badzra dgongs gter las: bar chad lam sel bzhugs: rmiḥ e ma ho ma chags dri bral chos sku snang mtha' yas: snying rje'i gter 'chang longs sku spyan ras gzigs: mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig padma 'byung: sku gsum mnyam nyid sang la gsol ba 'debs: gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: 1 āḥgle badzra gu ru padma sidhi hūṃ: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs thos bsam mdzad: dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa brkyangs: phur ba'i zhal gzigs mu stegs ma lus btul: sgrub sde rgya mche'i grub brnyes thod phreng rtsal: sprul sku khyad 'phags rje la gsol ba 'debs: gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs: dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: sa āḥ( badzra gu ru padma sidhi ྅: o rgyan yul du sku bzhugs 'gro don mdzad: 'byung ba'i log sbyor ma tshugs grub rtags bstan:

'byer ldan gtsug 'dzin tshom bu 'bum 'bum bcas:phyag rgya chen por sbyor la gsol ba 'debs:gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs:dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: tho āḥ( badzra gu ru padma sidhi ྅: bod yul dbus su zhal byon gdug pa btul: nyas po ri rtser dregs tshogs dam la btab:sku gsung thugs tshab gdul bya'i dpal du bzhag:bka' drin mtshungs med rje la gsol ba 'debs:gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs: dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: a āḥhūṃ badzra gu ru padma sidhi hūṃ: dpal gyi bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub:chos kyi char dbab rje 'bangs smin grol bkod: gdon gzugs bon bsgrubs chos sku dri med bstan:che ba'i mtshan gsum grags la gsol ba 'debs:gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs:dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol:sa āḥhūṃ badzra gu ru

ba:tshu padma sidhi hūṃ: khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin gangs can mtshos:mi mjed zhing dang khams 'dul mdzad phrin sgo: bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi: gzigs bya bgrang dka' de la gsol ba 'debs: gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs:dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: sa āḥ( badzra gu ru padma sidhi ྅:da lta gdong mar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad:thugs rje'i 'od zer gangs ljongs bod la 'gyed: mdzad pa phrin las gdul bya'i khams kun khyab:snyigs ma'i skyabs mchog de la gsol ba 'debs:gus pa'i phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs: dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: sa āḥ& badzra gu ru padma sidhi :: sku gsung thugs ldan 'gro ba 'dren mdzad dpal: sgrib pa kun sbyangs mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas:dngos grub mchog stsol bde chen rgyal po'i sku: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: gus pa'i phyag 'tshal

snying nas skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes byin rlobs brtse bas lam sna drongs: dngos grub mchog stsol phyi nang gsang rkyen sol: ma ātshwa badzra gu ru padma sidhi hūṃ dad dang mos gus drag po yis: skyabs gcig padhwa ka ra la gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs pa'i bu 'phral rkyen bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal: byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs kun byang baspu ba med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya snyi: ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud dang dad ldana'abyug sgras bskul ngoranus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

la( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos skor: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgrub pa'i kha bskang lag len las kyi rim pa bco brgyad pa: dngos grub sprin 'khrigs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gtsaX na31 gu dzag padmā ka ra ye: skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugasathod phreng rtsal: mi 'bral snying dbus pad mtshor rtag rol mdzod padma'i thugs bskyed smon lam gdul bya'i yul: smin par byed pa'i thabs mchog 'di kho na: sa ma yā phun chogs lnga yisgrub la zhugs pa'i tshe: smin byed dbang dang 'da' med dam tshig 'dzin sgrub pa'i yo byad rkyen bzlog sman dang ni: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams mdzes par bkod: sa bslang grogs bcol dkar dmar skyems phud gtong bgegs bsal srung ba'i gur phub dam rgya bsdams dam tshig 'dzin cing rdor dril rgyan rlabs ni: snyen ma hā badzra sa:ces rdo rje thugs shar brten zhing thugs kyi dam tshig 'dzin dzñā na tiṣṭha hūṃ: ces dril bu dkur brten zhing gsung gi dam tshig 'dzin snyen sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra gā na badzra sa ma ya skyes: ces thugs shar 'byud rgya bya zhing sku yi dam tshig 'dzin: bsang chu byin rlabs ni: stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu sa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang: g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad par gsal ba'i smra las khro chung rdzul phra rab tu 'phros pas: 'byung po dam sri thams cad rdzul du brlag pa dang mchod rdzas ye shes kyi rol par sgrar nus pa'i

gtsa(: mthu ldan du byin gyis brlabs la: ka a bighān ta kṛta tshinta tshinta hūṃ phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig brjod: lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu de gang dang gang la 'thor ba tsam gyis 'bag rtsog nyes skyon dri ma thams cad sbyang ba'i nus ldan du gyur: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni:shā hrī: mtha' bral ste nga pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde stong rtsal mdangs ting 'dzin rol ston ni: phyi nang gsang mchod lha mo'i gar dang bcas: dbang chen padma'i dgyes bskang sprin du stel: skye su ra su ra a purta ya a purta ya ho:badzra pū dza spa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa ྅: khros byungs ni: 33 rdo rje lha mo'i sbos khang las spros pa'i snang stong rnam dag bdud rtsi spos sprin 'dis: rtog sgrib las byung dri ma bag chags kun: ye shes sgrib med ngang du ram̐ ye dza: sang sa le sang nge ye swā hā: ram̐ badzra dhu pe pra titstsha byu dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ: rol mo byin rlabs ni: ྅ hrī:snang ba thabs su shar ba'i rnga bo che: stong pa chos dbyings rol mo sil snyan sgra: dpa' bo 'bod pa'i chu srin rkang gling dang: bcu drug dga' bde'i don mtshon gling bu

zung ro mnyam rdo rje'i 'khyug ma dung chen dang: rig 'dzin paṇa grub tshogs bskul dkar dung dbyangs: rta phag bcu drug ltag sprod ḍā ma dza/ mnyam pa'i dbyings bskul g.yer phreng ting ting shag: khams gsum chos dbyings sgras khyab mkhar rnga sogs: rgyal ba'i dgyes bskyed kun bzang rol mo'i sprin sems can sdug bsngal sangs byed sku ngas dzadargas rje : skyes badzra dharma ghaṇḍi shabha ā :: de ltar byin gyis brlabs par bya: rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang nyid du gyur: sa ma yā: byin gyis brlabs pa'i las rim ste dang po'o: rgya rgya rgya: skyabs yul bskyed pa ni: rlu ma hā shu n+ya ta dzña na badzra sā bhā wa arma ko3 nya: mdun gye nam mkhar sna tshogs padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'brur bde stong nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su: bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i o rgyan chen po phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal gsal ba'i sku dbyings dwangs gsal gyi klong du: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho rig 'dzin lo paṇa bsam yas: dag pa dbyings gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho dang bcas

pa( pa ma badres shing yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas: zhi khro rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo: na tho: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: thegag ser tshig brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o:bka' bab lung bstan brgyud pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o:smon lam las 'phro'i brgyud pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma thugs rdze sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma mngon par byang chub sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o: rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi'o: brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can la skyabs su mchi'o: 'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rdze can la skyabs su mchi'o: na mo:'das dang ma byon da ltar

bzhugs pa yi: sgrib gnyis skyon spangs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang: lung rtogs dam chos tshogs mchog dge 'dun te: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: byin rlabs char 'bebs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: dngos grub sprin 'khrigs yi dam rgyud sde'i lha: bde stong 'od 'bar dbyings gsum ḍākki'i sprin:rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la skyabs su mchi: ngo bo stong zhing bdag med de bzhin nyid: rang bzhin 'od gsal nges pa lnga ldan gter: thugs rje mkhyen gzig phrin las chags thogs bral:sku gsum ye shes 1nga la skyabs su mchi:ho:nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pha ma sems can rnams: nam yang mi gtong tshul khrims gsum gyis skyongs:snying rje yis ni sems can don byed cing: shes rab rtogs pas srid pa'i drwa ba gcod: don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs sangs de yi sras:mdzad dka' spyod pa rgya mtshor bdag gnas bgyi:skye ā:nyu 'dus ma byas pa mkha' 'dra'i de bzhin nyid: mi g.yo bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor len: lus dang ngag yid dwangs bas rab bskul te:

tsa( bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag bgyi'o: nam mkha'i gnas sunam mkha' gang ba yi: kun bzang mchod sprin mnyam pa nyid du 'bul: rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi'i dbang gyur gzung 'dzin nong: thams cad chos sku'i dgongs sang bshags bgyi'o: ma brtsal ye rdzogasasku gsum dkyil 'khor la: ngo mtshar rang ngo rig pas rjes yi rangs: sku gsum gdul zhing gang 'dul mdzad pa yis: mdo sngags rdzogs chen chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: thugs bskyed mdzad pabyedan lam rnam dag pa'i: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dus gsum rnam dkar dge tshogs gcig bsdus te: 'khor gsum yongs dag dmigs med chen por bsngo: nang dbyingasachos sku ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor: skye med gsung gsang mngon gyur sa thob shog: de yis tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i snod rung 'gyur sa ma yā: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags pa'i las rim ste gnyis pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: sngon gtor 'bul ba ni: dkar gtor dang skyems 'dod rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni: ces sbyobye hrī ā: rin

po che'i snod stong gsum dang mnyam par: bcud dkar bshos gangs ri la nyin byed kyis 'khyud pa'i bkrag mdang 'bar ba: skyems rgya mtsho 'jing nam bas kyang rgya che la gting zab pa: dpal 'dod dgu'i sprin 'khrigs shing longs spyod lnga yi char 'bebs pa: lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur: dzad ā:( ha ho hrī: badzra spa ra ṇa dza: dza: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten la: dbang mdzad zo dor dregs pa can: dkar la dgyes shing dam la gdung: rlung gi shugs can bang rtsal mgyogs: byedan nas g.yar dam gnyer bzhes pa'i: dge bsnyen dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yul gzhi'i bdag po mnga' dbang bsdus: sa 'di bdag la stsol ba dang: gsang chen sgrub la ru ma nga: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: sems can sku ngas la phan bde spel: phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsams kyang: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: zhes brjod la gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs: sha khrag brgyan pa'i dmar gtor dang ja chang gi skyems

btsan spyomasaphral reye khaṃ:mchod gtor gyi dngos 'dzin stong par sbyangs rgo ā:྅ gis zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gang la gang mkho ba'i longs spyod:ci la ci dgyes pa'i yo byad:mthong thos dran reg gi mgron rnams kyi ngoms pa skongs shing gdug rtsub zhi nas byang chub gyi sems la gnas pa'i bde ba skyed byed du gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags kyis spel:bdag nyid padma thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i thugs sgog las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: gnag cing rtsub pa'i lha ma srin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams spyan drangs shing bkug la mdun du 'khod par gyur:kyi stong khams srid par dbang bsgyur zhing:nam mkha'i dbyings la thogs med bsgod: bar snang yangs par rtag tu rgyu: sa gzhir mnga' mdzad lha ma srin: lha dang gshin rje ma mo bdud: btsan dang rgyal po gnod sbyin ku: gza' dang the'u rang dmu gtod rigs:thams cad ma lus dam la 'dus: gnod cing gdug rtsub bsam sbyor sbongs: zhi zhing byams brtse dad gus kyis: mchod sbyin gtor ma skyems bzhes la:sdang byed

dgra bo rdul brlag cing: gnod byed bgegs dpung tshar bcad nas: sgrub la bar chad med pa dang: bsam don yid bzhin grub la sogs: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar 'bul: rkyen zhi gegs bral bsam don 'grub de nas bgegs la changs glud bsngo ba ni: spyo las rin po che'i dzā da duces las glud gtor 'dod sku na lnga ldan gyi phung por gyur: shes ā:nyu: de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod: sam bha ra'i sngags dngas ka ros spel bdag nyid dbang chen rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas drag po'i rta skad stong gsum kheng pa sgrog pas sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdon tshogs dbang du 'dud cing dam la 'dogs par bsam: na lnga: dzo btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka' bden pa dang: dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang: gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa chen po'i mthus: sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo

gas/: rje 'dzin pa bdag gis gsang chen gyi sgrub pa zab mo'i dbu btsug nas:bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhi bzung ba la bar du gcod pa'i pho gdon rgyal po: mo gdon bse mo: klu gdon sa bdag: gza' gdon rgyu skar:ya bdud rgyal po:ma bdud rgyal mo: btsan kha bzhi: mgyogs sde brgyad: 'byung po ro langs: sa bdag klu srin: nad rims yams kyi bdag po bdag mo: bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu:byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga:'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya: gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad: gang dang gang yin pa thams cad lan chags gtor ma len pa'i slad du 'dir 'dus shig: bla( sarba bisnan a gar sha ya dza: dzaḥtsū baṃ ho: gzhung ltar bka' bsgos la lan chags bsngo ba ni:dzñā rnal 'dredar bdag cag dpon slob kyi: sngon gyi lan chags ma byang ba: phral du bu lon ma sod pa: sha rin khrag tshabs sgog gi glud:mtho ba mkhar dang mi rta'i tshabs: dma' ba yul zhing dkor nor yas: de ring sngags 'chang ngas mchod kyis:

bgegs rgyal 'khor bcas tshims gyur nas: sngon kyi lan chags byang ba dang: phral gyi bu lon sod gyur nas: rang gi lus la dpe long la gzhan la gnod 'tshe ma byed par: bgegs rgyal 'aX ra bcas da sdugang cig: sarba bisnan gasne hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab des ni bgegs rnams nye mi nus sa ma mā: sngon gtor 'bul ba'i las rim ste gsum pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: srung dmigs ni: ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i steng thams cad mtshon cha sna lnga'i bla bre: bar thams cad mtshon cha sna lnga'i drwa gur: 'og thams cad mtshon cha sna lnga'i sa gzhi: de'i phyi rim ye shes kyi khro bo dang khro mo'i gur khang: bskal pa'i 'thor rlung dang ye shes kyi me chu'i dra ba dkrigs par gyur: nang dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'ur rang snang 'od gsal gyi gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs sogs mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dam lha yi nga rgyal gyi ngang la gnas par gyur: skyed badzra tsakra tikta garma gī la ya dzwa la re ram̐ḥtsū phaṭa: dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu

btsarsha gnas par gyur cig: dzñanadhartu badzra rakta rakta tiṣṭha lhanaḥ des ni 'gyur ba mi mnga' bar: ye shes lha yis byin dbab 'gyur: sa ma yā 'gyur ba med par rgyas gdab pa'i srung dmigs kyi las rim ste bzhi pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: ma tshang kha bskang brda sgo dbye ba sogs ni: khye trī: gdod nas spros bral ka dag chos kyi dbyings: ma rig dbang gis phyogs ris so sor bzung: du ma tha dad snang yang ngo bo gcig: gnyis med zang thal rtogs byer brda sgo dbye: sbyo maṇḍal saṃ skri ta pra we sha ya phaṭa: bye: chos nyid mnyam pa'i thig le grwa zur bral:yongs rdzogs lha tshogs gnyis med lhun gyis grub: don dam rang rig mjal ba'i brdas mtshon nas: ye babs lta ba rtogs pas phyag bgyi'o: sarba a ti pu ho:na mo sa: ho: phyogs ris mi mnga' chos sku thugs rje can: ye nas gnyis med bla ma rdo rje 'chang: sgog gi ko ru 'ub chub gcig rdzogs par: nam yang mi gtong dam tshig 'dzin par bgyi: badzra tsitta sa ma ya hrī: ho: kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings nyid ye dag kyang: rnam rtog mu bzhir 'thas pa'i gol sgrib gyi: snang zhen a 'tha'i dri

ma mtha' dag kun: mi gnas ye 11la bla ma chos skur bshags: badzra sa ma ya bhi sabye ā: 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lag ste: spros pa can la med mi rung: sa ma yā: brda sgo dbye phyag dam bca' 'gyod bshags kyi las rim ste lnga pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: byin bskul ni:dkyil 'dzadar mchod rdzas gzhal yas khang lha dang lha mo rnams las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: rtsa ba gsum dang phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i sku phyag rgya phra mo: gsung yig 'bru'i rnam pa: thugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs: yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od phung gi rnam par byin thibs thibs bun ling ling byon nas: gnyis su med par byin chen dbab la dbang chen bskur nas dag smin rdzogs par bsam la: ( trī: chos sku skyemed spros dang bral ba las: 'gags med ye shes gzigs pa'i thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin 'khrigs shing:gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa mngon gyur stsol: dbang chen zla gam dgu rdzogs e 1nga nas: sgrub sde dgu rdzogs bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dal: phyag rgya zil gnon

bas/ gsang ba gsum du bzhengs: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa mngon gyur stsol: bde stong klong yangs padma 'bum 'khyil nas: dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i rtags 'dzin rnams: bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya'i gar ngoms la: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa mngon gyur stsol: grin las lhun grub bka' nyan pho brang nas: rdo rje'i srog ldan dregs pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ye shes rjes su 'gro ba'i gar ngoms bzhin: gnas 'dir byin phob rtog pa mngon gyur stsal: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob gzi mdangs bskyed: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur nus byin phob: rtags mtshan bzang po dus las mi g.yel bar: mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho char ltar dbob: skyid badzra ma hā gu ru bidu dha ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā na dhartu a we sha ya a ā: de ltar byin dbab nus mthu bskyed yon tan yid bzhin nor ltar 'phel sa ma yu byin chen dbab pa'i las rim ste drug pa'o: rgya rgya rgya gzhung ltar mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs phral: dngos kun bdud rtsi'i mchod pas rgyal ba'i dgyes pa bskyed

par bsam la: bla ā:྅: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī:ṭha: 'khor b.liganas rnya nga phyir rakta'i mtshan 'dzin bsgral la girti dmar mo'i gsang bar byin gyis brlabs te:oṃ ā:྅:ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūṃ hrī:ṭha: 'dod yon gyizhen 'dzin grol phyir dam rdzas ba lirnyi ro brgya nus pa stong ldan ye shes kyi lha mo'i gar dang bcas par spros te:yin ā:྅ ma hā ba lidha te dzwa ba ling ta ba la ba te gu hya trī shwa sa ma ya hūṃ hrī:ṭha: byang chub sems ()zeg mas rgyal ba'i dgyes pa bskang zhing sems can gyi chags rtog ka nas dag par byas te: bde stong ye shes kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur par bsam la: yid hūṃ bye:hrī a: sa:lī:ྈ:māṃ:hūṃ: bho dhi tsitta spra ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa :: dngos 'dzin dag pamiphyi mchod: nyon mongs grol ba'i nang mchod: dug lnga cer grol gsang mchod: ro mnyam rdo rje'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur: a badzra pū dza spra ra ṇa sa: de star byin gyis brlabs pa yis: rgyal ba'i dgyes pa skong bar 'gyur: sa ma yā mtshod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa'i las rim ste bdun pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni: rang dza/

badzra: snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul te: dbang bskur ba'i lha rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par byon te rin po che sna lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur:bum chus lus kyi cha shas kun tu khyab cing brdal bas: sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par sbyangs: dbang bzhi ye shes kyi rang zhal ji bzhin pa mngon sum du mthong: slar dbang rtags su snang ba mtha' yas gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lnga'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur: sa ma hā pra tai bhe kṣa na dzña na badzra su bhā wa atma ko3 nya: ka ma hā a darsha dzñā na badzra sā bha wa atpa ko3 nya: bla ma hā sa ma ta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3 nya: 31 ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra su bha wa atma ko3 nya:tsho ma hā kri hye shugi na dzñā na badzra sā bha wa atpa ko3 nya: zhes dbang bskur zhing ye shes lnga yi cod pan bcing bar bya'o: slar yang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lngas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus pa'i rgyas gdab kyi dbang chen thob par bsam la: tsho sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 nya: sa sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā wakka

badzra sā bhā wa atma ko3 nya: 31 sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsitta badzra sā bha wa atpa ko3 nya: slar yang rang dza ga dam tshig gi lcags kyus bskul te ye shes kyi 'khor lo mkha' khyab tu sad nas bdag dam tshig gi dkyil 'dza ra la spyan drangs te tha mi dad par bstim mo: de star dbang bskur rgyas gdab pas bsgrub bya'i lha dang skal ba mnyam: sa ma yā: dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa'i las rim ste brgyad pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: sman gtor rakta'i khā hi ni: 31 ā:shā chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: 'o ngas sku nam mkha' rgyal po: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal: lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas: ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs: 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsa rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: grub mchog bla ma mkhar nag: he pa chos kyi 'byung gnas: rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje bdud 'dul bzhad pa dgyes rtsal: klong yangs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor: gar dbang nus ldan 'dus rtsal: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma: gzhan yang bka' gter gsar rnying gi 'gro 'dren skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi:

bsgotshu ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā ba lirnyi khā hi: rjes 'jug rnams sras ltar skyong zhing byin rlabs kyi dbang bskur stsol cig: sa ā:྅:khyad 'phags rig 'dzin phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal: yi dam gsang 'dus yab yum: dbang chen rta phag yab yum: dpa' bo sde bzhi yab yum: laṅka ging chen yab yum: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi yab yum: rgyal chen sde bzhi yab yum: gzhan yang yi dam rgyud sde dang sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi:ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā ba lirnya khā hi: sgrub pa po la zhal nye zhing mchog thun dngos grub kyi char chen po dbab par mdzad du gsol: ma ā:snre:mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: yum mchog gsang ba ye shes: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang chen: sangs rgyas rdo rje mkha' 'gro: rin chen padma mkha' 'gro: las dang 'jig rten mkha' 'gro: dam tshig sha za mkha' 'gro: shugs 'gro phra men ma tshogs: gzhan yang gnas yul rigs sngags zhing skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang:

'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā ba lirnyi khā hi: skal ldan la brda chos ston zhing bde stong gi ye shes bskyed par mdzad du gsol: sa ā:nyu rta nag badzra gī la ya: 'dzam gling skyong ba'i ge sar: sngags srung e ka dza ṭi: gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag:ma mo gsod byed chen mo: bdud mo snying 'byin nag mo: dkor srung dur khrod lha mo: mi srun sha za chen mo: bstan srung dmar po lha lnga bdud kyi spu gri thod pa'i phreng ba: btsan gyi spu gri me zhags dmar po: klu yi spu gri dug rlang khol ma: gter gyi srung ma spu gri mched gsum: gzhan yang ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi srung ma pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor sprul pa zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā ba lirha khā hi: dam tshig gi rjes nyul zhing legs nyes kyi ltong 'dzin cing rnal 'byer ba'i brin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub par mdzad du 'asol: de ltar phul bas tshogs rdzogs shing: phrin las rnam bzhi

gtsa( 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma yā: mchod 'bul mtshan don khā hi sbyar ba'i las rim ste dgu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bsgrang phreng byin gyis rlabs pa ni: skyes sarba dharma ga ga na ā: —1nga pa'i ngang las bsgreng phreng rnams 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang thig le dra ba dang drwa phyed kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i dbus su: rgya bod kyi lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtshor gsal ba'i sku rnams bde stong gnyis su med pa'i rol gar bsgyur: gsung gsang sngags snying po'i rang sgra 'u ru ru sgrogs: thugs ye shes kyi gzigs pas bdag dang 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi rmongs mun ma rig pa'i dri ma bsal: yon tan mi zad pa'i gter la mnga' brnyes shing khams gsum gyi snang zhen gyi dri ma sbyangs: phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi mthu dang ldan te srid pa'i dra ba rlung sems kyi rgyun dag nas ye shes chos kyi skur sad par dmigs la: 31 ru ci ra ma ni pra warbha ni swā hā: nyer gcig brjod: dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum bzlas la rab tu gnas shing shis pa brjod: sngags phreng mi lag mi brgyud cing: lus kyi drod dang 'bral mi bya: sa ma yā sgrub rdzas bsgrang phreng byin gyis brlabs pa'i las rim ste bcu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: dam rdzas ril bu sgrub pa ni:

skye bdun sha ni gtso bo la: a par skyur gsum blon du shes: bzang po drug ni 'bangs su sdeb sel med chos sman kha tshar btab: mngar gsum dbang lag khu bas dril ril bu sran ma'i tshad tsam bya: dmar ser gur gum na bza' gsol: rin po che yi bum par blug rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i dus su bya: rnam lnga nyer spyod rdzas rtags bkram phyi nang mchod pa rgyas par bkod: lha snang ting 'dzin brtan po yis: snang srid kyi khams thams cad zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor gsal gdab: nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub cing bar snang la mchod pa'i lha mos sprin phung gtibs pa: sa gzhi la me tog padmo sna tshogs kyis gcal bkrams shing dri bsungs phun sum tshogs pa'i ngad g.yo ba: de dbus sbyoḥlas bum pa rang byung gi gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs sogs mtshan nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su: ril bu rnams o rgyan rin po che'i sku til gyi gong bu phyur ba bzhin gsal gdab: thams cad kyi thugs sgog las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: rnga yab kyi gling dang sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nas brgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad gu ru rin po che'i

btsaX rnam par spyan drangs nas rgya mtsho chen po la kha char babs pa ltar ril bu lhar gsal ba la sib sib bstim mo: ye shes pa dbab bstim bya: 'dzab bsnyen pa ni:sa: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che bar: ril bu rnams gu ru rin po che phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal du gsal ba'i sku yi 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud thams cad yang yang bsdus te gnyis su med par bstim la: tshig bdun gyi dbyangs dang bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen gyi sngags bzla'o: āḥ snang srid kyi khams thams cad yongs su khyab pa'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che bar: ril bu rnams gu ru thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i sku yi 'od zer gyis dregs pa can thams cad dbang du sdud cing bran tu bkol bar dmigs: gsung chos nyid kyi rang sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar 'u ru ru ti ri ti ri bzlas pas srid gsum g.yo 'gul byed cing khams gsum sku gsung thugs su dag smin dzadags par bsam la: snang ba 'dzin med la bzhag rig pa gtad med du bor ( glu tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dren bar skabs su tshig bdun gyi dbyangs dang sgrub pa dang sgrub chen gyi sngags dang: a ra pa tsa

mi ta hri da ya swā hā: zhes sham btab la gyer bar bya'o: shā: ril bu ye shes lha yi sku ru gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang: legs tshogs dpal yon gyi sgo thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang: rlung sems ting nge 'dzin dang lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang: bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang thar ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs sogs bdud dang dam sri 'byung po thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam la: las sngags kyi sham du sa a ralli ya ra)ཿ sa ma ya trī hrī phi 11 : de ltar bzlas pas grub rtags 'byung: myong bas grol ba khyad chos yin: sa ma yā dam rdzas ril bu sgrub pa'i las rim ste bcu gcig pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: phrin las kyi kha skong ni rtsa sngags mthar: 'jigs byenags rten 'brel nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad shīdzña ku ru swā hā: lan bdun brjod: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar:tshe bsod dpal yon legs pa'i stogs thams cad puṣṭi ku ru swā hā: lan bdun brjod rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par gyur cig: rtsa

gas/ sngags mthar: khams gsum 'gro ba'i rlung sems thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: lan bdun brjod dbang gi phrin las rabs 'byam thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed dgra bgegs bdud tshogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: lan bdun brjod: drag po'i brin las rabs 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par gyur cig: ho: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs padma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes:brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: stob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas: bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad dus da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol: ྅: bde gshegs yongs 'dus ngo bo bla ma dgongs: tshogs sbyor slob pa'i lam gnas thams cad la bsnyen cing sgrub 'bras thun mong grub pa brgyad: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mig sman rkang mgyogs dang: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi dang: mkha' la spyod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsos: zhes

dang: kye padma thod phreng lam byed pa'i: rnal 'byor skal bzang pho mo la: thugs mchog dpal gyi be'u nas: ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma sbor: snang srid dag mnyam lta ba'i rdzong: chos sku'i rang zhal mngon sum ston: 'dzin med 'od gsal sgom pa'i 'phrang: longs sku'i gzigs pa bdag la phyogs: rtsol sgrub ro snyoms spyod pa'i sgog: sprul sku'i phrin las myur 'jug cing: 'khor ba dongs sprug nus pa dang: 'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar mdzod: sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs nas:don gnyis lhun grub dngos grub stsol: deng sang skya ring dang po shar: rdo rje srin po'i nam yang lang: dngos grub stsol ran dus la babs: thugs dam ma g.yel o rgyan rje: dngos grub stsol cig sku drin can: byin rlabs ma g.yel thugs rje'i gter: ka ā:shā ma hā gu ru sarba sidhi pha la a la la ho: des ni dngos grub bskul byed cing: lus ngag yid gsum smin grol byed: sa ma yā: phrin las grub phyir sham 'dogs shing 'dod gsol gdab pa'i las rim ste bcu gnyis pa'o: rgya rgya rgya chos skyong gi gtor ma byin rlabs ni: do/nga pa'i ngang las shā pa

bsgo/: me thod sgyed kyi khar: ā75sa ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' bcing ba ldag gzhib kyi bkod pa thams cad phun sum dzamags par gyur: de yang ram̐ las mes ma dag pa thams cad bsreg: ye las rlung gis bag chags thams cad gtor: dza las chus gnyis 'dzin thams cad bkrus nas: ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod yon lnga yi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po: dngos po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum dam can chos skyong srung ma mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: lo āḥtsū sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha: ma āḥ( ma hā rakta ja la maṇḍal hūṃ hrī:ṭha: ma ā ñdzi ma hā ba lirha te dzwa ba lirnya bha la bha ti gu hya sa ma ya hūṃ hrī:ṭha: rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer glog 'khyug pa ltar 'phros: rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la phog:sngon gyi bka' tha tshig rjes su dran nas: chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas mdun du 'khod par gyur: lo sarba dharma pā la kṣe ṭa pā la lo ka pā la e hya hi ṭi ka

(1 ༄ste: sa ma ya rdoste: sa ma ya tswa: rang gzhung ltar du srung ma rnams bskang gsol bya zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma yā: chos skyong gi gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'i las rim ste bcu gsum pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: tshogs phrin gdab pa ni slob bus phyag gsum zhe sa bcas ho dgongs su gsol ma : spros pa med pa'i dbyings: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i: 37 rgyan yab yum rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol: deng gi dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir sgrub rdzas yo byad ni bkram: lha sngags ting 'dzin kun gsal glu gar bro yis kyang bskul: ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul lags na: bdag gzhan gyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa'i slad du bzhes par ci gnang: bla mas lan gnang ni: ho: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'tshogs shing thugs yid gcig pa'i rdo rje rgyal theb garma gdang can las kyi gzungs ma las kyi ging ka ra rdo rje gdong 'khrugs las mjad g.yos sbyor mkhan sogs: dkyil 'khor 'dir 'tshogs shing 'dus pa rnams gsan du gsol: gtsang spe gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa bor:

bsnye tsu dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor dang du len bzhin tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor lags na: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i stogs 'khor dang bcas pas thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bzhes par gnang ngo: kun gyis: a la la ho: / hrī: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: dga' ston tshogs kyi mchod pa bkod lags na: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs brtses dgyes bzhes nas: bdag cag rnams kyi chags nyams skong gyur cig: sa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo ྅: de nas tshogs kyi gzhung la 'jug: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur sa ma yā tshogs phrin gdab pa'i las rim bcu bzhi pa'o: rgya rgya rgya bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni:sarba dharma ga ga na ā: ste nga pa'i ngang las mkha' dbyings rnam dag pa'i dbus oṃ las beeḍūrya'i sa gzhir thugs kyi dga' ston: shar du sbyoḥlas shel gyi sa gzhir sku yi tshogs mchod: lto ru saḥlas gser gyi sa gzhir yon tan gyi rol ston: nub tu che0las zangs kyi sa gzhir gsung bde stong gi mchod sprin: byang du āḥlas g.yu yi sa gzhir brin las phun sum tshogs

pa'i bskang rdzas: ri dwags g.yung dgas chu gnas bya rigs gcan gzan 'bru sman zas nor gos rgyan yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum mthar: bskang rdzas rnams 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rabs 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur: badzra sba ra ṇa dza:tshogs bsgral la: mdun du e las lcags khang gru gsum pa mtshon thun sna tshogs kyis tshang khang 'khrigs pa'i nang du: driḥdang tri las zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang: thar lam la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs gang yin pa de mngon sum du gsal la: na moḥ rig 'jin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:yi dam rgyud sde dang sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs la brten nas:

ba:tshu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom pa'i dgra bgegs gang dang gang yin pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig: dza:spyo baṃ ho: lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum zhe sa bcas: sngon gyi tha tshig dang mthun par lhag gtor ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par zhu pañtsa a mṛ ta ྅: ha ho hrī: gang la dbang ba'i lhag mgron rnams sngon gyi bka' tha tshig bzhin du dpal gyi pham phab kyi mgron du bshagags shig byon cig: e a ra li hri tri pho dza: lhag ma'i gtor ma gzhung ltar gtong sgrub pa'i drod srungs mel rtse bcol: sa ma yā: bskang bsgral lhag gsum gyi las rim ste bco lnga pa'o: rgya rgya rgya gtor 'gugs ni: gtor snod e lasaya/den rje'i bsha' gzhi las kyi pho nya dang mtshon thun 'khrugs pa'i nang du: gtor ma yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal bar gyur:na moḥ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang: yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka'

sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang: bden pa chen po de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: ma rungs ba'i sems can rū tra bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa gzugs can dang gzugs med gang yin pa thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: lan gsum: dza shā baṃ ho: dbyings nas mtshon thun gyi char dbab pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum nam mkhar mnyam pa'i sprin du gyur: bskul ba gtong: sngon gyi tha tshig dang mthun pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po mgron rnams rang rang gi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab par gyuraḥ au ā:nyu ha ho hrī: chad mdo gtong rin po che'i sgod du bshos bu dang bshal chu zag med ye ro/sa kyi bdud rtsir: skyes ā:shā lan gsum brtan ma gtong zhing phrin las bcol: sgrub la bar chad med par bya: sa ma yu: tha tshig gi gtor ma rnams gtong ba'i las rim ste bcu drug pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bro 'gugs ni:ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom mun pa nag po rlung thub kyi nang du tri las dam sri rgab 'dre bse rag pho mo thams cad thibs kyis 'dus par bsam la: na mo mchog gsum sku

btsa/ gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: khyad par du che mchog padma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i bden pa'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri nyuphye spun dgu bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad e nyid stong pa'i sgrom rgyar khug cig: dza:dzñā baṃ ho:gnod byed dam sri khul le spun dgu bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad thar ba'i dus med par gyur: sa dang po ting 'dzin rtse gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa bcom ldan thub drug rgya: bdun pa byang chub yan lag rgya: brgyad pa lhun shā/ba bye brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgya: phyag rgya de rnams rgyas btabs pas: bdud dang dam sri ma ga 'dren rnams: nam yang ldang bar ma byed cig: gzhung gi bro mnan bya: ྅ bzhi'i sngags mthar: 31 le: ā:le: nyu le: sum lam̐: ha leḥst+waṃ

bha ya nan: de ltar bro mnan byas pa yis sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad sel: sa ma yu: rgab 'dre bse rag dam sri mnan pa'i las rim ste bcu bdun pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: rjes chog gi dmigs rim ni: bdag mdun gyi gnas so so las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par spros te: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad la mchod pa bla na med pas mchod cing dgyes pa bskyed par bsam la: mchod sngags rgya cher 'bul gzhan yang rdo rjelilha mo rnams kyis mdzes pa sku yi gar byed cing phyag nas rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol bzhin ngag nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rta la drang nas: lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la bstod pa glu yi mchod pa phul bar bsam la: bstod pa rgyas par bya'o: bzod gsol skabs: ho: rtsa gsum kun dngos padma thod breng rtsal bdag la dgongs su gsol: sems ma rig pa gnyis 'dzin gyi dbang du gyur te so sor thar ba'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba: byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya nyams pa: gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig la 'gal 'das zhig ral gyis skyon

badzra byung ba thams cad mi 'chab mi sbed par gnong zhing 'gyed sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshags par bgyid lags so: tshe 'di dang phyi mar sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i tshangs pa stsal du gsol: skyed badzra sa ma ya ā: yig brgya dbyangs gsal bzlas la lag chad bskangs brten bzhugs ni: khyedags bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du: rgyal ba rnams rten 'di dag rnams la brten par bzhugs su gsol: bzhugs nas kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i slad du mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol rgo su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: shis brjod la: rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon nas: zhal nas bkra shis dge mtshan gyi tshig rnams tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis brjod cing: phyag nas me tog manda ra ba'i char chen po dbab nas bkra shis

dge mtshan gyi snang bas sa gsum yongs su gang bar dmigs la: ye dharma he tu sogs brjod gzhung ltar bkra shis rgya chen bya: smon lam gdab pa ni: na ma gu dza rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bden stobs dang: bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu yis: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang: sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog: nad mug mtshon 'khrug rgud pa zhi ba dang: rdzogs ldan snang bas yongs su khyab gyur cig: mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags drod gtong zhi ba dang: 'dzam gling tha gru chos kyis mdzes par shog: nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi don ston pa'i: bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng gang bar shog: bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis ldan phrin las te:chos skyong rgyal pos rtag tu bsnyen gyur cig: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byer rgyas nas: dam chos bdus rtsis skye rgu tshims gyur cig: nag phyogs gdug pa'i mgo 'phang sma phab nas: dkar phyogs gzeng bstod legs nyes so srung re ga: bde nas bde ba'i lam bzang la brten nas: don gnyis lhun grub rdzogs sangs

gtsa( rgyas lnga ba thegag:de ltar bsngo smon rgyasagadab pas: bsam don 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub: sa ma yu rjes chog mtha' rgyan gyi las rim ste bco brgyad pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: e ma:rgyal ba'i dbang po padma thod phreng nga'i ma 'o sa 'gro la lag par thugs brtse bas thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor: phyag rgya zil gnon sgrub phran man ngag bcas: ma chang kha bskang cha lag dang bcas nas:grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstim:mdo khams bkra shis rdzongs der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga yi rgyal tshabs las can gcig dang 'phrad mdzad phrin gdul bya'i lhag ma de yis gso: 'gro don rma smra byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin zhing la 'god bka' 'di srungs shig dmar po lha lnga po:dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum gdul zhing skal ldan pad tshal rgyas gyur cig: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: lag len kha bskang las rim bco brgyad pa rdzogs so gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sam bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: brda thim zhi zhes pa 'di'angalung zin chos nyid grags pas bkra shis lha reg dkar dmar thabs shes rdor dril rin chen maṇḍal bsnyen

sgrub lhur len mdzad pa'i dam bca' dang bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal khams kyi sprang spyon o rgyan chen po'i thugs kyi nang don gyi myong ba cung zad thob pa nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyisami 'gags dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin game gīrtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:rig 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde'i:brda byang mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

'a:tshu na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye 2shā 'dzomaji mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya phu gang 'dul mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i phrin las kyi gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i don ston pa: mtsho skyes rdo rje bdag blo'i pad mor rol: deyang dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lags khang du: ston pa mtsho skyes rdo rje bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar: bdag mkhar chen mtsho rgyal dang: las can nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus te: nor sna khyad 'phags mang po dang sku la mdzes pa'i na bza': a mṛ ta'i skyems bzang ljags la bstabs nas: gus 'dud kyis phyag zhe sa dang bcas te mgrin gcig gis: yinam ho yab dang yum med padma'isdong po las: rus rigs las 'das brdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku: dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs 'dus 'gro ba'i mgon: 'dul dka' 'dul zhing sde brgyad dam la 'dogs: mtha' 'khob 'dre gling dkar po'i chos la bkod: bka' drin mtshungs med o rgyan chos kyi rje: padma thod phreng brtsebs dgongs su gsol: chos kyi che ba bkod pa'i khyad par dang: bstan pa'i

badzra phrin las dus kyi legs nyes dang: snod dang snod min gsang rgya'i mtshams dbye sogs: ji bzhin nyid de legs par gsungs du gsol: zhes zhus ma hā gu ru'i zhal snga nas: kye ho: mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal la: las can nyer lnga 'dir 'tshogs skal ba bzang: bdag gi spyan sngar 'khod rnams tshogs re bsags: bstan 'gror phan pa'i thugs bskyed ngo mtshar che: mkha' la lding ba'i bya tshogs mang na yang: khyung chen gser mig ldan la 'gran zla bral:gcan gzan khyu tshogs dpag gis mi lang yang: gangs kyi seng ge dkar mor mtshungs pa med: rlan las 'khrungs ba'i ge sar tshal mang yang: u dum wa ra mchog la phyogs mi nye: 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po mang na yang: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po shin tu dkon: sdon shing nags tshal bsam mi khyab na yang: sa mchog sbrul gyi snying po'i tshal de dkon: theg tshogs grub pa'i mtha' rgya bsam mi khyab: rmad byung a ti yo gar 'gran mi nus: gang 'dul ston pa bsam mi khyab na yang:

sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung mtshungs pa med: che ba'i yon tan rgya mtshos rab spud cing: bskal pa chags nas 'jig rten ma stongs bar: zag med sku la skye 'chi bsgres rgud bral: mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya rtsa gang 'dul bye phrag brgya brgyas 'gro don byed: chos dbyings gnas su skye med chos 'khor bskor:stug po bkod par nges pa lnga la dbang: ḍakki'i tshogs la gsang chen brda brgyud byed: sprul sku'i zhing du gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor: gdug pa can bsgral rnam shes dbyings su sbor: chags pa can 'gugs bde stong dga' bzhir sbyor: mos gus can la rig pa'i nyi ma sbar: nyams myong ldan la man ngag drod tshad 'debs:nam zlas bskul ba'i rtsi bcud 'bus pa bzhin: gdul byas bskul tshe thugs rjes de ru skyongs: ji ltar nam mkha'i mtha' ni bsam mi khyab: de ltar sems can mtha' yang zad mtha' bral: bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang der mnyam na: sprul pa phrin las mtha' yang tshad bzung bral: shan pa gdol ba smad btsong khyu na'ang:

ba tshu byang sems sprul pa re 'ga' 'byung srid na: gdul bya'i dus ston nga sprul tshad bzung dka': su la'ang log lta ma byed ro snyoms zhog: dri mas dri ma nyi mas mun pa bsal: ngang ngur dag gis 'o chu shan 'byed bzhin: nga sprul bu yis legs nyes rnam par phye:des kyang 'ur la sgrogs la nang ma bsdams: gdon gzugs bon la gshe zhing chos la 'dud: log bstan mu stegs bsnub cing rgyal bstan sgrogs:shes rab ma la brtse gar bde stong spyod: bya spyod 'chol yang re rdogs 'dzin stangs dag:spro thung rig pa hur la nyams rtogs myur: gtad med byung rgyal spyan ni mkha' la sbyor: gnas gsum sme ba nyams mgur glu sgra 'gyed: gces dgu cog bzhag bu lon sha 'ded mkhan: mi gcig dgras gnyer 'jig rten g.yeng bas dben: snying rje byams sems che zhing gtong phod ldan: ri khrod 'dzin spro bsnyen sgrub gnad la mos: de 'dra byung na bgo skal mchog gi nor: padma'i pha nor 'dzam gling spyi yi gter: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlang tho le ba: rtog ge'i

bslad kyis sel 'khri ma zhugs pa: theg dman blo la mi regangs rig pa'i gnad: rgya gsum chings lngas spras pa'i ke ta ga: rgyal khams spyi la gces pa'i gter kha dgu ma bton dngos grub yal ba'i gter kha lnga: 'dzam gling bsod nams bskyed pa'i gter kha gsum: bton du mi rung snying po'i gter ka lnga: sems can yun du bde phyir bla gter bkod: gter regs bco brgyad snying po sgom rgya bcas: gnas chen gnas phran phun tshogs lnga ldan kyi: zab pa lnga lngas legs par rgyas btab po: bdud sde dpung dgu phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon: rmongs pa'i bstan dgu phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon: 'khrug slong sri dgu phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon: ma dag sa dgu phyag rgyas zil gyis gnon: theg pa rim brgyad phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon: dus kyi rgud tshogs phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon: zel gargon rgyal po padma sgod phreng ngas: yul gru chen po 'dul ba'i gter chen re: yul phran du ma 'dul ba'i gter phran dang: 'dzam gling sa gnas kun la gter kha re: gnyer byang 'dzin pa'i pho nya

gas/ dam can re: chos la mos pa'i ban btsun sngags pa re: rgya gsum 'byed pa'i shes rab ḍāski re: thams cad o rgyan nga yi brjed tho yin: mi mjed zhing la sku drin mi chung tshe: drin gzo shes pa'i gdul bya re byung na: 'dzam gling phyur gtams nor gyis gzhal du med: khe drag 'jig rten bya bas gzhal du med: re 'dod bcos ma'i chos kyis gzhal du med: mi sbyin grags stong tshig gis gzhal du med: nges pa don gyis phyi mar sems pa na: o rgyan nga la gsol ba rgyun du thob: dben pa'i gnas nas 'o dod lhang lhang bos: mos gus gyis gzing ba spu slong bar bskul: bzod med gnas dbyung mchi ma thor thor phyungs:khye'us pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gdungs dbyangs gyis: dus gsum skad cig ma brjed nga bsgom la: tshig bdun rdo rje'i bzlas pas rab bskul na: 'du 'bral med par skyongs ngo phyi rabs rnams: padma nga yi thugs kyi sgrubs pa mchog: phyag rgya zil gnon che ba yon tan mdzod: rdo rje snying po'i 'bras bu dus brgya'i bcud:

reg tshad rnam par grol ba'i sa la sbyor: 'di 'phrad pho mo tshogs bsags skal ba bzang: dngos grub byin rlabs 'byung bar gdon mi za: sgrub pa po rnams tshe gcig srid mthar brgal: dpal ri padma 'od kyi pho brang du: 'phags bod lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i tshom bu rtsa 'khor gyi thog ma thugs sras thu bor 'gyur: de ltas bcud mchog rmad byung gsang mdzod dpal: khyed cag rnams la brtse ba chen pos sbyin: rang nyams dang sbyor rtags thon mtshan brnyes gal: da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas:rin chen brdar bstims bkra shis rdzongs la sbos: ma 'ongs bstan pa gso ba'i rten 'brel che: dus kyi ston 'khor rdo rje'i lung gis gsal: e ma ho: ya mtshan du mas spras pa'i dgyes sde mo: zab gter sgrub pa'i grogs mo mkhar chen bza': mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: lo paṇa rig 'dzin tshom bu dang bcas dgongs:spre'u tsha rgyud gnags ma rung srin po rnams: brtse chen thugs rjes dam chos lam la bkod: sku rten gtsug lags bsam yas lhun gyis grub:gsungs

bsgotshu rten 'phags yul bzhags pa'i chos rnams bkod: thugs rten zab mo'i gter gyis sa 'og bkang yon tan mthu smon las grub sprul pa 'gyed:phrin las nub med bye ba phrag brgyar phyur: mdzad pa rmad byung bkod pa'i rnam rol kun: lce brgyas brjod kyang zad pa'i mthar mi dpogs: sangs rgyas mdzad phrin smon lam de 'dra na: las can smon lam mthu btsan khyed rnams kyang: bstan 'gro'i don du thugs bskyed dag par mdzod: chos kyi spyan ldan 'brog mi ye shes blo shes rab thogs med khye'u chung lo tsā khyod: ma 'ongs dus su sprul pa'i gter ston ni: du mar sprul dang ma nges sna tshogs pas: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa bsam yas ston: zab gsang rdor snying bstan pa 'di 'phrad skabs: snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing 'khrug pa slong ba'i dus: grub pa'i gdung 'dzin dpa' bo ni ga: o rgyan rig 'dzin nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal shing khams 'brug lo blo gsal dbang po rno: yab gshegs yum 'dor ma nyes la yog dang: mi mdzes zug rngu du mas shin tu gtsen: o

rgyan nga la dad mos lhags par 'phel:skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas: rang byung ye shes dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin: 'dod yon ro snyoms brtul zhugs brtse gar brgyur: nying khu zab bcud rang gi myong ba'i tshe: gter rgyaḥston pa'i mtshan snyan ba dan dkar: yongs la brdal zhing gdul bya ngang gis 'du: chos 'di'i snod gyur dbang skal 'dzoms pa yis: lung zin skyes mchog nyi shu rtsa lnga bstan: rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam padma gsal: skye rtags ma nges bzang ngan du ma brgyud: chos 'di'i bcud 'dzin pra 1 dzña'i mtshan gsol ba: ma rung dam sri'i skabs blta has grib g.yo:rang gi stobs kyis de dag tshar bcad na: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin rigs mchog dam pa'o:sdebs sbyor bsgrigs mkhas ldan ma rtse mang yangs: thugs bskyed dag pa'i bstan pa'i zhabs tog sgrubs: blo rno bya btang dang ba 'dren pa'i mi: dharmā ku 2chud chos kyi gnyer 'dzin no:da lta grub pa'i mnga' bdag dbang gi bab: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs mi yi rje bo mchog:ma rung rkyen bzlog bstan

gas/: la lhag par gdung: zab gter gnyer skyongs pa 3 shaṃ ming can rna: las smon mthu btsan rgyal ba byang chub kyang: mdo sngags bstan pa rin chen dam pa'i bcud: re skyongs re bkur mang du song ba'i rjes: sngags spyod dpa' bo ku 4mud mtshan 'chang ba: bka' 'di'i gnyer skyongs bstan pa'i sgron me sbar:cog ro klu rgyal gsang gsum rdzogs pa'i gar: mchog gi me tog bzang po'i lo 'bras can:bstan 'di'i bka' bab ka 5ma la zhes grags: bsnyen sgrubs gnad smin 'di phyir phan bde 'char: gnyag rigs rin chen bzang po rims brgyud nas rong sngags yul du brtul zhugs bya btang ba: buddha 6me tri bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ste: 'phral snang jag pas ma bslus ngo mtshar gnas: ngan lam rong rgyal byang chub sems thob pa: mos gus dpal thob yon tan 'dzin mdzad gar: a chen gtsug phud ku mud 7dpal gyis 'khyud: skyes mchog de yang bstan 'dis gnyer 'dzin no: rdo rje spre'u chung skye rtags gar ngoms pa: 'dzi rongs phyogs nas shrī phar 8

lar 'bod bar chad bdud kyi rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na: bstan pa 'di la zhabs tog bya ba byed: sba mi khri gzher sprul pa stag lo pa: rgya min rgya yi sde nas birya'i9ming skyes bu de yang sel gyis ma bslad na: dben pa'i gnas su bstan 'di'i bsgrub rgyun badzin: rong sngags yon tan mtshan can dad dam gtsang:ngang pa'i rgyud nas purje'i 10ming can 'byung rtog ge'i sgro btags dri mas ma bslus na: rang byung ye shes zhal mthong gdeng thob 'gyur:'o bran sprul pa las 'phro bzang po can:dge yi phyogs nas 11grags pa'i ming can 'byung: gnyis 'dzin bse rag 'gong pos ma bslus na: bar do tha mar zangs mdog dpal rir 'gro: gnub kyi rigs 'chang gzhon nu'i gar bsgyur ba: sngags kyi bden mthong sa 12ra dza zhes grags: mdzad phrin 'od brgyas gdul bya'i yul rnams skyongs:bstan pa 'di la zhabs tog bshad sgrub mdzad:gnyag rigs dam pa'i zla gzhon snang ba'i gzugs: chos kyi sbyan ldan blo 13bzang ming can 'byung: rā dza dam sris sku la ma rgol na:sgrub pa mthar

ga64 phyin grub 'bras mngon du 'gyur: ngan lam ban btsun byang chub sems dpa'i tshul: thugs bskyed dag pa rig 'jin 14rgya mamor grags: sbas don gnyug ma'i ye shes mngon gyur cing: gzhan don 'byung zhing nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: gan cag thang ta'i brtse zhal 'dzum g.yos pa: rigs kyi gar 'dzin snying 15po'i ming can 'byung: g.yeng bas ma bslus bskyed rdzogs zam btsug na: sa thob yon tan ldan zhing 'brel tshad 'dren: kong spyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor shrī'i mtshan: rim brgyud dbang chen phyogs nas nor 16bu'i ming log rtog gzhan rje'i tshig gis ma bslus na: bstan pa 'dir 'phrad don gnyis ngang gis 'byung:lang gro lo tsa thugs bskyed dag pa'i mthus 17sna tshogs mtshan 'chang gzhon nu 'brug la zhon: bstan pa 'di la zhabs tog byed bzhin du: chos nyid bden mthong rtogs pa'i rtsal chen rgyas dzña na ku ma'i 'dzum gyi ge sar las: rig pa 'dzin pa dhwa dza'i 18mtshan can 'byung: dam chos 'dir 'phrad bar chad rkyen las grol: nyams

rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar 'phel padma'i zhal mjal chos kyi spyan ldan pa: go cha'i mtshan 'chang 'dzum pa'i ge sar ni: dbang chen rgyud nas tshul 19khrims ming can 'byung: bstan pa 'dir 'phrad sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas: byang chub sems dpa' zla gzhon sprul pa ni: blo gros spyan ldan 'jam 20dpal ming can 'byung 'chad dang rtsom pas bstan la bya ba byed: thugs bskyed dag pas 'gro don rgya cher 'byung: dran pa nam mkha'i mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa nas brtse ba'i mthu ldan me tri'i 21mtshan can 'byung rgyal tshab skyes bu'i bka' bzhin zhabs pad bsten: bstan pa'i sgron me gdul bya'i zhing la spel: g.yu sgra'i gzigs pa gdul bya'i dpal ngoms pa: zla rgyud phyogs su nges don nirma 22ka: chos 'di nyams blangs dam sri'i g.yul las rgyal: sku tshe mdzad phrin yar ngo'i zla star 'phel: lha dpal sprul pa thos bsam nor ldan pa: rma yul sku skyes garma'i 23ming can 'byung: sgrub brgyud bstan pa ri sul 'dzin nus na: chos nyid 'od gsal rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'char:

gas/ 'brog mi dpal ye sprul pa rgya rong nas: rnal 'byor 'chol po rtogs 24ldan mtshan can 'byung: ma rgyud rlung gi rnal 'byor la brten na: rtsa yi mdud grol phyag rgya'i nye lam mthong: nyang ban sprul pa rlung sems dbang thob pa: smra yul bstan pa'i gzhi 'dzin 25dharma'i mtshan: gdams pa 'di 'phrad bstan dgon phan bde 'bar: 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod: smon lam dbang gis dus dang dus su 'phrad: rang skal sprod la bshad sgrub bstan pa gtod:nam zlas bskul ba'i rtsi thog 'bus pa bzhin: las 'phro nga yi gter gyi mdzad phrin rgyas: gtad rgya:gter slob dag pa'i yon tan can: chos 'di'i byed por phrin las phun sum tshogs: zab gsang rdor snying 'di nyid bzhugs pa'i gnas: rig 'dzin gong ma'i byin gyis rlabs mdzad cing: sa/ rgyan chen po'i zhabs bcag sgrub pa mdzad: nyams dga' dwangs spro skyo ba med pa yi: dbus phyogs rdo rje'i rdzongs dang shar 'khor lo: lho ru rin chen nub ngos padma'i rdzongs: byang phyogs las rab

rigs dang rnam pa lnga: mtha' ma rdzongs chen bco brgyad kyis bskor zhing: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ḍākki lngas: 'du ba nye 'du mdzad pa'i bla mtsho lnga'i ser mo don grub nor rgyun bzhugs pa'i dal: rgyas pa'i mtsho la zab gter sbas rgyas btab: smon lam las 'phro dag pa'i rgyal tshabs las: gang yang rung bas rnyed par ga la 'gyur tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzom pa'i zhing bzang la: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: bka' gtad phyag rgyas btab pa'i gter srung ma:sngags bdag klu mo yakka nag mo dang: bdud kyi spu gri thod pa'i phreng ba can: btsan gyi spu gri me rlung zhags pa spro: klu yi spu gri dug gi rlang pa khol: rang rang sprul pa g.yog dang bcas pa ni: phyi yi gter srung dam tshig 'dzin mdzad yin: rdzogs chen bka' yi pho nya dma' ru rtse bde bas rgyas 'deb gsod byed dmar mo yum:stong par dbang bsgyur bdud mo snying 'byin ma: zab gter so srung dkor bdag ngan nee mo: dga' bzhi'i drod bskyed dam 'dzin kha mo che: sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha'

gas/: 'gro'i tshogs bcas te: bstan pa'i srung ma rnams la gnyer byang gtad: gtad rgya dam tshig 'dzin pa'i pho nya yin: bka' gtad ji bzhin legs nyes shan 'byed cing: sgrub brgyud bstan ba yar ngos zla ltar spel: 'gro don phrin las rgyas pa'i grogs byed 'gyur: chos kyi mdzod 'dzin las kyi phyag rgya ni:ye shes gsang sgo shes rab ḍākkis 'byed: dag snang 'phrul mdzod rig stong ḍākkis gsal: sa gter sbas rgya dam tshig mkha' 'gros grol: phun sum tshogs pa mkha' 'gro'i rigs la lnga:mi ma yin pa dregs pa'i bu mo lnga: las kyi phyag rgya rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang ma: bde sbyin ri mo can ni las kyi rigs: gsang chen 'di yi thabs kyi lde'u mig ste: ngang byung dpal gyi thugs son sa le sman: gsang rgya ratna'i ming can dam tshig dag: smon lam dbang gis phun sum tshogs par 'gyur:'gro don phrin las yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: phan bdes phyogs kun khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod: e ma ho: ya mtshan du mas brgyan pa'i rje 'bangs tshogs:

snyigs ma'i sems can las kyi mnar ba la: bde sdug 'jam rtsub ma nges du mar g.yo: zhe sdang a 'thas rgyal pos rgol ba 'byung: sku yi 'bangs 'khor nye ba rtsa lag mnar: 'dod chags a 'thas shi gson bse mo 'khrugs: gso ru mi btub nad yams sna dgu 'tshubs: gti mug rang bzhin sa bdag klu gnyan 'khrug btsa' sad ser gsum mu ges rgud pa 'byung: de yi rgud gsotsan rgyan rgyal tshabs kyis: dregs pa dam log rtogs pa'i ngar gdeng bskyed: dam sri ar gtad dgongs pa'i phyag rgyas btab: gzhan phan thugs rjes btsa' sad ser gsum srungs: dug gsum gdon la sgyu 'phrul tshabs ma gtong: 'khrul ba sbubs bshigs sangs rgyas bstan la 'god: 'dre brdung gtum rngam ma yin sa ma yā: sngags pa mthu med grong mtha'i khyi dang 'dra: sus brdung 'dis brdung med pas tshugs mi thub:sku dgra yan par btang na dam log yin: mthu med snying rje'i ngo srung yi mug gnas: dgra yi kha log bgegs kyi za kha zug: thol byung spyo spyod drag las mtshon las

btsan gtugs: gar song cha med nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor byung rgyal rjen pas 'khrul ba ru bzlog byed bde skyid nyi gzhon mtha' dbus kun tu brdal: 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs: yang cig gson dang rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshogs: smon lam log pa'i ho ban kong khran 'khrug: snga dar me byis 'dzam gling zhon tshe rgol: phyi 'byung stag dang yos bu 'brug gsum la: de yi bstan pa rab tu dar bar gnas: rong 'brog kun gyi mgo la dar phru 'dzug:mgul la mu tig sngon po'i ske rgyan 'dogs: sems la sbos rgya'i ri mo nyis rim bri dkar po'i sma phab nag po gzing bstod byed: bde ba'i ngar 'don sdig gis khra bor 'phrul: sbrul rta lug la de yi rtags tsam 'dzin: cha shas kyis ni rtsod cing dmag las byed: mnga' ri dbu gtsang mdo khams has grib g.ya' rim gyis 'og nas 'og tu sa la thim: sprel gyi mnga' 'og de yi ngad pa tsam: chen po nyid ni chen po'i sbubs su nub: dkar dang dmar ba mdog gi bye brag can: ru gnyis

thabs kyi zhags pas re 'ga' 'ching: 'khrug dang rtsod pa ya ma bla ru 'byung: kun la phan thabs srung ba rdzongs dgu dang: gso ba lnga dang sbas pa bcu drug gis: re zhig bstan 'gro'i rgud pa skyob par 'gyur: e rna: 'brong nag ngar mas 'brong la tab sha rtsod: stag mo'i 'dzum la dred pos co 'dri g.yo: khra glag spyang gus za kha 'thung kha rtsod: de tshe dbang phyug chen po'i mtshon rdul sprugs: gzhom med rdo rjes sri tshogs 'dul las 'bad: 'jigs med rdzing bur zhugs na zhi bsil 'khrungs:btsan gyi me zhags dmar pos nyes kun 'dul: bde ba'i go skabs sprin bar nyi gzhon bkra: e rna: shar phyogs dung rdzongs 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas: gser gzhong rin chen bdun gyis gtams pa'i tshal: lha g.yang rgyal gsum ldan pa'i dge bsnyen gsum: gnam ri dkar po'i steng nas zla ba tshes: don yod dung gi zhags pa'i brda thabs kyis: gser gyi ri nas rgyal mtshan lnga pa can: ldang khug gsum bcas g.yu 'brug yang yang bskul: 'tshubs ma lnga yis gzing pa phyogs su 'thor:

gas/: 'gro don phrin las dga' ba'i 'dzum bzang ngoms: sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i ri mo gsal bar byed: rten 'brel dus tshigs ma g.yel skal pa can:che ba bdun gyis spros pa'i ke ta ga: 'jigs pa'i dgra bdud 'joms pa'i tho lum mo: bskul byang dril yig gser gyi ga'ur chug: mi 'gyur rin chen rgyas thob dam tshig can: e ma he: rtsa gsum kun dngos sa/ rgyan thod phreng rtsal: rtag tu spyi bor bkur ba snying gtam yin: ma rig gnyis 'dzin sems kyi sgong rgya bkrol:rig pa'i nyi ma sbar dgos snying gtam yin: rlung sems bde sdug srid pa'i drwa ba kun: zang thal bar med gtong dgos snying gtam yin: chos dbyings mkha' la 'od gsal sgron me 'bar: mnyam rjes dbyer med bsre dgos snying gtam yin:phu nu nye ba kun gyis dgra zla byed:skyes rabs rnam thar dran dgos snying gtam yin: ye shes bde ba las kyi phyag rgyas sbyin: dam nyams yongs la 'dzem dgos snying gtam yin: blo gtad khel ba su yang 'byung min pas: sgrub tshugs ri la 'dzin dgos

snying gtam yin: chos rgyud mi zin rlung kha'i mar me 'dra: yongs la man ngag ma spel snying gtam yin: bzo ma tshar la gzhan gyi lag 'grim na dngos grub yal bar dor 'gro snying gtam yin: sngon bsags bsod nams 'bras bu smin dus 'dir: skyed spel bsogs 'jog ma byed snying gtam yin: zab gter dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu 'dra: bsdam spel thabs la mkhas dgos snying gtam yin: dam sri gdong dmar sha rul 'bu zhugs 'dra: chags sred mdud pa bkrol dgos snying gtams yin:chos brgyad zin med spos rgya'i ri mo 'dra: byung rgyal thug 'phrad rjes med snying gtam yin: gser gyikhyel seng stag hab sha rtsod: gang byung des chog bde'o snying gtam yin: rma bya'i gdugs 'og nyi zla go las bskul: chu sbrul dug la 'dzem dgos snying gtam yin: rma bya'i zlos gar dung ri'i tse nas bsgyur: g.yu 'brug 'dzum gyis 'khrul 'gro snying gtam yin: gser gzhir rin chen bdun gyi maṇḍal khod: mda' mo brag la 'jug dgos snying gtam yin: lce spyang ha las rang sha rang gis

btsa/ za: sman gyis gso ru mi btub snying gtam yin: lcags kyi rdo rje 'ja' lnga'i 'od thags can: nam phug rgyang thag mi ring snying gtam yin:gser zhal drug cu rtsa gcig ba gam brtsegs: mkha' 'dza'i gling dbus 'khyil 'gro snying gtam yin: mkha' 'gro'i brda gsal shel gyi me long 'di: nyi zla'i ga'ur chug la brtags dpyad kyis: e ma ho: rgyal ba kun dngosashes rgyan thod phreng rtsal: rtsa gsum gcig bsdus phrin las ngo bo nyid: gu ru nga sgom nga sgrub gsol ba thob bod 'bangs baspu ba med do dam tshig yin: nad mug mtshon 'khrug dus kyi yo langs dang: sde brgyad lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rgol ngan dang: sha za ro langs dam sris 'tshe ba na: nga la gsol ba thob dngabaslu ba med: ting 'dzin sgom la bying rgod rkyen gyis gzir: rnam rtog kha yan chos nyid rang sa shor: dug lnga thugs 'phrad lam khyer mi 'byung dus: o rgyan nga nyid sgom dang ngang gis grol: sa gter sbas rgya dus su mi grol dang: brda sgrom sgo rgya 'byed la bul ba dang:shog ser ring

bsrel rjes dran mi gsal ba: nga nyid tshogs kyis mchod dang gsal bar nges: lus rgya ma grol sha za'i dam grib dang: rlung sems ma dag slob bu'i nyams grib dang:lta dgongs ma dag mtshan ma'i bag chags kun: nga sgom 'gyod tshangs bshags pas sgrib kun sel: lta ba dman pas gzhan rgyud bogs ma thon: spyod pa tho cos sngags la the tshom bsgong: sgom yun thung bas rang gzhan rgyud ma grol: nga sgom bsnyen sgrub kyis dang bogs 'don 'gyur: mi med lung stong mnyam bzhag blta stangs kyis: o rgyan nga sgom gsol ba lhang lhang thob: gdung shugs drag pos mchi ma rdol rdol thongs: snyigs ma'i bod 'bangs skyob po skal pa can: snang ba dag dang ma dag sgyu lus sbyangs rmi lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'od gsal bsre: 'chi kha thim rim bla ma'i gsang gsum dang: dbyer med bsres pas sku gsum grol sa zin:chos nyid thim tshul 'od gsal rang ngo shes: khyad par bla ma rjes su dran pa'i mod: gsang sngags gnas mchog zangs mdog dpal gyi rir: o rgyan nga dang 'du

gtsa(7 'bral spu tsam med: zhes gsungs rje 'bangs 'khor bcas tshim par gyur: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: brda byang mkha' 'dza'i gsang tshig yid bzhin nor bu rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu hya: snyed rgyan gyi sgob dpon padma sam bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: ༷sa: zhes pa'ang lung zen dharma kairtes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo sbas ba'i rnal 'byoranus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma kirtis bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig: sarba maṅga lam:
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung dmar po lha lnga'i phrin las rno ba'i mdeludagra bgegs brlag byed dug khrag khol ma bzhugs so:

gas/rnya na re gu ru padma ka ra ye za1byuskoro/glurtedag41ni padmalirang lugasangago rnams kyis las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: rgyan drug sngags kyi lta dgongs 'dzan srid du ling ga 'chang bar byed ngan sngags reg phung chos skyongs sgrubs 'bod rbad bsad pa'i dam tshig 'dzin: zhing bcu tshang rnams thabs kyis skyongs sngags kyi dam tshig rnam dag ba'i sgrol ba'i las kyis grol bar byed sa ma yā 'disalas la rnam pa bcu dang po rlung rta kha sbub ni dgra bo'i ming rus mkhan gsum dang zag rdzas lnga sbya liṅgar bkod: re 'byams thur rgyugs sna 'og nas: chos skyong gsol zhing bsang chen bkyag za ngu drag bskang dmod mo gyer: lcags zangs phye dang yungs dkar nag: ram bu phung sa gri rdo dang: rab chad khang dreg rbab rdo dang mchod rten zhig po'i sa bye rnams:thun rdzas bsags la liṅgar brab dmad byang gas pa bskul 'a༄ ltar bya: kyi gson cig dgongs sheg gnod sbyin dma' ru tse: ngas ni tshe gcig khyod sgrub bskang gsol byas: dam nyams dgra 'dis mi 'dod sna dgu brtsams: gdung tshig spre sngags 'o dod ma legs kyang: bka' chad gdug rtsub rno myur ces ma byung: grogs khyod med dam da ni las la rgyug:dkar nag

badzra bden rdzun yo drang shan phyes la: nyes pa can de'i bsod nams thur la sbub: klung rta kha sbub dbang thang mar me sod: gdong nas 'od 'phrog ltag pa'i bdud dang sprod: mchan gyi bu sod lag dmar dgra lag chug: nyes pa dran chug spyo tshig kha ru 'don: ma mo gardzu da byed dmar mo las la rgyugs: dgra bo mo rnams spyo zhing 'gag grir chug: bdud mo snying 'byen nag mo las la rgyugs: dgra bo'i bu dang bu mor keg gzer phob: hur thum rgyugs 'gyel khrag skyugs kha sbubs sod: zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo las la sbran: dgra bo'i mi bsad nor brlag dkor rnams stong: ming gi lhag mar byed pa'i dus la babs: sha za kha mo che yis mthu rtsal phyungs: dgra sde phung thal 'jag mas bshug glu len: mthu yi grags snyan nam mkha'i pha mthar sgogs: sngags pa rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags rnga chen sbir:mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i 17gas mdzod cig: dgra bo'i slung rta kha sbubs mthu rtsal phyungs:ma ra ya: tshal pa tshal pa:shaka pa shaka pa:snying khrag sa dang bsres:zhes

pa'i bskul byang kha sbub 'di: dgra la rbad pas thog dang 'dra: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa srung ma dbye ba ni: bsang bkyags dmar gtor skyems phud bshams: dgra bo'i lha srung 'gugs bstim ni na 53 dasko/na mabyedag gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: bden gnyis bslu med bden mthu yis: dgra bo'i skyob byed lha srung kun: bsang mchod gtor skyems mgron du khug: 'o ka pa la a garsha ya dza dza: brgya rtsa brjod: kyi: stong pa nam mkhar dbang byed cing: snang zhing srid par mnga' mdzad pa'i: dregs pa sde bcu'i char gshogs shing: dgra bo 'di yi skyobs byed rnams: padma'i brgyud 'dzin bdag nyid kyis: bka' dang dam tshig bsgrags la gson: ma nyes rang khar 'dug bzhin du: dam chos sgrub pa 'di yis bcag: thar ba'i sa bon 'di yis skems: 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'di yis bcom: bla ma'i sku la 'di yis bsdos: dge 'dun dkor la 'di yis 'bag:gsang ba sngags kyi 'du sgo bkag: thar med dmyal ba'i rnam smin bsags: de phyir bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang: 'di la mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: ye shes lha

gas/ tsu ni thugs dam nyams: 'jig rten dregs pa mnar bar byed: de bas dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gtor bsang mchod bzhes:dgra bo rang gshed sgog bdud thongs: dgra bo'i nus mthu phyir la bzlog: dgra bo ming med brlag nus mdzod: bcol ba'i las te ma byas na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' chad 'byung: khyod nyams brlag par gdon mi za: tha tshig mchog la gnas mdzod cig: grangs bsogs dgra bo'i lha srung rnams glud gos phud bzhin dbye bar 'gyur:sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsum pa 'bod bskul bya ba ni gtor skyems 'gugs gzhug sbyang sgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te: hūṃ ktaḥ he chen dha nas dur khrod nas: padma dbang gi bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin shan pa dme ru rtse: dam tshig gnyan gyis 'bod do bskul: mi srun khros pa'i gad rgyang can: dgra bo'i sgog snying lag na gnas: ma mo gsod byed gtum rngams sku: dam tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do bskul: gnas yul dur khrod zogs med rgyu: zhing bcu sgrol la

hab sha rtsod: bdud kyi bu mo snying 'byin ma: sngon gyi dam bsgrags 'bod cing bskum: zhing dang gtsug lag kun la rgyu: rnal 'byor dkor la mig ser can:nor srung lha mo ngan nee ma: 'bod pa'i tha tshig bsgrags bzhin bskul: snga 'gyur bstan la lhag par gdung: gsang sngags rnal 'dredar 17gas su nyul: dgra sha bza' ba'i kha mo che g.yar dam ji bzhin 'bod do bskul: shar phyogs stag 'du'i lha khang nas: dri za'i rgyal po 'bod cing bskul: lto phyogs khyung tshangs brag nag nas: gshin rje'i rgyal po 'bod cing bskul: nub phyogs 'ur chem brag dmar nas: ma mo rma bya'i gdong can 'bod: byang phyogs rngam brjed rdza brag nas:gnod sbyin 'brong gdong 'bod cing bskul: shar lho 'bar 'khrugs dur khrod nas: grul bum nee tso'i gdong can 'bod: lho nub rakka srin gling nas: dom gyi gdong can 'bod cing bskul: nub byang dur khrod rlung 'tshubs nas: shang shang gdong can 'bod cing bskul: byang shar rol ba'i mtsho gting nas: gser mig gdong

gas/— can 'bod cing bskul: phyogs bzhi 'tshams brgyad dgra dpung thul: gnod byed ming med phrin las mdzod: dkar po lha yi sde dpon pa:tshangs pa chen po 'bod cing bskul: 'byung po yi dwags sde dpon ni: las gshin nag po 'bod cing bskul: sha za ma mo kun gyi rje: gnam sman chen mo 'bod cing bskul: drag rtsal gnod sbyin yongs kyi rje: ka la yakka 'bod cing bskul: drag rtsal can gyi sde dpon pa: yam shud dmar po 'bod cing bskul: srog la dbang za kun gyi gtso: dgra bla pe har 'bod cing bskul: mi srun drag khro'i bdud kyi rgyal skos rje drang dkar 'bod cing bskul: klu gnyan gtod gyi sde dpon pa: gdol ba mgo dgu 'bod cing bskul: sngon gyi dam tshig dran gyis la:zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byin: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir:'bod pa'i dam tshig dus la babs: ma g.yel ma 'gyangs sa ma yā: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas:padma dbang gi bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs thams cad bya rgod

sha la rub pa ltar: bdag he ru ga'i mdun du 'aX da cing mngon spyod kyi las sgrub par bsam la: 'bod sngags chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla: rtags mtshan dus las mi g.yel gsal: sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya bzhi pa dregs bskang bya ba ni sha khrag gtor skyems 'gugs bstim spel: lhar gsal ting 'dzin gdeng ldan pas: kta: gnod sbyin mi srun drag po rtsal: shan pa chen po dam la dgongs:bka' 'khor pho nya da tshur 'dus: dgra bo'i sha ni zan ba'i zhim: gti mug mchod pas thugs dam bskang: dgra bo'i khrag ni chang ba'i zhim: 'dod chags mchod pas thugs dam bskang: dgra bo'i rus pa mar ba'i sla: zhe sdang mchod pas thugs dam bskang: dgra bo'i don chen rnam pa lnga: nga rgyal mchod pas thugs dam bskang: dgra bo'i snod drug khu rdul bcas: phrag dog mchod pas thugs dam bskang: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba bskyed: sems can yongs la phan bde spel:sgrub mchog rnal 'byor mgon grogs mdzod: mthu yi grags snyan phyogs bcur sgrogs: dgra bo brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: ces brjod

ba/〈( gtor skyems bsang nang 'bul: thabs des mngon spyod lhun gyis grub: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa rbad bskul bya ba ni: sha khrag gtor mar 'gugs gzhug bya: dgra sha khrag gi rgya mtshor dmigs: khro rngam sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad rol mo'i sgra sbir 'di skad gyer kta: shan pa dmar nag dam la dgongs: dgra sha khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag po'i las la bskul:yid la brnags pa'i dgra la rbad: gsod byed dmar mo dam la dgongs: dgra bo'i sha la dgyes par rol: myur mgyogs 'gugs pa'i las la bskul: snga dgra bsdo ba'i gshed du rbad: snying 'byin nag mo dam la dgongs: dgra bo'i khrag la hub kyis rol: 'chor med bcing ba'i las la bskul: da dgra thad langs gshed du rbad: dur khrod lha thodam la dgongs: dgra bo'i tsitta krum krum rol: 'gul med sdom pa'i las la bskul: phyi dgra yid shom gshed du rbad: sha za chen mo dam la dgongs: dgra po'i dbugs la rngubs shing rol: dran med spyo 'bogs las la bskul: zhing bcu tshang ba'i gshed du rbad: las mkhan mched

brgyad dam la dgongs: dgra bo'i tshogs yul rngams zas kyis: 'chor med las kyi shan par bskul: sbyor sgrol drag po'i las la rbad: lha sreg ldobargyad dam la dgongs: dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched rol: gsod gcod phung thal las la bskul: ming med brlag pa'i gshed mar rbad: snang sred lha srin dam la dgongs: dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus rkang rus rol: nyes can gshed du dmag la bskul: sdang dgra shul med brlag phyir rbad: rgyugs chang khrag skyems gtor ma bzhes:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: thog ser hur thum rgyugs 'gyel sod: dgra sde stong ba'i phrin las mdzod: dus la bab so sa ma ya: zhes bka' sdod dregs palidamag tshogs drag tu bskul tshe: nam mkha' la na bun sngo dmar 'khrigs: bar snang la thog 'brug glog ser khol: sa gzhi la ltas ngan nad mtshon gyi char chen po 'beb par bsam la: rbad sngags thub chod mtshon rtse ltar bzla: rbad pa'i mtshan rtags dus su 'byung dgra la rno nus thog ltar myur sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: drug pa za ngu'i gnyer bcol ni: sha khrag gtor ma ja chang

gtsa/ skyems: bshams la 'gugs bstim byin rlabs bya: srung ma mngon sum gsal btab ste: kṣa gson cig dgongs shig gnod sbyin dma' ru rtse: ngas ni sdang dgras rgol sbyor ma bzod de: mthu gtad tom zor dmod mnan byas nas slar: gnod sbyor la 'jigs mkhon pa bsdum nas su: zhu bshags mjal gsum dkor nor blangs na yang:dgra bo ma zad bar du za ngu gyis: mi phyugs dkor la rngams pa'i za ngu gyis: mtha' rtsa skye rgyud brlag pa'i za ngu gyis: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i za ngu gyis:mthu stobs thog 'dra'i nus mthu da phyung la: dgra sde me chu 'phrad pa'i dpe ltar gyis: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: grangs bsogs snying nye phrin las myur 'khu ldog gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya bdun pa bsad pa'i bskul ba ni: khrag sol byug pa'i gtor ma dang khrag skyems chang phud bsham pa la: dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim nan du bya: sha ra khrag gi rgya mtshor dmigs ( kta dur khrod he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog nas: shan pa dmar nag mi srun drag po rtsal: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad

rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: dbang gi 'od khyem g.yo ba'i 1nga dkyil nas: ma mo gsod byed chen mo dam tshig can: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: sgog gcod bdud mo snying 'byin mthu rtsal can: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: dur khrod ging rus gram bsnyil 'jigs rngams nas: dkor srung dur khrod lha mo ngan nee ma: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: dur khrod gtsug lag gnas yul kun srung ba'i: dam 'dzin ma mo sha za kha mo che: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: gar bzhugs gsang ba'i gnas mchog so so nas: las mkhan sprul pa'i 'khor brgyad mthu rtsal can: do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i

ba tshu phrin las mdzod:lha gshin ma bdud srin btsan srog klu gnyan: dbang sgyur bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad po:do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs:bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhir rten bcas pa'i: snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin dregs pa'i dmags:do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra la rgyugs: bsad rtags mngon sum 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod: dgra bo'i pho rgyud thog gis phog bzhin sod: mo rgyud lcugs phran zor bas brngas bzhin thongs: chung gsum me tog sad kyis khyer ltar gyis:dkor nor na bun rlung gis gtor ltar mdzod: mngon spyod mdzad pa'i dpa' skyems gtor ma bzhes:las pa las la ma g.yel mthu rtsal phyungs: gsod gcod mtshon cha spu gri ngar ma zhan: las byed shan pa pho mo lag ma sdum: 'byin pa'i so dang sen mo rno ma rdul:gtum rngam gdug pa'i yus ro rgya ma chung: bza' shugs 'thung ba'i lto ba khung ma dog: stong gsum dgra sde shul med brlag par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa

ma yā: gtor skyems sdang ba'i dgra phyogs rdeb: sgra bsigs dmod bor smre sngags 'don: bka' sdod rdo rje'i pho nya rnams sngon gyi bka' tha tshig gnyan po dran nas:ki bsā cha sgra dang bcas te dgra rnge rdul du brlag pa'i las la chas par bsam la: bsad sngags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor nas bzla'o: dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jig nus mthu gnam lcag thog dang 'dra: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: brgyad pa 'khrugs bskang gsol ba ni: mchod rdzas yo byad rgya cher bsags sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis srung ma mngon sum gsal byas te: rdo/:he chen dha na'i dur khrod nas: gnod sbyin shan dmar mthu rtsal can: mi srun sha za chen mo bzhi: bka' 'khor shan pa lha srin brgyad: snang zhing srid pa'i dregs tshogs bcas: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes bzhin: gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: 'khu ldog gdug rtsub zhi ba'i phyir: lta ba nor na dbyings su bshags: sgom pa nyams na rig pas bskangs: spyod pa 'chol na tshogs kyis gso: sku gsung thugs yon dgyes bskang nas: nyams chags nongs pa sor chud

btsa(4 de: bu sdug bzhin du brtse bas skyongs: ma g.yel ma 'gyangs grogs mdzod cig: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: grangs bsogs las myur phrin las sgrub lus dang grib bzhin snying nye 'gyur: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: dgu pa gser skyems 'bul ba ni: shel tshig gtor ma sbyangs bsgyur spel: rang nyid lha gsal ting 'dzin gyis: mdun du srung ma gsal byas te: re yo dza: ma ā:sa kyi: dbang chen padma gsung gi bka' sdod pa: gnod sbyin shan dmar mi srun drag po rtsal: rgyugs chang gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod brtsam pa'i grogs mdzod cig dam tshig rjes nyul brin las glog 'khyugs pa'i: mi srun sha za chen mo mched bzhi yis: rgyugs chang gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod brtsal pa'i grogs mdzod cig: legs nyes shan 'byed sdong srog 'dzin mdzad pa'i: las mkhan sprul pa'i 'khor brgyad g.yog dang bcas: rgyugs chang gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod brtsam pa'i grogs mdzod cig: gsod gcod las kyi mtshon cha

phyag na bsnams: shan pa lha srin sde brgyad g.yog dang bcas: rgyugs chang gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod brtsam pa'i grogs mdzod cig:snang zhing srid pa'i khams la dbang mdzad pa'i: dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs kyis: rgyugs chang gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod brtsam pa'i grogs mdzod cig: bdag la rgol zhing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: ri rab gling bzhi bsrung ba'i gur khang sogs: gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par khug: ldog 'byams logs pa'i lam du ma regar bar: bsad gcod bsre 'pho mdzad pa'i dus la babs: ma g.yel ma bul bka' sdod dam tshig can:gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams dza/ba mdzod cig: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: skyems gtor mchod cing phrin las bcol mngon spyod lhun gyis grub par 'gyur: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya:bcu pa gnad byang bstan pa ni: dang po zhi sgrubabyed pa'i dus: tshogs gtor mchod pa'i rdzas kyis bskangs: grib la 'dzem zhing 'khrug rtsod bsrungs byi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdam: smra bcad mi tshig mi bsre bar:

—4(rnya bzlas pa bye ba gsol mchod 'bum rtags ni dbang gi 'od khyim g.yo: bde ba 'bar zhing me drod mched nor 'du khrom 'tshogs mkha' la 'phur: spos dri 'thul zhing shes nyams gsal: de ni bsnyen pa'i rtag mtshan no: g.yel na gnad dbab 'khrugs bskang gtong: 'khu zhing ldog na shi sa ston: snying nye'i rtags byung bzhugs gsol gdab sha bsgos chang 'gyed ston mo byed rgya tor ban bon a tsa ra:'du 'tshogs khrom la mnga' dbang byed: thams cad mngag pa'i las byed pa: de ni 'bod pa'i rtag mtshan no ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya: gcan gzan mi rgod sna tshogs pa: bkol zhing zhon nas 'gro ba dang:yul mang kha lo bsgyur ba ni: rbad pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung ba'o: dgra bsad sha brdung rus pa 'thag: lngags mnyed dri 'thul 'byung ba na: bsad pa'i rtags tshad theb pa'o: gcer bur phyung zhing byang thang lus: rta 'drogs chas drud me rlung 'tshubs: de ni 'khu ldog 'khrugs pa'i rtags: 'od dmar mkha' la yal ba dang: nang nor gzhan gyis hab sha rtsod: mi 'dod gyong god zhal lce mang: de ni chos skyong 'khru ba'i rtags 'khu na ye shes lha yis gzir ldog na dam tshag phyag rgyas bcing 'da' na tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags g.yel na las kyi phyag rgyas bcing thabs la mkhas na lus grib bzhin mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs par
