'gyur: bka' bsgo dam tshig thogs med sgrubs: the tshom med do sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya: yem rgyal ba kun dngos padma thod phreng ngali ma 'ongs gdul byar brtse ba'i thugs rje yis: thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor: grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad: da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdom ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:las can rig 'dzin nga sprul bu dang 'phrad 'gro don phrin las byang nas byang du rgyas: 'brel chad don ldan rig 'dzin sa la 'god bstan dgra 'dul ba'i tho lum mtshon chen 'di: thub par srung cig dmar po lha lnga po: dam nyams lag tu ma regar skru gri gsum skal bzang rig 'dzin pad tshal bzhad gyur cig: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya phrin las rno ba'i mde'u dgra bgegs brlag byed rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya: gu hya o rgyan gyislob dpon padma sambha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chos nyid grags pas bkra shis lha reg thabs shes mtshon pa'i skyes dang sgrub pa lhur len gyi dam ma 'a dang bcas te nan tan chen po'i bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo sbasapa'irnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro 'phrul gyi brda ris las phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma gīrtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung dmar po lha lnga'i drag po'i mthu sgrub:man ngag don 'dus reg phyung nag po bzhugs so:

btsa/ na mo padma kro dha he ru ka la ya: 243kho rgyal bstan 'dzen palirsā bu la bar chad bdud dgras rgol gyur na bstan srung drag sgrub las kyi mtha' ngan sngags reg phung 'di la brtson: sa ma yā: dkyil 'khore 4'a thabs zhal shes ltar: dgra gzugs liṅga zag rdzas bcas:thun mtshon rdzas sogs gzhung ltar sgrubs chos skyong bsnyen sgrub sngon song bas mngon spyod las 'di rnam par khrug: sa ma yā 'di la las rim bcu gcig las:dang po drag po'i bskyed dmigs ni:sa su bha wa shuddha sarba dharma sā bha wa shuzlo3nya: stonge palingang las rang nyid padma dbang chen du gsal ba'i mdun sa gzhi las cung zad dpag pa'i mkhar: dur khrod me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus suganod spyin shan pa dmar nag khro gtum drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa:phyag bzhis ral gri dang snying zhags gri thod 'dzin zhing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing: rab 'bar me rlung rsābs ma'i dbus su rngams pa'i khyung dmar la bcibs pa:deli'og tu gru gsum las kyi bsha' gzhi dug lnga rang gshed du 'bebs pa'i btson khang nag po kha dog la mthil yangs pa: shin tu skyi g.ya' zhing ya nga ba'i nang du:gi

gas/ las yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo gang yin pa de'i rū pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa: skya ba ham pa rid pa rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb cing nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed pa gcig tu gyur: de'i snying ga'i dzre yig las 'od nag po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can spros te stong gsum gang na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par 'ub kyis rngub cing dril nas ling ga la sib sib thim par gyur: slang yang bdag mdun gyi sku'i cha thams cad nas spros pa'i pho nya lcags zhags sgrog dril thogs pa grangs med pas: thad du langs pa'i dgra bo de'i bu pho rgyud bu mo mo rgyud nye 'khor rtsa lag dang bcas pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs rten liṅga la yang yang bstim mo: gnyis pa pho nya spro ba ni: dza dza: stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: snying rje'i rang gzugs pho nya mo: lcags kyu dkar mo grangs med pas: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: bla sgog rnam par shes pa ni: las kyi liṅga 'di nyid la: khug cig badzra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ tsū sa skye med chos

kyi dbyings nyid las: byams pa'i rang gzugs pho nya mo: zhags pa ser mo grangs med pas: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo yi: bla sgog rnam par shes pa ni:las kyi liṅga 'di nyid la chings shig badzra pa sha hūṃ kyai: bo baṃ: bde dang stong pa'i dbyings nyid las: dga' ba'i rang gzugs pho nya mo: lcags sgrogs dmar mo grangs med pas: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: bla srog rnam par shes pa ni: las kyi liṅga 'di nyid la: bsdoms shig badzra sbo ṭa baṃ baṃḥ ho ho: spros dang bral ba'i dbyings nyid las: btang snyoms rang gzugs pho nya mo: dril bu ljang mo grangs med pas: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: bla sgog rnam par shes pa ni: las kyi ling ga 'di nyid la: myos par gyis shig badzra gharnye ho ho: e he dma' ru tse ku ṇa hrī:da hūṃ: badzra pra mo ha:ri:ni:sa:dgra bgegs gnod byed aṅku sha dza dza: ratna pa sha hūm̐ ྅: padma sbo ṭa baṃ baṃ: karma ghaṇḍi ho ho:nyin mtshan gyi thun gcig re la 'gugs sngags 'di'i rgyun 'dzin:gsum pa lha dbye ni: dza bhyo: kha khwa mu kha mthu mo che: nag mo bya rog gdong pa can: rje la byed mtshon cha phyag na

ba:tshu bsnams las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: mgon skyabs lha srung kun dang phrol: bhyo: kha khā mu kha dgra la rbad:dgra bo mgon skyabs kyi lha dang phyes shig: badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: dza bhyo: hu lu mu kha mthu mo che: ser mo 'ug pa'i mgo bo can: sgrol byed mtshon cha phyag na bsnams: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: mgon skyabs lha srung bdud du phob: bhyo: hu lu mu kha he rbad: dgra bo sdong grogs byed pa'i lha dang shag phyes: rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: e he dma' ru tse gu ṇa hrī da hūṃ: badzra pra mo ha:ri:ni:sa:phaṭa: a dri trag rakta mā ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma trag rū tra mā ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha dang phyes phyes badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa phaṭa: nyin zhag thun gnyis pa la lha dbye'i sngags 'di'i rgyun bzung ngo: bzhi pa bla 'gugs ni dza bhyo:'gugs byed las kyi pho nya ni: bse khyung mtshal stag g.yu'i spyang ku: zangs dred gser 'phar khra bo gzigs: yus rngam 'jigs pa'i gar g.yos te: rdzu 'phrul

thogs pa med pa yis: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo de'i: bla gzugs sha rkyang dgo ba g.yag: lug dang ra yi rnam par bsdus: dgra bo'i gzugs dang dbyer med bstims: bkrag mdangs sras phur nyid la bsre: nyes can nyams shing nus stobs zad: dran pa rmugs nas 'byel bar bsam: e he dma' ru tsegu ṇa hrī da ྅:badzra pra mo ha:ri:ni:sa:rbad bhyo: dgra bgeg gnod byed sarba dza —:baṃ ho: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi bla sha re ma ti grim grim: sha ma ri ti thul thul: myog myog:yed yed:sha ma ri ti khug khug ling ling shag ling hūṃ tsa mradhi dza:nyu baṃ ho: nyin mtshan gyi thun gsum pa la bla 'gugs kyi sngags 'di'i rgyun 'dzin no:lnga pa thun gdab ni: tu dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: las mdzad pho nya'i dus la babs: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo yi: phung po khams dang skye mched la: sna tshogs thun gyi char phob la: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: e he dma' ru tseg ṇa hrī da hūṃ: badzra pra mo ha:ri:ni:sa he bhyo: bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma li rbad nan: rā dza rdu ling shag rbad nan: shig

gas/ shig dum dum rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: khro khro bhyo bhyo rbad nan rmugs rmugs rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal tshal rbad nan: dgra bgegs gdug pa can gyi sha la bhyo bhyo ya ya rbad: khrag la bhyo bhyo ya ya rbad nan: sgog la bhyo bhyo ya ya rbad nan: dbugs la bhyo bhyo ya ya rbad nan: rus la bhyo bhyo ya ya rbad nan: dbang ngo lnga la bye byed ya ya rbad nan: nya shaṃ tri du nan mā ra ya rbad che/da: nyin mtshan gyi thun bzhi pa la thun sngags 'di'i rgyun 'dzin no: drug pa bskul pa ni: sha khrag gtor ma bshams pa la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim yang yang bya: 'dod yon lnga yi phung por dmigs: rnga rol snyan pa'i glu dbyangs bcas tsū kṣa bhyo: dbang chen mi srun drag por khros pa'i spyo: gnod sbyin shan pa chen po dam la dgongs: bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob: ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs: spyo 'bogs brgyal gas hur thum gzer nad ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod: dza: khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs pa'i

dkyil 'khor nas:sha za gsod byed dmar mo dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod:nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob:ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs:spyo 'bogs brgyal gas khur thum gzer nad ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza:dur khrod rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas:bdud mo snying 'byin nag mo dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod:nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob:ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs:spyo 'bogs brgyal gas nyung thum gzer nad ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza:gnas yul zhing dang gtsug lag so so nas:dkor srung dur khrod lha mo dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod:nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob:ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs:spyo

ge rte 'bogs brgyal gas hur thum gzer nad ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza:sngon nas g.yar dam thob pa'i dam ldan ma:mi srun sha za chen mo dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob: ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs: spyo 'bogs brgyal gas hur thum gzer nad ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza:'jigs rngams 'bar 'khrugs dur khrod so so nas:las mkhan sprul pa'i 'khor brgyad dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob:ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs:spyo 'bogs brgyal gas chung thum gzer nad ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza:phyogs 'tshams brgyad la gnas shing dam 'dzin pa'i:bka' 'khor lha srin sde brgyad dam la dgongs:bdud rtsi

khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob: ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs spyo 'bogs brgyal gas nyung thum gzer nad ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:dza nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon la rten bcas pa'i: snang srid lha 'dre dregs can dam la dgongs: bdud rtsi khrag chang gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: nang dme shi chad nad mtshon glo bur thob: ltas ngan mig 'phrul than gyi tshang khang phobs: spyo 'bogs brgyal gas hur thum gzer nad ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod:thad du langs pa'i dgra bo nyes can 'di'i: pho rgyud nang dme gri thabs mtshon gyis sod: mo rnams 'gag gri spyo 'bogs nad kyis sod: byis pa chung sris 'phrog la ming med mdzod:sngags pa rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags rnga chen sbir: mthu yi grags snyan nam mkha'i pha mthar sgrogs: che btsan 'jigs zil dpa' rtags sdan par mdzod: brngan pa'i gtor ma

gtsa(: khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs rdul brlag nas: ming gi lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: gtor skyems dgra yi phyogs su rdeb: dmod bor mngon spyod lhun gyis grub: bdun pa thun gyis gdab pa ni: tsū bye: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: gsung mchog yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūṃ: nga ni padma he ru ga: sku stod khro zhal rngams pa'i tshul: smad ni lcags phur zur gsum pa: me rlung dug mtshon tsha tshwa 'khrugs: sbyor sgrol pho nya glog ltar 'khyug: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo yi: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs: phung khams skye mched rdul du rlogs: snyed padma kro ta gī li gī la ya sarba rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: tshe khrus gnas gsum gyi dgongs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgral 'dren bya'o :brgyad pa mtshon gdab bya ba ni: ( dza dbang chen las mdzad bka' yi 'khor: gtum rngam khros pa'i brtul zhugs can: gsod gcod shan pa'i phyag mtshan ni: spu gri nyi ma'i kha dog

can: rno ngar nus mthu stobs ldan pas: thad du langs ba'i dgra bo yi: phung khams skye mched dum bur gtubs: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: tsogatedama' ru :gu ṇa hrī da :: gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba sha hūṃ garma duṣṭi yakka rakka hūṃ phaṭa: gnod byed dgra bgegs tshal pa dum bu rdul phran tika gtun kha ṭwāṃ ka mā ra ya rbad sod: spu gris gzir zhing gas par bya: dgu pa gdong gtad ni: tsher mas nyam brtsigs me sbar te:re badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ:mngon bye da lhun grub drag po'i me 'bar klong: khams gsum rol mdzad gnod sbyin dam 'a ru rtse: 'jigs rung srin po khros pa'i nyams ldan pa: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: misrun sha za bzhi dang dregs pa'i tshogs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs til gong phyur bzhin gsal: rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra spyan drangs bstim: me rlung dug mtshon bu yug thog ser khol: rngam pa'izhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsig sang:yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo nyes can bstabs: bu pho pho rgyud bu mo mo rgyud bstabs: mtha' rtsa skye rgyud nye 'khor rtsa lag bstabs: gtad 'di longs la 'chor med dam du

badzralho bzhes: lto ba mun pa nag po'i nang du chug: ming tsam med par chos kyi dbyings su bsres: drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod dam tshig can: e he dma' ru tse gu ṇa hrī da hūṃ: badzra pra mo ha:ri:ni:sa:he: a:ya:ma:du:runamonag:na: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi me sa rakta tsitta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: brgya rtsa brjod la liṅga dum bur gtub pa 'bul: sngags kyis mchod cing bstod par bya: bsdu rim ni: kṣa: dam ye zung 'jug gnod sbyin gtso 'khor bcas: 'od zhu sgrub pa'i rdzas dang ro gcig gyur: thal sol dgra bo'i bla srog dngos su dmigs: bcu pa mnan pa bya ba ni: klu bdud gnas pa'i sar phyin la gtor skyems 'gugs gzhug byin brlabs te: dza: mchog gsum bden pa'i bka' la lha 'dres nyon: 'dir gnas klu bdud 'khor bcas sa mā dza: gtor ma dgra sha khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: yid brnags dgra bo gtad du 'bul lo bzhes: sarba nā ga rā dza ba lirha khā hi: lan gsum brjod la gtor skyems mchod de nas dong brus thal sol blugs: bden pa brdar zhing mnan gtad ni: phaṭa dza gdol ba'i rang bzhin sdig nag lto ba dzasgyu thal sol dri: las yid brnags dgra bo de: mngon

sum ltar gsal srog las 'od 'phros pas: dgra bo gang du gnas kyang dbang med bstim: na mo: mchog gsum kun dngos padma dbang gi lha: gnod sbyin shan dmar lha tshogs bden stobs kyis: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo nyes can de'i: bla sgog rnam shes gzugs rten 'di la khug: lan bdun brjod ka badzra e ku sha dza: ratna pa sha nyu padma spro ṭa baṃ:garma ghaṇḍi hoḥ pra we sha ya phaṭa: a we sha ya ā: phur bu btab bas dran med du brgyal bar bsam la: sarba rū tra mā ra ya a phaṭa: dza: klu bdud nag po ti pa ra tsa khyod: sngon gyi dam dgongs mngon spyod las la bzhengs: nyes can dgra bo yul mkhar zhing dang bcas: 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa khyod la gtad: thar med nad rims lto ba'i mthil du chug: dgra bo phung byed mdze rig lnga yi thob: 'phar ldang g.yo 'gul med par rdul du rlogs: ka unyu swā hā: stum bha ya nan: zhes brjod tshe rngam brjid sdig pa nag po rab tu khros te khyi ltog gis sha la rol ba ltar: dgra bo'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa cur mid mdzad nas klu bdud kyi yul du gshegs par bsam: sa gzhi gas pa'ang thag gis rngub

btsasdo ste phongs thal byed pa'i sgra chen po grags song bar dmigs so: bcu gcig pa dmod gyer ba ni na mo: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: ban sngags bon po kun rgyu'i nus stobs kyis: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di klu bdud gdol ba nag po la gtad do: mdze skya rlung gi 'khor lo thob cig: mdze dmar me yi 'khor lo thob cig:mdze nag dug gi 'khor lo thob cig: mdze sngon spu gri'i 'bor lo thob cig: mdze khra gzer gyi 'khor lo thob cig: ho: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di klu bdud nag po'i pho brang la gtad do: rgya mtsho dug ri kha la gtad do: klu yi phyag brnyan nag po chings chings zungs zungs zer ba la gtad do: 'chor med nag po sbrul mgo bdun pa la gtad do:sbos gas byed pa sbal nag 'dam 'dzin la gtad do: ho: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di'i bu dang tsha bo yang tsha dang bcas pa: sbra gzhi dkor nor sgo khyi lcags thags dang bcas pa: phu nu nye ba mna' ya shag rog dang bcas pa: klu yi rgyal po sog ma med kyi bu me ru 'dab ma can la gtad do: zings shig zungs shig bsdom zhig: dmod mo bor zhing

ral pa bsigs des ni dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur mthu yi grags pas phyogs kun khyab gzhan snang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur sa ma yā a ma: rgyal bamidabang pe padma sambha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad: da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon cha'i gzeng pa langs pa'i tshe: ma rgyan rgyal tshab nus ldan rdo rjedang: 'phrad nas gdul bya'i lhag ma de yis skyongs 'gro don phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin zhing la 'god bka' 'di srungs shig dmar po lha lnga po dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par ra ga sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: drag po'i mthu sgrub man ngag don 'dus reg phung nag po rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu tyā sa rgyan gyislob dpon padma se bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen chos nyid grags pas bkra shis lha reg thabs shes mtshon pa'i skyes dang rin chen maṇḍal bsnyen sgrub kyi dam bca' dang bcas bskul ngor/ kho bonus ldan dpal gyis rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma gīrtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi: gsang sgrub 'od gsal snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

'a rte na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: cas/ /dza/tsho 1 dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi sras mchog padma 'byung: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro spro bsdu la snying nas gus pas phyag bgyi'o:ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabs su las can sgrubs la snying rus can: skal bzang pho mo re mchis na: de yi bgo skal snying po'i chos: thugs kyi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: g.yel med brtson pa drag po yis rtag tu nyams su len par bya: sa ma yā: sgrub gnas yid 'ong bkra shis pa: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs gnas rgyu 'grul glag col bral ba na phyin te sa bslang sde brgyad brngan phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs su bcol bar chad bgegs la glud gtor bsngo: dpag tshad mang po'i pha mthar bsgrad srung 'khor rim pa brgyad du phub bde ba'i stan la bag phab gnas 'tsho ba zas dang rkyen bzlog sman: mda' lnga'i rkyen dang bral ba dza phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bcad:smra bcad mi dang mi 'phrad par: 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba bskyed: mi rtag sgyu ma'i blo sbyongs dang: rgyu 'bras baspu med yid ches bya dkon mchog yid ches dad pas brten: 'gro don byang chub sems rab bskyed bslu med bla ma'i rnal 'byer dang: mos gus gdung ba drag po yis gsol ba phur tshug gdab par bya: dbang bzhi blangs la thugs yid bsre: des ni nyams rtogs gong 'phel rgyas: maṇḍal gru bzhi mdzes pa'i dbus gsang rdos bla ma yab mum brten

—41 ma nyams a dṛ mtshan ldan rnams bzang po dza gad dag dang bsre: chos 'byung kha kheb dar gur phub rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkram khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon song bas zab mo'i las la 'jug par bya: sbyor ba'i rim pasnyirgya: sa ma yu: 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: sngon 'gro las rim bdun gyis bstan: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na 33 rang ༷ la mnyam gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zhal: sku dang ye shes rdzogs pa'i gsang ba che: 'pho med gnyug ma sems kyi rdo rje la: rang ngo rig pas ngang nas skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed bya ba ni rsā 'khor 'das gnyis med bde ba chen po'i dbyings: skye 'gag rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' kun bral: ye yin mnyam gnas rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal:ji bzhin rjen par mjal ba'i sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni na 33 chos rnams rang dzadal rig sku mjal phyag 'tshal: ma 'gags rang gsal kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: rtag chad mu bzhi'i mthar ltung mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid ka dag rjes yi rang: ma rtog 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul:

zang thal bde ba chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro khams rgya mtshos rang rig rtog phyir bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs rgyal sar byang chub regag: bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba hūṃ hrī: ma rig mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'dre gdon bgegs: ye shes rol pa chen po'i glud gtor gyis: ngoms shing tshims la rang grol chos skur bsgrad: 'da' med phyag rgya chen po'i zil gyis gnon: hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: lnga pa srung 'bar sgom pa ni: hūṃ hrī: brdal khyab 'pho 'gyur mtshan mas gzhom gzhig bral: bla med byang chub sems kyi ra gur ste: ye shes lnga yi 'od 'bar bsrung ba'i dal: 'gyur med rdo rje 'bar ba'i rnam par dkrig: cha dzña na rakṣa rakta hūṃ: drug pa byin chen dbab pa ni: hūṃ hrī: ka dag chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig: 'gags med rang grol longs spyod snang mtha' yas: brda rgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: dmigs med brjod bral sprul sku padma 'byung: snyan rgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: dngos grub char 'bebs byin rlabs gter gyis mdzod: gsang 'dus rdor 'chang yab yum byin phob

bsgo/ cig nyams rtogs yon tan sgron me rab sbar bas: pho rgyud dpa' bo rnams kyis byin phob cig: bde stong 'od gsal nyi zla ltar 'khyil bas: mo rgyud dpa' mo ḍakkis byin phob cig: sgrub mchog lus dang grib bzhin bsrung mdzad pas: chos srung dam can rgya mtshos byin phob cig: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob nyams rtogs bskyed: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur rtags mtshan ston: sgrub pa'i rkyen bsal rji gcig smin grol zhing: 'ja' lus 'pho chen 'grub pa'i byin phob cig: skye badzra dzña na a we sha ya a ā: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni:: hrī: ye shes ting nge 'dzin las byung ba yi: kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba lha mo'i rol rtsed bcas: dbyings las bton te dbyings dang mnyam par spel: yin badzra spra ra ṇa dza: ye shes rol pa'i mchod sprin gyis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam bkang: tshogs chen dam pa rjogs par byed: sngon 'gra'i rims pa3)rgya: sa ma yā: ཿgnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rims la rnam grangs bcu yi sgo nas bstan dang po ting 'dzin rnams gsum ni: 36 31sa rnams ma skyes brjod bral cherdogs pa che: ā:

rang gsal mnyam rdzogs klong yangs byang chub sems: hūṃ: lhan skyes rig pa hrī: dmar rgyu ru shar: zung 'jug rtsal las lhun grub zhing bkod sprul: sa ā:hūṃbadzra tsitta sa ma dhi :: gnyis pa lha bskyed bya ba ni trī: ma skyes brjod bral chen po'i rang bzhin las: lhun grub zhing bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: rang gsal gzhal med mdzes shing yid 'ong ba: gru chad sgo khyud rta bab bang rims sogs mtshan nyid rab rdzogs ye shes khang dbus su: ma chags padma thabs shes nyi zla'i khar: rig pa trī:bab 'phro 'dus zhu ba las: rang rig ngo bo tse/ rgyan rdo rje 'chang: sku mdog mthing gsal bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud: rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul phreng dang: phyag zhabs gdu bu dar gyis stod g.yog dang: smad sham zi ldir cod paṇa phu dung mdzes: do shal se mo do yi mdzes par brgyan: rig pa mi 'gyur gser gyi rdo rje dang: stong pa mnyam nyid dngul dkar dril bu bsnams: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug gzi 'od 'bar: rus ba'i rgyan drug dar dpyangs mdzes par spras: phyag

gas/ tsu gnyis pad phreng bhanta yab la stobs: zhabs zungs dpa' bo yab kyi sked la 'khril: bcu drug rol pa chen po'i rnam 'gyur ngoms: snang stong zugs 'jug sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed: spyi bor rigs bdag kun bzang yab yum sku: 'od lnga'i dngas klong mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: mtha' bskor rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin tshogs: nyi rdul 'jigs bzhin ma 'dres 'od mdangs bskyed: g.yas na pho rgyud dpa' bo'i nyams bro 'khrab: g.yon na mo rgyud mkha' 'dza'i brda glu len: mdun na ging dang lang ga'i bro gar bsgyur: rgyab tu las byed pho nya'i phrin las byed: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rang bzhin gyis: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang sngon ni: lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros: rgyal ba zhing khams rab 'byams mnyes mchod 'bul: 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas rnams kun stong de: 'khor 'das dngas bcud dpal yon bsdus te bstims: slar yang thugs sgog 'od kyis ye shes pa: rnga yab dpal gyi ri nas spyan drangs bstims: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni: ྅ hrī: mi shig skye ba med pa'i

pho brang nas: chos sku gsang 'dus yab yum gshegs su gsol: bde chen bkod pa dri med dngas mtsho nas: longs sku thod phreng sde lnga gshegs su gsol: mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i skyabs gcig pu: padma mi nub rgyal mtshan gshegs su gsol: ma chags skyon bral padma'i sdong po las: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje gshegs su gsol: pho brang ratna'i mdzes pa'i dpal khang nas: dbang sdud padma rgyal po gshegs su gsol: padma brtsegs pa'i brtul zhugs dngos grub brnyes: slob dpon nyi ma 'od zer gshegs su gsol: bya skyibs tshal dang mkha' 'gro 'du ljongs nas: gu ru blo ldan mchog sred gshegs su gsol: a su ra dang bde chen brdal ba nas: 'dul 'dzin shakya seng ge gshegs su gsol:za tor yul dang bkra shis dga' tshal nas: mkhas grub padma sam bha gshegs su gsol: bde byed brtsegs pa zab brgya'i mdzod klong nas: bdud 'dul seng ge sgra sgrogs gshegs su gsol: stag tshang seng ge bsam grub ke'u tshangs nas: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod gshegs su gsol: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'i ging

ba rte dang laṅka rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: bde stong ye shes gar gyis gdul bya 'dul: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: legs nyes ltangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: pho nya dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: sgrub mchog rnams la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 31 badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni:hūṃ hrī: skye med dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes pa: 'gags med bde chen gsal ba'i lha sku'i ngang: gnyis med ro gcig chu la chu bzhag bzhin: 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i ngang du bzhugs: ka badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal bya ba ni: na ma: ma skyes brjod bral de bzhin nyid kyis sku: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor mchog: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i bkod pa la: rang ngo rig pa'i ngang nas phyag 'tshal lo: ma na mo na ma ho: drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rol pa'i 'phrul: ngo mtshar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang: sman rag gtor mchod sbyor sgrol byang chub sems: mdzes pa'i lha mo bsam yas gar dang bcas: rje btsun

bla ma'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul: 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur dngos grub stsol: sa/ ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: bdun pa bstod pa bya ba ni: sa hrī: chos sku dri bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin la: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad bcu gsum rgyan gyis spras: pad sdong las byon skye shi gnyis med sku: skyabs gcig bla ma rdo rje 'chang la bstod: rnam pa kun gyi mchog gsang dbyings nyid las: ye shes bde ba sbyin pa'i sman gcig ma: rgyal kun dgyes bskyed dga' bzhi'i rtser son pa'i: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos nyid dbyings las mdzad tshul thabs mang ngoms: chos can thabasu la phyag rgyas rol mdzad cing: bde nas bde ba mchog gi rtser skyol ba'i: rje 'bangs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging la bstod: khyed thugs sgrib bral ye shes me long zhal: sgrib byed dri ma rlung sems kun rtog cha: 'dzag med dbu ma'i dbyings su stobs bcil na: lhan skyes chos sku mngon gyur dngos grub stsol: badzra sa ma ya ā: yig brgya bzla brgyad pa 'dzab kyi zhabrul 'khor ni: sa trī gting gsal zung 'jug bde

gas/ stong bla ma'i sku'i: thugs gar 'od lnga'i ga'ur nyi zla'i sbubs: rig pa hrī:la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas sgo gsum snang zhen dri ma dag:ye shes lha yi gsang ba gsum du blta: dag mnyam gnas lugs rtogs pa mngon gyur ngang: sa ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hrī: yengs med 'dzin med ngang la gnas: chos kun dgongs pa'i phyag rgyas btab: rlung sems dri ma rang sar dag rtogs pa'i lo 'dab phyogs mthar rgyas: sa ma yā dgu pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni nyu trī: sngags kyi phreng ba mthing gsal g.yas dza/ 'gyesar: cesad zer yar spros rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse bskul: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon dri ma sbyangs: tshur 'dus snang grags rig gsum lha sngags thugs: ye nas gnyis med mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang: skyed a:nyu ma hā gu ru sarba sidhi pha la sa: dgongs pa dbyings la bor bzhin du rnam rtog gnyis snang ar la gtad ma yengs mi sgom ting 'dzin gyis: ye shes chos sku snying nas gsal: sa ma ya: bcu pa las sbyor 'jab dmigs ni: nyu trī: dgongs pa chos dbyings gter la mnga' brtes te: phrin las rnam bzhi stsol med lhun grub nas: gdul dka' nyon mongs

rgyas pa'i sems can rnams: tshad med thugs rjes sbyang smin rdzogs grub nas: 'khor ba dong sprug mdzad pa mngon gyur ngang: sa ā:྅ ma hā gu ru shrī he ru ka sarba sirnyi hūṃ phaṭa: 'khrul med rig pa'i ting 'dzin gyis gzung 'dzin mtshan ma thad gar sgrol snang shes gzhi med rtsa bral mthong kun bzang bla ma'i rang zhal mjal dngos gzhi'i rim pazhwa/rgya: sa ma yā rja1411 rjes kyi rim pa bco lnga las dang po 'dzab kyi mchod bstod ni: dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying: lan gsum bzlas la lhag chad bskangs: thod rnga'i sgra bcas spyan 'dren ni: ( hrī: khyen rgyan mkha' 'a111 gling dbus nas:gsang sngags gnas mchog dpal gyi ri: padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: brgyud gsum bla ma'i tshogs rje bo: gsang 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang: rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dang bcas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: gdung shugs drag pos 'bod bskul na: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: thod rnga gdung dbyangs glu la dgongasaḥ kun bzang rig pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul glu gar rdo rje'i bro yis bstod: chags nyams sems kyi dri ma bshags: rtog sgrib gol sa mtha'

ga:tshu dag sol: legs nyes snang ba ci shar yang: thugs rjes zungs shig rdo rje 'chang: byin gyis rlobs shig sku drin can: lus la sku yi gzi byin phob: ngag la gsung gi bden tshig sbor: sems la thugs rgyud ye shes bskyed: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang bskur: bya btang dben pa'i ri sul skyol: 'jigs med dpa' ba'i gdeng rnyed nas: snang srid brda dang dpe char shar: sgyu lus 'od sku phyag rgyar smin: sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs nas: dpal rir bla ma'i spyan sngar drongs: sras kyi thu 21ra bdag shākyar cig: ces brjod la ltem rkyang med ba'i mos gus mchi ma 'dril tsam bya khyed shes blo gtad 'gyur ba med pas gsol 'debs kyi tshig dir dir sgrogs: de'i tshe phar ma spros pa'i shes pa gting gsal: tshur ma bsdus pa'i 'od gsal zang thal dri med ngo bo ngos bzung dmigs gtad bral ba'i rig pa rjen ye re ba zhig 'char ro: de ni rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlab kyi drod tshad theb pa'i rtags gcig go sa ma yā:gnyis pa rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgrags nas pho nya gsol mchod bya ba ni: sha khrag brgyan pa'i dmar gtor bshams phral: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs la rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas 'di skad do tsū hrī:

skye med rdo rje dbyings kyi yum chen mo: sngags bdag sgrub mchog grogs mo e ka dza: sgyu 'phrul 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu 'gyed: ma g.yel rdo rje'i dam dgongs da tshur byon: dza bhyo: don dam dbyings kyi zhal gcig khro gnyer chags: log rtog srog la rnyab pa'i phyag gnyis kyis: rtog med zhing dbyug phyar bas rnam rtog gsod:ma rig dū tra'i snying phyung zhal du khyer: legs nyes shan drang 'byed pa'i lcags sbyang spro: srid gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i spyan gcig bsgrad: chos kun a tir mnyam pa'i ral gcig spud: 'khor 'das ro gcig grol ba'i tshems gcig gtsigs kun khyab lta ba ston pa'i nu gcig 'phyang: sgrib med zang thal gsal ba'i sprin dkar klub: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ston pa'i zhabs gar bsgyur: sgyu 'phrul rol gar 'gyed ba'i gtso 'khor ngoms: ming brgya mtshan stong bdag mo ral gcig ma:sngon gyi dam dgongs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: bla rdo sgog 'khor gsang ba'i rten la bzhugs: bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong phyir brda phyag 'tshal: rnam mang

btsarsha mchod pa'i sprin gyis thugs dam bskang: las myur snying nye grogs gcig mnga' gsol lo: ma cig khyed dran dwangs ba'i yid kyis bstod: rlung sems shan dbye rig pa sa ler ston: gol shor tshar chod rtogs pa'i sgron me sbor: 'phro rgod 'thor 'byams dbu mar phyag rgyas thob: bying rmugs 'thib dwangs 'od gsal sa ler bor: shes nyams yid dpyod las 'das rdzogs pa ches: khams gsum yongs grol srid gsum ka dag mdzod: 'bar ba'i stobs bskyed bde ba mchog bskul nas: sgyu lus 'od skur grol ba'i grogs mdzod cig: rdo rje'i dam dgongs tha tshig ma g.yel zhig: ྅ ma ma e ka dza ṭi sa pā ri wā ra e dam ba lidha kha kha khā hi (1 shā): lan bdun gyis phul dgyes pa bskangs: gang bcol phrin las thogs med 'grub: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa tshogs kyis mchod pa la ma dā na dang me sa sogs: bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams bkod: chang chu nang mchod sman gyis gso rnam rtog dri mas ma bslad par: ye shes bdud rtsir rlabs pa ni: ā: lce sa dbyings dang mnyam dum gcig ka pā lar: bza' bca' btung ba

ldag gzhib 'dod yon rigs: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ngo bor dmigs: rnam pa sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir spel: snyed ā:྅ ha ho hrī: bzhi pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: ( hrī:rang snang 'od gsal zangs mdog dpal ri nas: brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'chang: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i 'khor dang bcas: 'du ba tshogs la sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por dgyes bzhugs nas: thim pa'i tshul du dgyes ston rol nas kyang: rmad byung mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:oṃ ma hā gu ru bīdu dha ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza: lnga pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: sa hrī: 'dod yon lha mo mdzes 'dzum gar ldan pas: gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs gzhong pa rnga ye shes bdud rtsi tshogs ston rab spros te: rgyal kun yongs 'dus bla ma'i dal du 'bul: skye ma hā gu ru sarba ga ṇa tsakra putstsha khā hi: drug pa nyams chags bshags pa ni: sa skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang: ye shes gzigs pas bdag la dgongs su gsol: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dang: dam tshig chags nyams tshogs

bsgotshu kyis bskang zhing bshags: ma badzra sa ma ya ā: bdun pa bsgral bstabs bya ba ni: sa bye ma rtog log rtog a 'thas 'khrul ba'i gdon: mtshon chen bdag med shes rab ral gris bsgral: sha khrag drod dbugs phung khams skye mched rnams: 'khor 'das 'ub chub chos sku'i dgongs klong bstabs: dri tri rū tra sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: me sa rakta tsitta la khā hi: brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni: pho: 'khor 'das dgongs mnyam ye shes gsang sgog 'chang: legs nyes ltong 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i:ma sring ging ling dbang phyug 'bar ma rnams: sngon gyi g.yar dam rjes dgongs pham phab bzhes: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub mdzod cig: ma ma bying uṣṭi ṭa ba ling ta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni:spya stso mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las: brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'chang: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal mdangs bskul: gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams: 'khrul ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings su sgrol: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi rgud pa

sol kun nas bde skyid rdzogs ldan ltar 'phel ba'i: phrin las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma ya: bcu pa chad tho brtan ma ni ka bhyo: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: he ru ka dpal rig 'dzin chen po brgyad: o rgyan slob dpon padma thod phreng gis: spyan sngar khas blang dam bca' mna' bor ba'i dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bka' 'khor 'bangs: khyad par 'bum phrag rgyud srung ral gcig mas 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can phan bde spel: rnal 'byor grogs mdzod sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog: sbyin bdag 'byor rgyas mdzad phrin phyogs bcur spel: gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams thogs med stsol: khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i dam 'dzin ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje ug chos sogs: ma yam brtan ma bcu gnyis g.yog 'khor bcas lhab lhub rgyan dang khu sbrang rlung 'khrigs bzhin: dril g.yer rol mo bshud pa glu yis mtshon: ming pos 'bod do sring rnams da tshur byon: 'dod

bsgoji: yon gtor ma bshal chu 'di bzhes la: mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa sol: 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: bcu gcig rta bro bya ba ni: nyu hrī: e nyid stong pa chos dbyings sgom rgya dza rnam rtog gnyis snang bdud bzhi ar la gtad glu gar dro yi dgongs pas phyag rgyas btab: byang chub bar du ma ldang stam bha ya: ma ra ya rbad nan: bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni:ho: rigs kun yongs 'dus bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag rmongs ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams la sogs: las nyon dri ma bag chags bshags bgyi'o: badzra sa ma yā ā: bcu gsum pa bsngo smon ni: ho: rnam dkar dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'gro la bsngo: lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rnam dag ste: sku dang ye shes rol bar smin grol nas: dpal mgon bla ma'i spyan sngar 'khod par regag: bcu bzhi pa rtag chad mtha' bsal ni: ho: snang cha lha sku'i dkyil 'khor rten brten pa: rim bsdus mtha' bral de bzhin nyid du ā: slar yang 'od gsal sgyu ma lta

bu'i skus: snang stong zung 'jug spyod lam dang du len: a phaṭa: bco lnga shis brjod bya ba ni na mo: chos dbyings mkha' la rig pa'i nyi ma shar: rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub bum bzang 'dod dgu'i sprin phung 'khrigs: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: bde stong mkha' la dga' bzhi'i 'od stong 'bar:dag pa dbyings gsum mkha' 'dza'i bkra shis shog: yid la 'dod pa'i phrin las char ltar 'bebs: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: dbul phongs rgud sel yid bzhin nor lta bu: nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog: 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin sa la 'god: zab chos rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: thog mtha' bar gsum dge zhing bkra shis pa: 'od gsal rjerdogs pa chen po'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar sgrub la brtsan 'bras bu: nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel sa lam yon tan lhun gyis grub: bar chad bdud las rnam par rgyal: rjes kyi rim pasnyirgya: sa ma yā: rjetsho31 ༷ e ma: rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje gshog rgod nga'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis: thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i

—4): dbang phyug 'brog paṇa khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas: rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye mdo khamasabakra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdom:ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas gdul bya'i lhag ma de yis skyong 'brel tshad don ldan rnga yab dpal rir 'god nad mtshon mu ge'i rgud pa cha shas skyobs:bstan pa'i 'gro don rma smra sngags sder rgyas 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shig dmar po lha lnga po: dam nyams lag tu ma re ra spu gri gsum: skal bzang pad tshal skyongs shig sngags srung ma:sa ma lnga rgya rgya rgya: gsang sgrub 'od gsal snying po rdzogs so: gter rgya:gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya gu hya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sambha wa'i bka':bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim: snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chos nyid grags pas bkra shis lha reg dkar dmar thabs shes rdor dril rin chen maṇḍal bsnyen sgrub lhur len mdzad pa'i dam bca' bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma gīrtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

'a:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde'i: bka' them byang 'gyur ba med pa'i rgya can zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rmi: na 31 gu dzag padma kwa ra ye: sna she sa mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya rtsa gang 'dul sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa yi: spro bsdus bdag nyid khyad 'phags rig 'dzin la: rnams kun dad brgya'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i dal dbus su: mnyam med ston pa o rgyan padma dang: las can rje 'bangs rigs lnga'i tshom bu la: zab gsang khyad 'phags rig 'dzin chos sgo phyes nor 'khrul med phyir bka' rtsis btab pa ni: e ma ho: ye sangs rgyas kyang thugs rje med byung ba'i gdul bya'i snang ngor gang 'dul ston pa'i sku mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal tshabs su: chos kyi nyi ma pad 'byung bdag bskrun pa'i rgya bal bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbar: lta 'o/ga mu stegs gdon gzugs bon bstan bsnub sa gzhi zhabs bcag sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabs: zab gter rgya mtshos 'dzam gling yul gru bkang: bstan pa'i gzhi ma gu ru nga nyid kyi phyi nang gsang sgrub bsam mi khyab pa las khyad 'phags sgrub pa phyag rgya zil gajon gyi: sgo 'phar phyes nas khyed cag rnams la sbyin: de yang las rim rnams pa 'di ltar ro: brda byang dri med yid bzhan nor bu dang:

lag len kha bskang las rim bco brgyad pa smin byed dbang mchog 'od dkar mtha' yasadang: lo rgyus zab mo mos gus gnad bskul grags: gsol 'debs bde stong bum pa bzang po dang: zab sgrub bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i bcud chen po: tshogs mchod yid bzhin nor bu dngos grub mdzod bskang ba padma rgyas pa'i chun 'phyang ba: rdo rje'i tshig bdun dang 'brel las tshogs bcu phyi nang gsang ba'i zab sgrub gsol 'debs bcas smon lam rnam dag dri med shel phreng ngo: mdun bskyed yo rgyan nor lha'i zab sgrub dang: g.yang 'gug 'od kyi dra ba zhes pa dang: g.yang 'gug thugs rje'i lcags kyu rnam gnyis so: mchod phreng man dha ra ba'i do shal can g.yang gtad bkra shis ku mud bkram pa'i tshal: bzlas dmigs thugs rje'i rgyud bskul dngos grub mdzod las tshogs bsam 'phel rim pa bco brgyad do: gsang rgyud thig le chen po zhes su grags nyams len gnad tig dri med a rgya can sreg blugs phrin las lhun grub zab pa'i sgo ratna'i nor dbang dri ma med pa dang: byin rlabs dbang mchog gter gyi bum bzang ngo: bshags pa rab gsal shel gyi me long dang: rdzas bskang bsdus pa tshogs chen rab rdzogs grags:dmar po lha lnga'i zab sgrub spu gri 'bar: gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag lha lnga'i bskang: rno ba'i mde'u dug khrag khol ma'o: man ngag mthu sgrub don 'dus dang bcas nas: bsgrub pa bsdus pa'i don rnams yongs su tshang:

btsa(: lhag chad med par brda yi ris su thob grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rtse shod gsham du sbos ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus grub pa'i dbang phyuganus lngan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god: chos bdagabye na lam bu gsum las can bdun: dad lngan nyer lnga smon lam dbang gis 'dzom 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' log lag tu ma re ra a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga: sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya: bka' zem byang 'gyur ba med pa'i rgya can rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya:gsang rgya: gu bya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sam bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda zim: snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag du mas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bocas ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'dza'i 'du gling nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda lhag chad med par gtan la dbab pa'i ye ge pa nipadma smon sems kyis bgyis pa'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga lam̐/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bstan srung dmar po lha lnga'i zab sgrub spu gri 'bar ba dgra bgegs snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas/ na mo gu ru padhwa ka ra ye thab rnamache rje/ rab 'byams rgyal ba thamasacad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus padma 'byung lo paṇa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjes bor:gus pas btud de phyag bgyi'o:ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis:zab gsang sgrub pa lhur blangs nas:tshe gcig sangs rgyas sbyor ba la bar chad dgra 'dres rgol ba rtsubs:de tshe dmar mo lha lnga yi sgog gi sgrub pa zab mo gces sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:tha'i rgya 'di la spyor dngos rjes dang gsum:dang po dben gnas 'jigs rung sar phyin nas sa bslang dkar nag brngan bgegs bsgrad bsrung ba'i rwa gur phub maṇḍal zla gam 'khyud 'khor nang:gru gsum rim pa bzhi bskor bya:nang dmar phyi nag mtshon chas bkod ldeng khrir gtso gtor ral gri'i dbyibs yul bshos bzhi dang 'dod rdzas bkod gdug dang dar tshon mjes pas spras rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkram:gru gsum nang dmar ling ga ni dbang tshang zhal shes bzhin du bkod:rtsang mtshe dug nyung dra ba bya:mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bkod:bla rdo sgog gi 'khor lo ni:gab pa'i yig chung ltar du bya rtsa gsum sman gtor rakta sogs:mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bya rnga ral dung gling g.yab dar dang:rdor dril thod rnga ja chang skyems:sha khrag gtor ma 'bru sna tshogs bag chags dri ma bral bar bsags:de nas bdag bskyed he ru ga'i bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa tshad 'khyol rjes:srung ma 'bod pa'i thabs la brtson sa

btsardo ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: thatha rgya:gnyis pa dngos gzhe bskyed bzlas la: 'gab 'dre bkar mnan spyi ltar bya sgrub rdzas bsangs sbyangs rgya chen brtson rten dbab mchod rdzas byin gyis rlabs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: sgo ma hā shu byeta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3 nya: rang mdun bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i sang: dur khrod lce spyang gcan zan nyul ba'i tshul: : phaṭa sod rgyob nga ro ldir ba'i khrod: las byed pho nya'i mtshon thun 'gyed pa'i dbus: thod pa'i sku mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i nang: dgra bgegs pho mo gcal du bkrams pa'i steng:gnam lcags las grub 'khor lo'i rtsibs dbus su: ktatshutt+waṃ:la 'khor 'das dngas bcud bstims: dam can yongs kyi srog snying nus mthu bskyil: yongs gyur gnod sbyin shan pa daste ru rtse: dmar nag khrag mdog khro gnyer rab tu 'khrugs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche bzhi gtsigs: smra ra rab 'bar me yi tsha tsha 'phro: spyan gsum dmar la zlum pas sdang mig bsgrad: smin mar drag po'i glog 'od rtag tu 'khyug: ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan: phyag g.yas ral

gri me 'bar mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas snying zhags thod phreng thugs gar brten: dbang gi dar ber dur khrod dpal chas brgyan: zhabs gnyis me khyung dmar po rlung bstegag bcibs: las byed shan pa sde brgyad bran ltar 'khor: bka' nyan dregs pa sde rgyad las la 'gyed: 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sde rdul ltar 'tshubs che btsan 'gran bral gzhan snang zil gyis gnon ma rungs dgra gdon rgyal bsen brlag par byed: shar gyi rtsibs dbus pad nyi bse mo'i steng: gnod sbyin bu mo gsod byed chen mo ni: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam: phyag g.yas dgra snying 'byen pa'i lcags kyu dang: g.yon pas ma rung gdon gyi tsitta 'dzin: mgo phreng zhing lpags gzig sham rus rgyan spras: ral pa gyen brdzes zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur me rta dmar po bcibs: gtum drag me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong du bskyed lto yi rtsibs dbus pad nyi bam gyi steng: bdud kyi bu mo snying 'byin 'bar ma ni: dmar nag khrag sol 'dres pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: spyan bsgrad mche gtsigs nu 'bur

gtsa/: bā ga rgyas: phyag g.yas gsod byed dgra stu mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas nad rkyal dgra dang gdon la 'debs: sbrul chun zhing g.yang spre'u'i smad sham mdzes: zhabs gnyis gar gyi bdud rta rlung gshog bcibs bskal pa'i dug rlangs 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed: nub kyi rtsibs dbus pad nyi rū tra'i steng mdzes 'dzum lha yi bu mo ngas nus ma: dkar ser zhi 'dzum brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can: phyag g.yas 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum pa 'dzin: g.yon pas dkor la rngam pa'i snying 'byin bsnams dar nag go zu padma'i do shal 'phyangs: mdzes pa ratna'i phreng ba sum rim spras: zhabs gnyis gar gyis g.yu 'brug stsal ldan bcibs: 'ja' 'od khu sbrang 'khrigs pa'i dbus na 'gying: byang rtsibs dbus su pad nyi bdud bsen steng: klu btsan sring gcig sha za kha mo che: dmar sgrug zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam:ha he'i bzhad sgogs bstan dgra'i sha la dgyes sgrub pa'i drod nyul bshug glu brda la spro: rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi sring gcig mo: phyag g.yas dug gsum rtsad

gcod spu gri phyar: g.yon pas bhanta dmar bkang zhal la 'dren: zhing g.yang sbrul chun mgo phreng gzig sham mjes: zhabs gnyis gar gyis rtsal ldan glog zhags bcibs: me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbus su gsal: de mthar pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma ma 'dres yongs rdzogs til gong phyur bzhin gsal: rang rang sgog las 'od zer dpag med 'phros: he chen brdal dang gtsug lag chos 'khor gnas: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: bsad glu rol mo'i sgras bskul sbyan 'dren ni: hūṃ ktaḥ dad dang dam tshig gnyen pos 'bod bskul gyis: tshur gshegs sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: dbang drag shan pa dmar nag gtso 'khor bcas he chen brdal ba'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin srin dang bshos pa'i sring gcig ma: dur khrod ha he bzhad pa'i gnyer 'dzin zhing:legs nyes stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: ma mo gsod byed chen mo gshegs su gsol: bdud po sman dang bshos pa'i ma chen mo: dur khrod phu lung nag po'i srung ma che:

badzra sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas shing bstan pa'i bdag:bdud mo snying 'byen chen mo gshegs su gsol: btsan dang klu mor bshos pa'i sman gcig ma:dur khrod mun pa can gyi zhing skyongs gtso: dkor srung zas nor skyongs ba'i dam tshig can: sman btsun ngas nus chen mo gshegs su gsol:lha mi bar sa pa'i a lcam bzhin bzang ma: dur khrod gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyen skyong zhing:rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi grogs gcig pu/ma mo sha za ḍakki gshegs su gsol/'byung lnga'i dbying dang sa spyod mkha' spyod zhing:gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i gnyer 'dzin ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍakki gtso 'khor bcas:sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:ngo bo gcig las rnam 'phrul cir yang bsgyur:'khor g.yog sprul pa dpung bcas gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol:dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho phyir gshegs su gsol: sems can bde skyid spel phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs rdul du brlag phyir gshegs su gsol:

dus 'khrug nad yam bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: lo nyes sad ser bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor dam ldan bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: sgrub gnas gtsug lag skyongs phyir gshegs su gsol: zab gter bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir gshegs su gsol: e he dme ru rtse gu ṇa hrī dha pa tsa du pa si li ma ni sha za ḍakki kha mo che sarba sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas btsas su gsol ba ni: tsū trī: phyi nang gsang ba bla rdo sgog 'khor rten: 'dod yon bkod ldan sgrub pa'i dam rdzas la: dmar po lha lnga brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dgyes shing bzhugs nas phrin las grub par mdzod: badzra sa ma ya tisgo lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba ni: na mo: rgyal bstan bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin rnams kyi grogs: sgrub pa'i drod nyul dam tshig gnad la brten: bla med rdor snying bstan pa gtsug tu bkur:pho nya dam can mched lngar phyag 'tshal lo: na mo dṛ na ma ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: zab gsang bla med rdo rje snying po yi: bstan pa rin chen 'dzin bsrung spel nus

btsa/ pa'i: dbang drag shan dmar yab yum sprul 'khor bcas: dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul ba ni:khrag gi mchod yon dri chu'i zhabs bsil dang: dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen bdug pa spos: zhun gyi mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod pa'i rnga: sil snyan pi waṃ gling bu phag rdo pa: rnga chen dung dang bshud pa mkhar rnga'i sgra: phyar dar g.yab dar mda' dar rten mdung dang: sgrub gtor bskang rdzas bla rdo srog 'khor lo ja chang 'o phud dkar mngar skyems sna tshogs: zla rgyas zla phrum me sa bā la ya: rta dril ba glang cang shes 'dod 'jo'i ba:stag seng khyung 'brug gter bum dpag bsam shing: gro 'bras khre nas so ba 'bru yi rigs: dar gos 'phrug ther lwa ba byang dkar reg:rma bya de pho mkha' lding bya yi tshogs:g.yu byur ind+ra beeḍūr ratna'i rigs: gzig dom 'phar sprang g.yi sogs gcan zan sde: rta g.yag ra lug g.yang dgas dmar gyi tshogs:sbal sbrul nya gcong chu gnas rigs mtha' dag:sha rgo rna ba ri dwags bsam mi

khyab: go khrab mtshon cha yo byad sna tshogs dang: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi mjes pa'i rgyan: mdor na mchod par 'os pa'i dam rdzas ni: 'dzad med ting 'dzin kun bzang rol pa'i sprin: phyi nang 'khri bag dri mas ma gos par: 'dzin rtog rang grol ye shes gar bsgyur gyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i pho nya brngan legs na: dgyes brtse'i rnam 'gyur du ma'i dpal mdangs kyis: yongs su bde ba chen por bzhes rol nas: dbang mdzad dmar po lha lnga'i phrin las gang: dus bab bstan pa'i dgra sde brlag pa dang: nub med a ti'i bstan pa mkha' ltar spel: nyin mtshan g.yel ba med pa'i dam tshig gis: zab gsang rdor snying bstan pa bsrung ba dang: de 'dzin 'dus sde thugs mthun khrims gtsang bzhin: bshad sgrub snying po nyi zla ltar gsal mdzod: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba spel: 'jig rten khams kun char chu dus bab nas: lo bcud rtsi thog phyug 'phel 'bras bu rgyas: nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyur:dkar phyogs dbu bstod nag po'i sde dpung

gas/ bcom: 'dre bdud bgegs tshogs dam la 'dogs pa dang: smon log dam sri thal ba rdul brlag cing: sbyor sgrol rmad byung drag rtsal khyad chos ston:bod khams dkar po'i chos kyis 'tsho ba dang: o rgyan padma'i phrin las dpal gyur te: tshom bu 'bum 'bum padma 'od kyi zhing: gang 'dul sprul pa'i dpal du dbug dbyung mdzod: e he dme ru rtse gu ṇa hrī dha sarba sa pa ri wā ra ma hā arnya pabye pus dhu pe a lo ke ghandhe ༷wibye shabha rū pa shabha ghandhe dharmā ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta rakta bā lirha tsitta bā su ta ko ro tsa na ke ni ri ti la kha kha khā hi khā hi: dam nyams pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs che 'dre chung sri gri bo gshed 'khyams rgyal bsen dam sri mtha' mi kla klo sogs chos srid nor la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po thams cad sarba ma ra ya khā hi: sarba ma mi ka ya sarba arta sirnyi ye swā hā: ho: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya: sdig spyod sgol ba'i shan pa: he chen dha na'i zhing skyongs: dbang drag shan pa dme dzasgyu dgyes bskyed drag mo mched bzhi: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro: dgra gsod shan pa sde brgyad: bgegs

'joms lha srin brgyad po: bka' nyan pho nyar bcas pa: gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo: phrin las gnyer bcol las ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs shig: dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod cig: bstan 'dzin sku tshe bsrings shig: bshad sgrub 'dus sde spel cig: zab gter dpal kha skyongs shig: dge ba'i sna khrid mdzod cig: sdig pa'i mgo 'phang chom shig: dgra dpung rtsad nas chod cig: bgegs tshogs ming med gyis shig: dkor gyi bdag po gyis shig: tshangs mgron skyel bsu mdzod cig:shag rgyal rno mgyogs re 'o: khyims thabs bcud bzang bskyil zhig: phya g.yang rwa ba srungs shig: zas grogs spel mthun bsgrigs mdzod: nor phyugs rdzi bu gyis shig:jag rkun 'phar spyang gzhom zhig: chos mthun bsam pa bsgrub mdzod: sbyin bdag mnga' thang bskyed cig: mi la na tsha ma btang: phyugs la god kha ma 'tshe:bsam pa myur du sgrubs shig: 'dod don lag tu stsol zhig: kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod cig: legs pa'i sgo brgyar sprod cig: nyes pa stong dang bsnol zhig: tshe bsring

pa( sgog bskyed dpal mthud: 'di phyi'i re smon dam pa gegs med yid bzhin stsol cig: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tshor: dge rgu bde bar sbyor zhig: bkris bde legs yon tan: nub med 'phel rgyas mdzod cig: 31 badzra sa ma yu: ā:badzra sa ma yu: : badzra sa ma yā: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūṃ bhyo: thugs rje zhi ba'i rang bzhin rnam par rgyal: 'dod 'byung rgyas pa'i las mdzad rnam thos sras: khams gsum dbang sdud hya ṣṭṛ wa dang: za byed rngam khros drag po ra hu la: kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus dme ru rtse: sde brgyad dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug na sba: mngon mtho nges legs sgrub la snying brtse zhing: rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsang ba'i snying por gdung: 'da' med a ti'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung: dam nyams gshed ma dam ldan grogs gcig pu: dbang mdzad shan pa dmar nag sku la bstod phyag g.yas gcod byed ral gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i sha khrag rus pa gtubs: g.yon pas tsitta dmar snying zhal du khyer: bdud dpung drungs nas 'byin la phyag

'tshal bstod: dbang gi ber klubs me tog tshom bu bkra: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' bo'i rtags su 'chang: drag po'i gad rgyangs ldir ba'i sa gsum g.yo: che btsan 'gran zla bral la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan me khyung rlung gasgo ga bcibs: dregs pa sde brgyad sgog la mnga' dbang bsgyur: skad cig stong gsum nyul ba'i bya ma rta: 'phur ldan stobs kyi bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod: khyod nyid dga' na sangs rgyas sa la sbyor: khros na srid pa gsum gyis legs nyes ston:gnyis byed gdug pa'i dpa' skongs dam tshig can: 'khor 'das yongs kyi byed por phyag 'tshal bstod: dgyes bskyed dga' bzhi'i rnam rol ḍakki bzhi:phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmag g.yul ngo bzlog mdzad cing:zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyis bstan pa srung: yab yum gnyis med dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod:tshogs brgyad sems la brten byas 'khrul ba'i sgog: ye shes sgo brgyad sbubs su 'dren byed cing: legs nyes sdong grogs 'dzin pa'i gnyer kha ba: pho nya sprul 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:hoX

ba:tshu stobs chen gar gyi dbang phyug he ru ga: 'khor 'das stong pa chos sku'i srog 'dzin pa: ye shes gsang ba legs nyes gar bsgyur ba: dmar po za byed shan pa dme ru dgongs bdag rmongs 'khrul ba'i smag rum 'thibs rkyen gyis: nyon mongs log par lta ba'i 'du shes 'khrul: so byang sngags kyi dam tshig sdom las 'das:bag med spyod ngan gzengs bstod lta ba dman: theg mchog rig pa'i snying po sang ma gyur: kha na ma tho'i grub mtha'i rjes su snyogs: phyogs chad rtog ge'i dri mas bslad pa dang: blo chung sems kyi dbang du gyur pa las: mchod bya mchod byed dngos 'dzin ma dag pas: nongs pa gang mchis ye shes lha la bshags: bzod pa bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bka' 'khor 'jig rten gdug rtsub 'chang ba'i rigs: 'pho med zang thal gnyer gyis dam bcing nas: ldog bral las kyi gnyer bzhes dam tshig gis: ci bcol phrin las rab 'byams 'grub par mdzod: e he dme ru rtse gu ṇa hrī dha hūm̐ sa ma ya dza: smra bcad mi dang mi 'phrad par bzlas pa rtags thon bar du bya: gang

'dod phrin las kun 'grub 'gyur sa ma yā: e he dme dzad rtse gu ṇa hrī dha ma hā mu tra sa ma ya dza:nyu bam ho dzña na dhartu phe dza: yab yum gnyis su med pa yi: srog sngags bar ma chad pa phu rtags mtshan ma gsal bar du bzla gnad kyis phrin las kun 'grub cing bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur: sa ma yā: e he dam 2〉 rtse gu ṇa hrī dam hā mu hā sa ma ya dza:hūṃ baṃ ho dzñā na dhartu tho dza: dgra bgegs gabye da byed kyi dre ga la rbad rbad: dmigs pa ting 'dzin rno ldan pas sgrub bsnyen de yi byed cha bzla: skabs su 'bod bskul nan du bskyang: des ni dgra bgegs rdul brlag pa'i: rtags mtshan bzang po 'char bar 'gyur sa ma yā: e he dme ru rtse gu ṇa hrī dha ma hā mu tra sa ma ya dza:྅ baṃ ho dzñā na dhartu pho dza: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi srog ha la ha la dum bur gtub la sod cig: yengs med rno myur ting 'dzin gyis bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod byed pa'i: drag sngags rbad pa'i grangs byed bzla skabs su bsad bskul bskyal ba'i tshe rtags mtshan don snying mngon sum 'byung gang la gzas kyang thal bar rlog:sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes su gsol mchod dang: 'khrugs bskang la sogs nan du bskyar: de nas phud bskang 'bul ba la rin chen brdar bas skyems bzang dang gtor skyu 'bru sman 'dod rdzas rnams:

gsatshu sngags drug phyag drug byin gyis brlabs zlo ā:hūṃ sarba pañtsa ra sa ya na a dṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭha: lan bdun gyis ni bdud rtsir bsgyur:ho:'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing dang:gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i srung ma:yul sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag po: dur khrod brgyad dang he ru'i gnas bcu'i gnyer 'dzin:sgrub gnas dang chos 'khor yongs kyi dkor srung:he chen dha na'i dbang bsgyur ba'i gtso bo: bka' gter gyi bstan pa rin po che la gdung sems che ba:khyad par o rgyan chen po'i zab gsang 'dzin srung spel sgrub byed pa por snying nye ba:rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin chen po: bos na snyan gsang ba:bcol na don 'grub pa: bskul na las myur ba: rbad na mthu che ba:ging thams cad kyi gtso bo:gnod sbyin kun gyi rgyal po:rgyal btsan sde brgyad kyi sgog bdag: dge bsnyen yongs kyi spyi rje: yab gnod sbyin rakka gdong dmar:yum 'dod pa stobs sbyin rgyal mo:sras khams gsum dbang sdud kyi rgyal po: dgra gsod pa'i mtshon:bgegs 'dul ba'i thog las byed pa'i pho nya:rtag par bsrung ba'i rdzi

bu: steng lha dmag gi bu yug 'tshubs pa: bar gnyan rigs kyi sprin dpung 'khrigs pa: 'og klu gnyan gyi mchod bstod phyur ba: g.yas na las mkhan mched brgyad sa ga ltar 'khyug pa: g.yon na lha srin sde brgyad thog ltar myur ba: 'dab na bye ba 'bum sde'i pho nya 'gyed pa sgrol ging shan pa dmar nag la gsol lo mchod do: sku gsang dkar po lha bzang la gsol lo mchod do: gsung sprul lha mgon dmar po la gsol lo mchod do: thugs sprul phung byed nag po la gsol lo mchod do: yon tan gter bdag yid bzhin la gsol lo mchod do: phrin las drang sgong mig dmar la gsol lo mchod do: 'dod 'byung a partsid ta la gsol lo mchod do: zhi byed rnam par rgyal ba la gsol lo mchod do: rgyas mdzad dpal ldan rnam sras la gsol lo mchod do: dbang sdud hya ghri wa la gsol lo mchod do: drag po rngam byed nag po la gsol lo mchod do: srid gsum mnga' bdag 'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal la gsol lo mchod do: driza'irgyal po stag gigadong can la gsol lo mchod do: me lha'i

ga66 mnga' bdag nai tso'i gdong can la gsol lo mchod do:gshin rje'i srog bdag gzig gi mgo can la gsol lo mchod do: srin po'i spyi rje rma bya'i gdong can la gsol lo mchod do: chu lha'i rgyal po dom gyi mgo can la gsol lo mchod do: rlung lha'i mnga' bdag shang shang mgo can la gsol lo mchod do: bdud kyi sgog bdag 'brong gi gde/nga can la gsol lo mchod do:dbang ldan spyi rje gser mig mgo can la gsol lo mchod do: lha chen tshangs pa 'od brgya'i 'khyud pa la gsol lo mchod do: gshin rje ya manta ka dus btab nag po la gsol lo mchod do:ma mo srid rgyal dbyings phyug chen mo la gsol lo mchod do: bdud po skos rje drang shan dkar 'byed la gsol lo mchod do: btsan rgyal yam shud gdong sprad mig mar la gsol lo mchod do:rgyal po be har sku lnga blon bdun la gsol lo mchod do:gnod sbyin ka la rū tra'i snying 'byen la gsol lo mchod do: klu bdud mgo dgu mig stong ldan pa la gsol lo mchod do:sprul 'khor bye ba sa ya 'bum sde la gsol lo mchod do: sangs

rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig:sems can la bde skyid spel zhig: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig:dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo bskyed cig:rnal 'byor ba'i sku tshe bsring shig:gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shig:sbyin bdag la mnga' thang bskyed cig:chos mthun gyi bsam pa sgrubs shig dgra byung na mtshon thob cig:bgegs g.yo na sma phob cig: nad byung na rtsi gsol zhig:byad sdang na rang gshed du phob cig: chos 'khor dang gtsug lag skyongs shig: bye nang gi nyer 'tshe bzlog cig:tshe dpal dang 'byor ba bskyed cig:nyams rtogs dang yon tan stsol zhig:tshe sgrub la gegs med mdzod cig:don gnyis kyi dpal kha phun tshogs: mi ring bar myur du sgrub pa'i:'dod 'bras gang mchis par mdzod cig:ho: gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po srin mo dang b.re/sa pa'i sras: drag rtsal thog las che ba: myur mgyogs rlung las zab pa:dgra sha zas su za ba: dgra khrag skom du 'thung ba: dgra snying hur mid rol ba:pho rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa:mo rgyud drung nas 'byin pa:byis pa mngal nas skems pa:

bas/rnya sgrub la gdung sems che ba: sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa: rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogs mo: bka' gter gnyan gyi bdag mo: a tsa ra nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sring mo: ma yam thams cad kyi gtso mo: dur khrod ha he bzhad pa'i dga' tshal la dbang bsgyur ba'i ma mo gsod byed chen mo la gsol lo mchod do:sku sprul dkar mo bcu drug la gsol lo mchod do: gsung sprul dmar mo sbun dgu la gsol lo mchod do: thugs sprul lha mo mched brgyad la gsol lo mchod do: yon tan ser mo nyer brgyad la gsol lo mchod do: brin las ljang mo drug cu la gsol lo mchod do: 'dod ster dbang sdud lha mo la gsol lo mchod do: dus 'dzin lha mo mched bzhi la gsol lo mchod do: thog 'bebs rdo rje ma drug la gsol lo mchod do: gar dbang khros ma spun gsum la gsol lo mchod do: dmag gi rgyal mo mched lnga la gsol lo mchod do: sbas pa'i ma mo bco brgyad la gsol lo mchod do: ḍakki brgyad cu rtsa gcig la gsol lo mchod do: sman mo bdun brgya nyi shu la gsol lo 'bul lo mchod do:

ho: bdud kyi rgyal po sman btsun chen po dang bshos pa'i bu mo: zhing nyer gcig gi bcud bsrung ba: lha khams su nyul ba'i me tog manta ra ba: gnyan khams su rgyu ba'i dung gi gdu bu can: klu yul la 'phyo ba'i klu mo mdzes 'bar dbang mo: stong pa chos sku'i dbyings su ro gcig tu bzhugs pa: mnyam nyid rol pa'i cho rol du ma ru bsgyur ba: dgra la za rngam che zhing hab rgyug byed pa: bgegs la nga ro khros shing rkan sgra sdeb pa: brda dang bshud pa gar la khrong nger nyan pa: sgrub gnas gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyan la 'dud pa: nyams pa can gyi srog snying dum bur gtub pa: nyes byed mkhan la bka' chad sna dgu 'bebs pa: legs nyes bslu ba med par drang por gnas pa: 'dod yon longs spyod char chen dus su 'babs pa: yar phyed tshe 'di'i phan bde 'bad med stsol zhing: mar byed bsgom bsgrub phyi ma'i don kun grub mdzad: sngags bdag 'bum phrag bco brgyad yongs kyi sprul gzhi: dur khrod phu lung nag po'i dpal 'byor la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'ibadud mo snying 'byen chen mo la gsol

gtsa/ lo mchod do: sku sprul bzhin bzang mdzes sman la gsol lo mchod do: gsung sprul chags spyod gcig gam la gsol lo mchod do: thugs sprul mon mo tril sna la gsol lo mchod do: yon tan ratna'i phreng mdzes la gsol lo mchod do: phrin las dpal 'bar dbang mo la gsol lo mchod do:mkha' la lding ba'i ma drug la gsol lo mchod do: sa la 'dzul ba'i sring lnga la gsol lo mchod do: lung bstan srid pa'i bu mo la gsol lo mchod do: gar dbang bdud rtsi 'bebs ma la gsol lo mchod do:chags 'bar bde ba'i dbang mo la gsol lo mchod do: rol rtsed mkhas pa'i ma mo la gsol lo mchod do:rnam rol bsgyur ba'i gnam sman la gsol lo mchod do: kun kyang las dang 'jig rten ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs su gyur pa thams cad la gsol lo 'bul lo mchod do: sa: btsan po mjes byed 'bar ba klu mo dang bshos pa'i bu mo: sha za 'bum gyi gtso mo: sgrub pa po yi grogs mchog: rin chen gter gyi srung ma: bsil ba tshal gyi gnyer 'dzin: nye ba'i chas ha yi

bcud skyongs: bden bral mun pa can gyi dkor srung: rdzu 'phrul rlabs shugs stobs ldan chen mo: sgrub pa po la brtse sems che ba: dam tshig can gyi bka' la nyan pa: nyams pa mkhan gyi srog dbug sdud pa: sgrub po'i zas dang nor la gdung ba: rlung sems ting 'dzin drod tshad nyul zhing: phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub cing:sha za sman phran gnam sman gtso mo: drag stsal can gyi pho nya'i gtso mchog: dur khrod mun nag gtum drag rol pa'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i lha mo ngas nus ma la gsol lo mchod do: sku sprul rdzas la dgyes pa'i ngan ne ma la gsol lo mchod do: gsung sprul dam la gdung ba'i ngan ne ma la gsol lo mchod do:thugs sprul dbyings la dgongs pa'i ngan nee ma la gsol lo mchod do: yon tan nor la re ba'i ngan ne ma la gsol lo mchod do: phrin las zas la ngan pa'i ngan ne ma la gsol lo mchod do: dpal khros ma'i bka' nyan ka li nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: dbyings phyug rgyal mo'i dam 'dzin dpal ldan nag mo la gsol lo mchod do:

badzra: rdo rje gar bsgyur ma'i bstan skyongs g.ya' sman nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: phrin las dus kyi gnyer 'dzin nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi rang mdangs ro langs nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: bde stong sgyu ma'i rang mdangs spyan mig khrag 'byil nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: dgra srog khong du rol byed mun pa gting 'byin la gsol lo mchod do: khams gsum rdul du brlag pa'i dbang mo rol byed nag mo la gsol lo mchod do: dpa' bo gar gyi las byed rdo rje bzhad pa ber nag can la gsol lo mchod do: srid pa rab 'degs rin chen shugs 'chang la gsol lo mchod do: rmongs pa'i chags bral padma mdzes legs la gsol lo mchod do: gdug pa rtsad gcod zu ra ra skyes la gsol lo mchod do:lha yi bu mo bdun brgya bdun cu la gsol lo 'bul lo mchod do: ho lha chen ye shes dpal yas grags pa rgyal ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje mtsho skyid dang bsdodas pa'i bu mo: srog dam tshig la gnas pa: zas sha khrag la dgyes pa: las sbyor sgrol la brtson pa: snying

rnam 'byer la rtse ba: brnag dgra bgegs la rngam pa: gnas chos 'khor la brten pa: yul 'byung khams la rgyu ba: dkor yongs rdzogs kyi gnyer 'dzin: dgra mgo gnon kyi dpa' bo: bgegs rdul du brlag pa'i shan pa: dur khrod dang gtsug lag chos 'khor yongs kyi dpal la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i sha za ḍakki kha mo che la gsol lo mchod do: sku sprul bzhad pa rtsal la gsol lo mchod do: gsung sprul padma lcam mo la gsol lo mchod do: thugs sprul rdo rje bde 'bar la gsol lo mchod do:yon tan phun tshogs grub pa mo la gsol lo mchod do: phrin las dpal ldan bsngags pa mo la gsol lo mchod do: lha mo ka ti bum pa can la gsol lo mchod do:klu mo ratna thod rgyan can la gsol lo mchod do: gnod sbyin mdzes ma khyungs thog la gsol lo mchod do: bdud lcam khri za stong sgol la gsol lo mchod do: grub pa can gyi bdag mo can la gsol lo mtshod do: sngags mkhan mo yi grogs mo la gsol lo mchod do: a tsar dgyes bskyed ma mo la gsol lo mchod do: tshangs pa'i bu mo

badzra cha bzhin legs la gsol lo mchod do: mdza' grogs spel ba'i ma drug la gsol lo mchod do: sha za ḍakki nyi rdul 'khrigs pa'i grangs mnyam chos rnal 'byor gtsug lag srung ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo rnams la gsol lo 'bul lo mchod do: dgyes rab kyi mchog: mnyes rab kyi phud dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig: dang po bka' lhar ma bgyis pa: bar du gzhung lhar ma bsgrub pa: tha ma tshul bzhin ma srung ba: ma zla zhag dus kyi bka' dam las 'das pa: chags nyams 'gal 'khrul zhig ral du gyur ba thams cad mthol lo bshags so: mi dbul nor gyi dngos grub btsan phyug stobs kyi dngos grub: drag rtsal mthu yi dngos grub: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub: mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub: dam pa chos kyi dngos grub: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol: gnod pa'i bgegs la rtsal ma zhan: za ba'i 'dre la stobs ma chung: 'jigs pa brgyad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: 'byor ba drug puṣṭi ku ru ye swā hā: mos pa bzhi wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: log 'dren 'byung po mā ra ya ku ru ye swā hā:

'byor rgyu rkyen 'dzom zhing gza' skar 'phrod: phun sum tshogs par bya ba'o:de nas mnga' gsol 'bul ba ni:hūṃ trī: gdod nas rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings:ka dag dri ma bral ba ye shes skur: gnyis med ro gcig mngon par byang chub pa'i:gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyid du mnga' gsol lo:lhun grub bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las:'gags med bde 1nga thig le nyag gcig sku:zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i 'ub chub pa'i:longs spyod rdzogs mdzad nyid du mnga' gsol lo:thugs rje'i phrin las cir yang ma 'gag pa: zhing khams gnas yul kun gyi bdag po dza rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags brjod gnyer gtad pa'i: sprul pa rmad byung dam par mnga' gsol 31: gdug pa'i dpa' che ngas sde brgyad bran du bkol:bla med a ti'i bstan pa 'dzin bsrung spel: rgyal dbang padma'i bka' dam srog tu 'chang: dam can yongs kyi rje bor mnga' gsol lo:dga' na gdod ma'i sangs rgyas sa la sbyor:khros pa'i srid pa ru bzlog g.yo 'khrug ston:legs nyes stangs 'dzin srid zhi'i sa mkhan ste:'khor 'das yongs kyi byed por mnga' gsol

des/: lo: sangs rgyas bstan dgra'i steng snying mngon sum 'byin: zhing bcu'i dgra sde rno gcod ral gris gtubs: bye ba phrag brgya'i gtsug lag chos 'khor bsrung: mtha' yas gnyer 'dzin mchog tu mnga' gsol lo: rbad pa'i yul snang skad cig thal bar rlog: bsam pa'i 'bras bu bde blag nyid du smin: smon pa'i gsol btab chud mi za bar stsol: rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogs por mnga' gsol lo: lha la dbang bsgyur lha dmag bu yug 'tshubs: sde brgyad bran bkol dregs tshogs las la 'gyed: klu la dbang thob gnyan gtod klu yis 'dud: srid gsum pho nya'i rje bor mnga' gsol lo: dus kyi ru 'dzing bskal pa'i g.yo 'khrug yang: lta stangs rnam 'gyur rol pa'i sod chud byed: dpa' bzhad skan sgras dgra dpung drungs nas 'byin: skyid pa'i 'byung gnas dam par mnga' gsol lo: sgrub la nyer 'che'i gtsen tshe zug rngu 'joms: nyams snang bde sdug ri mo thabs kyis bsal: legs nyes gang byung bstan pa'i lung byang spel: dam ldan snying gi grogs por mnga' gsol lo: gnyer

bcol dpa' zasaltang 'dzin mchod pa'i sprin: stobs ldan dpa' bo khyod la gus 'bul na: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por bzhes rol nas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ston stsol: nam mkha'i mthar mnyam skye 'gro sems can kun: las nyon sgrib pa'i dri ma dang bral phyir: rnal 'byor bdag gi gdul byar rab gyur te:phyir mi 17ga pa'i sa la —1ra bar regag: ces brjod phud skyems gtsang sar gshegs gnad kyis phrin las gang bcol 'grub: sa ma yā de nas 'khrug mkhon rtags byung tshe: bskang ba 'di la nan tu brtson:he kṣa: dbang chen gsung gigar 'dzin dme ru rtse: dgyes bskyed yum dang sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas: dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la brtan par bzhugs: phrin las myur du sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtshos thugs dam bskangs: sha khrag ja chang skyems kyis thugs dam bskangs: 'dod yon ma tshangs med pas thugs dam bskangs: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangs: 'khu ba'i rkyen byang tshangs par mdzad du gsol:

ba:tshu ldog pa'iskyon bral byams brtses bu bzhin skyongs: gdug pa'i nyams zhi bde legs 'byor ba spel rtsub mo'i sems dben 'jam dal drang pos skyobs: bdag rmongs nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog stsol dgra sod bgegs dpung thul: rnal 'byor 'di dang phyi ma'i 'dod 'bras kun: dzags med yid bzhin 'khru1ba pa'i phrin las mdzadad: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces pas grangs bsogs phrin las bcol: 'khu ldog rkyen byang byams brtses skyongs: ma gcig bu la brtse sems kyis dam tshig dus bab gdon mi za sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya yem: rgyal b.lidabang po padma thod phreng ngas: ma 'ongs 'gro la shin du brtse sems kyis: phyag rgya zil gnon bdud dpung rtsad gcod sgo shin tu zab pa man ngag mthil gcig bu grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog mikhyod la sbyin da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims: mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdom klu bdud btsan la zab mo'i gnyer byang gtod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: grub pa'i dbang phyuganus ldan rdo dzodang: 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyongs spel bka' bab nyer lngas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'jug bstan pa'i 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung gdul bya

'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god: 'gro don ya mtshan che ba'i rten 'brel yod:zab bcud thub par srungs shig dmar po lnga: bka' log lag tu ma shor a the rgya: las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bstan srung dmar po lha lnga'i zab sgrub sbu gri 'bar ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu rgya 37 rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka':bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud kyis bskul ba dang/lung zin dharmā kirti'i gsung rten rin po che bzhengs pa'i dam bca' rdzas thabs shes rdor dril lha reg dri bral bkra shis shog dkar gtsang ma zhabs pad brtan pa'i skyes bcas yang yang bskul ba dang:chos bdag dharma'i mtshan can gyis kyang de ltar du bskul ba rnams rtags dang rten 'brel bzang po ru shes nas kho bo nusaldan bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brta zab mo dag par phab pa'i gnas bkra shis ca ri ṭa sku gsung thugs kyi gsang mdzod chen po'i klong dkyil mi 'gyur mchod sdong brtsegs pa'i mdun nas lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i spel ba dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/legs jo / sarba maṅga le/
pa( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi: phyi sgrub dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gsaX na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: rgadza/'gabyugarnamarta rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi phrin las gcig bsdus padma 'byung: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i spro bsdu bcas: bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol:las ldan sgrub la snying rus can tshe 'dir zhe 'dod chung ba dang: 'jig rten phyi ma'i don gnyer mkhan: skal ba bzang po re mchis na: de yi bgo skal snying nor ni: man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor bstan sa ma yā:deyang dben gnas byin chags pa rgyal ba gong mas byin rlabs pa'i rgyu 'grul nyer 'tshe dben pa dza phyin nas sde brgyad dregs can la sa bslang yon 'bul phrin las bcol: bgegs rnams 'bras chan glud kyis brngan: bsrung ba'i ra gur rim brgyad phub: khrus dang gtsang sbra nan du bya: maṇḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa'i: lte bar gu ru'i sku gzugs bkod bum pa bhasto shel rdo dang sgog gi 'khor lo ma nyams pa sgrub gtor nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas sman gtor rakta ga ṇa tshogs phyi nang mchod pa rgya chen bkram yid 'ong shin tu mdzes par bya: rnal 'byor blo sems bag phab te: bde ba'i stan la dang bar gnas 'dor ba'i chos la zhen pa log mi rtag skyo shes chen pos bskul: sdug bsngal khrims las dbyung thabs 'bad: sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma ni: 'khor 'das byed por 'dren pa'i dpal: ye shes mnyam gnas chen po na nges par shes pa'i dad gus kyis don gyi sgrub pa

—4(6 zab mo 'dir: yang dag 'jug pa shin tu gces sa ma yā: 'di la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum sbyor ba rnam grangs bdun gyis bstan: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo blo bral gnyug ma ye dag chos sku'i ngang: lhun grub 'ub chub ye shes yon tan mdzod: ma rtsal rdzogs ldan mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings: spros bral rig pa rjen pas skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems mchog bskyed pa ni: ho: rten 'brel 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du 'phyangs: ma rig las nyon zug rngus rtag tu mnar: bde 'dod sdug sgrub bsam spyod phyin log rnams: kun bzang sa la 'god phyir sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: na mo: bcing grol las 'das rig sa chos kyi sku: mtshan 'dzin blo bral rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor 'das spang blang las 'das chos mchod 'bul: ma rig gnyis snang dri kun dbyings su bshags: ma bcos dag mnyam chen por rjes yi rang: rang grol 'gag med ye shes chos 'khor bskor: 'gag med zang thal gnyug ma rjen par bzhugs: dus gsum dge bsags ka dag 1nga du brdal: 'khor 'das zlum 'khyil dbyings ye rdzogs pa cher: ngo

mtshar gdod ma'i mgon po'i sa thob shog: bzhi pa bgegs bskrad rim pa ni: hūṃ hrī: ma rig las skyes khams gsum 'khrul ba'i gdon: 'dod yon rnam dag rang grol rol pa'i brngan: ye shes gsang ba chen por rdul brlag nas: rig stong rdo rje'i rwa bar 'da' med gtams: hūṃ hūṃ sarba bisno ghatstsha phaṭa: hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab: lnga pa bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūṃ hrī: 'khor 'das lha 'dre blta ba thams cad sems: sems ni 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por blta: dug gsum 'khrul ba'i rtog pas glag mi rnyed: don dam snying po'i srung 'khor gzhom zhig bral: ma dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakta tt+waṃ: drug pa byen chen 'bebs pa ni trī hrī: skye med ka dag gtsug ma'i pho brang nas: dgongs rgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: 'gag med 'od gsal bde ba chen po nas: brda brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: rang grol mnyam nyid stsol bral chen po nas: snyan brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: 'dod 'byung bsam 'phel dgongs pa'i pha phog 'bebs: gter brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig: gang la gang 'dul phan bde'i nyi ma mchog:

gas/ brgyud ldan bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig: rang rig 'od gsal dag pa'i thig le nas: pad 'byung lo paṇa rgya mtshos byin phob cig: byin rlabs mkha' la thugs rje'i nyi ma shar: dngos grub sprin 'khrigs bde stong sbrang char 'bebs: dad ldan gdul bya myu gu smin mdzad pa'i: rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: gdul bya'i ma rig dri kun sangs ba dang: nyams rtogs yon tan rgya mtshos rgyas thob la: chos zad blo 'das chen po'i dgongs pa spor: 37 badzra sa ma ya dza a we sha ya a ā: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin dbab ni: ka hrī: gzung ba rnam dag chos dbyings ka pā lar: 'dzin pa rang grol snod bcud 'dod yon kun: rig stong rjen grol phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: kun bzang dag mnyam chen po'i rgyan du shar: 6/ badzra sba ra ṇa dza: sngon 'gra'i rim parsārgya:sa ma yā: —14 gnyis pa dngos gzhir rnam grangs bcu dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: 33 chos sku mi 'gyur ka dag spros mtha' bral: ā: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rang gsal 'gag pa med: :: thugs rje ye shes sprul sku stsol med shar: hrī: thabs shes zung 'jug 'khor

'das yongs kyi srog: sa ā:hūṃhrī:badzra sa ma dhi /: gnyis pa wa bskyed rim pa ni:hrī:stong nyid mkha' la ye shes snang ba'i gzugs: ma 'dres rang gsal zhing bkod phun tshogs dbus: gdos bral 'od snang gzhal med khang mdzes nang:rnyogs bral mdangs ldan dri med ko sha'i mtshor: chags bral pad sdong lo 'dab gyes pa'i khar: rig pa'i ngo bo hrī:yig 'phro 'dus zhu: bdag lus 'dzin med 'od gsal dngas ma'i sku: a tsarya gache na dkar gsal 0〈byem mdzes bzhad: bcu drug nyams 'bar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan zung mkhar gzigs dbu sgra thor cog bcing: thod skam rab brgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur: rus pa'i rgyan dang ratna'i phreng ba mdzes: snyan cha gdu bu padma'i do shal mdzes: dar dmar e rag ljang sngon dpyangs pa spras: rol pa'i stabs bzhugs mcho rgyal yum dang 'khril:dkar mo gcer bu mdzes 'dzum lang tshos 'khyud:gnyis med bde sbyor byang chub sems 'od spro: phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyar:gru mor thod rnga bkal ba'i rang sgra yis: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul

bsnye tsu 'khrigs bzhin sdud: g.yon pas bde stong bhandha bdud rtsi brten: ging dang ma tshogs ḍakki 'khor du 'gyed: 'ja' 'od 1nga bzhugs ye shes sgyu ma'i sku:spyi bor pad 'byung snang srid zil gnon gsal: gnyis med thig le nyag gcig rol pa las: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga'i gzi 'od kyis: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: bla rgyan pad 'byung yab yum rnam pa dza spyan drangs gnyis med bde ba chen por bsre: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni: hūṃ hrī: snyeng dbus mi shig rnga yab dpal gyi ri: lnga ldan 'od gsal lhun grub padma 'od: mi shig thig le 'pho med da la nas: rang byung rig skuphan rgyan padma 'byung ro mnyam sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i 'khor tshogs bcas: gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma med kyang ye shes gar: gang 'dul gdul bya'i myu gu smin grol phyir: dbyings nas spyan 'dren bu la byin gyis rlobs: nub med rig stong 'od gsal nyams rtogs sbor: zung 'jug 'ja' sku 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: bla badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni:
