hrī: thugs rje lcags kyus drangs ba'i ye shes pa: byam pa'i zhags pas dam tshig rten la bstims: dga' ba'i sgrog gis gnyis su med par bsre: btang snyoms dril bus 'khor ba dong sprugs re ga: sa/ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal bya ba ni: na mo: skye 'gags spros pa'i mtshan ma kun dang bral: rang byung ye rdzogs rgyal ba kun gyi gsang: mtshan ma med pa don dam snying po'i lhar: ngo mtshar lta ba dag pas phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo shrī na ma ho: drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ chen med rnam dag nyer spyod bdun dang ni: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: dug gsum klong grol sman gtor rakta'i bcud: mtshan bcas rtog bsgral mtshan med bde bar sbyor: bcu drug rol rtsed rdo rje'i rig ma dang: khams gsum bkod pa blo bral chen po dzas dbyings las bton te ye shes dbyings su 'bul: gnyis med rol pa chen por dgyes bzhes nas: gsang gsum gnyug ma'i yon tan dpal bskyed nas: tshe 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la sbyor: sgo ma hā panyu 8 dza khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūṃ hrī: ma bcos spros bral chos

gas/ sku kun tu bzang: kha sbyor bdun ldan longs sku rdo rje 'chang:mnyam nyid 'ub chub sprul sku padma 'byung: sku gsum dbyer med rje la phyag 'tshal bstod:mngal gyis ma gos padma'i sbubs las 'khrungs:rus rigs las 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku: skye 'chi mi mnga' tshe yi rig 'dzin grub:mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs la bstod:mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya dzasarmad byung rnam sprul mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i:mdo dang sngags kyi bstan pa'i chos char 'bebs:gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi gasku 'dren mdzad dam pa'i zhal:thugs mchog mi nub yi dam rgya mtsho'i gsang:gsung gsang mi 'gags dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i brda: rtsa gsum 'byung gnas mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod:'di bzung ji srid gdod ma chos sku'i bar:dri med mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes bzung nas: nyams rtogs rig pa'i rtsal 'byong bskyed rdzogs gom:bden gnyis mthar thug 'bras bu khong chub nas: mi ldog ye shes btsan sa zin par shog: de ma thob bar gnyis snang dri ma yis:las nyon bag

chags dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon: ci bgyis gnong zhing 'gyod pas sems kyis bshags: badzra sa ma ya āḥ yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol bya: brgyad pa 'dzab kyi 'brul 'khor ni: hūṃ hrī:snang stong zung 'jug bla ma yab yum sku'i: thugs gar gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor ga'u rtsa rig pa hrī:la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khor 'das srog la dbang thob cing: he ru ka dpal sku gsung thugs mchog dang: gnyis med dgongs pa mngon gyur bde ba che: ma badzra gu ru padma a tsarya bho dhi tsitta sarba ྅:yengs med ting 'dzin don la gnas rig stong gsang ba'i ga'ur gtad: bcing grol 'dzin zhen med par skyongs rtags mtshan bzang po gegs med 'char: sa ma yā: dgu pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni: lha hrī: sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od zer rab 'phros phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams khyab: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi: dbang byin dngos grub ma lus 'bad med thob: 'od zer mar 'phros 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs: tshe bsod dpal yon 'byung lnga'i dngas bcud bskyil: 'khor 'das yongs kyi sgog la dbang thob cing:

gtsa/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: yin badzra ma hā gu ru a tsarya sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: dgongs pa chos kyi sku ru gsal: lhun grub ye shes spro bsdu 'gyed gang shar rang grol sprul sgur sad gnad kyis nyams rtogs nyi bzhin gsal: dngos grub byin rlabs dpal thob 'gyur: sa ma yā bcu pa las sbyor 'dzab dmigs ni: hūṃ hrī: dbashangs pa mi gasku chos sku'i ngang la gnas: 'od zer 'du 'phro rdo rje'i rol rtsed bsgyur: 'jigs pa'i tshogs zhi stong pa nyid du gyur: nyams rtogs yon tan 'byor rgyas ratna bzhin: snang srid dbang gyur khab len lcags bzhin sdud: dgra bgegs tshar gcod chu dang me 'phrad ltar: phrin las rab 'byams thogs pa med par 'grub: stong khams skus gang 'dzab dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrogs: ma rig 'khor ba ye shes chos skur sad: phyag rgya chen po'i dgongs pa mngon du bya: e badzra ma hā gu ru a tsarya shidzña puṣṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: zhabrul ba med pa ting 'dzin gyis: gang la gang 'dul rol rtsed bsgyur gnad kyis brin las rab 'byams kun: thogs med yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur dngos gzhi'i rim pa:rgya: sa ma yā bye'i rjes kyi rim pa bco lnga las:

dang po mchod cing bstod pa ni: dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying gsum gsum bzlas la lhag chad bskangs: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: thod rnga rol mo'i sgras bskul te: : trī: zhes nub rnga yab gling dbus na: raka srin po yongs kyi rje: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtsug rgyan mchog: gangs can bod kyi skyabs gcig pu: bye ba phrag brgya'i gu ru rje: mtsho rgyal padma thod phreng rtsal: rje 'bangs lo paṇa rgya mtsho dang : dgyes bskyed ye shes mas rgyal bcas: gdung shugs drag pos 'bod bskul na: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: thod rnga snyan pa'i dgra la dgongs: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la rol: sngags tshig glu gar bro la bstod: ma rig gnyis snang dri ma bshags: dam tshig nyam chags dag sangs stsol: skyid sdug legs nyes bzang ngan rtags: bdag la snang ba ci shar yang : re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas: brtse ba chen pos rjes su zungs: sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan brjod:lus la sku yi byin gyis rlobs: ngag la gsung gi dbang chen phob: sems la thugs kyi yon tan spor 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bya btang rikhrod zin pa dang : chos

ba rte brgyad brel lung yul ngan dben: sgrub tshug snying po lon pa dang : gzhan phan byang sems myu gu smin: phyi nang bdud las rgyal ba dang : dus kyi rgud tshogs bsal gyur cig: chos sku mi 'gyur mngon gyur zhing: phan bde'i gzugs sku'i spel bar shog: phyi nang 'byung lnga'i rten 'brel chos: sdud bkrol las kyi mthar gtugs tshe:sems kyi 'khri shing sa ra dzas: mngon gsum snang ba gzugs sku yi: rdo rje'i gar dang brdas bskul nas: mi shig dwangs ma 'od kyi zhing : sku gsum 'dus zhal padma 'byung : ye shes zlum 'khyil tshom bu dza3 mi ldog sa thob dpa' bo yis: sras kyi thu bor dbang bsgyur shog: ces brjod la mos gus mchi ma 'dril ba tsam du bya: khyed shes kyi dad mos drag po bskyed: srid pa las bsgral ba'i gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab: de'i tshe byin rlabs phebs pa'i rtags lus sprid cha chil: ngag glu 'ur 'ur sems phyal chad chad: ye shes gsal rig rig du 'byung ngo pha gcig padmā ka ras rjes su bzung shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags so: lhag par yang dad mos brjed med du bya ba ni gnad do: sa ma yu gnyis pa rdo rje'i tha tshig gis: pho nya las la 'bod pa ni: dkar gtor 'o phud rin chen skyems: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs: rang

nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te: : hrīḥ mi g.yo bde chen badma 'od kyi zhing : lhun 'grub bkod pa rmad du byung ba ni che ba'i stobs rdzogasabla rgyan thod phreng rtsal: brtse ba'i shugs kyis rdo rje'i dam dgongs la: mtha' dmag dus 'khrug bzlog pa'i dus la bab: hrī ༷ rab dkar 'od brgya'i zer chen g.yo ba las: dpal ldan padma'i phrin las bstan 'gro'i mgon: chos skyong dam can yongs kyi gtsug na spa byang chub sgrub pa po yi grogs gcig pu: myur mgyogs stobs rtsal ldan pa'i dgra bla ni: 'dzam gling skyongs ba'i nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal: dkar dmar 'dzum sgeg brjid nyams lang tshos 'khyud: phyag g.yas dgra 'dul mdung dar dkar po phyar: lha min g.yul bzlog lha yi dmag dpung 'tshubs: g.yon pa 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum pa bsnams: chos mdzad yongs la 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang 'bebs: khrab rmog 'khor gsum rgyan cha mdzes par klubs: bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra sde brlag par byed: dar ber ratna'i rgyan cha sna tshogs spras: khams gsum dbang sdud rgyal po rol stabs tshul: gsang gos sngon po lcags phur rked la brten: rdo

ba:tshu rje'i theg pa 'dzin srung spel bar byed:rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rkyang dmar 'phur shes bcibs:khams gsum yud kyi bskor ba'i dgra bla che:me rlung 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong na 'gying :che btsan srid pa gsum na mtshungs dpe bral:las mdzad skyes bu sum cu rtsa bdun 'gyed:phyogs bzhi'i dmag dpung drung 'byin brlag par byed:thog ser glog 'khyug 'brug sgras sa gsum g.yo:ma rung byad ma'i snying 'byin klad rgya 'thor :khro chung mda' thun phag sdig me khyung 'phro:dus kyi 'byung po gdon rgod 'dul bar byed:dpa' bo gar dbang rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal:sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po las bzhengs te:mkha' la skar tshogs bkra 'dra'i dpung dang bcas:bde chen padma 'od 'bar da la nas:skad cig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:ma gdung bu la brtse 'dra'i byams shugs kyis:sgrub por zhal ston snying nye phrin las sgrubs:sha khrag gtor skyems mchod pas dgyes pa bskangs:yar phyed tshe 'di'i phyin bde rgyas par mdzod:dkar gsum mngar gsum chang phud sman gyis bskangs :mar phyed sgom sgrub phyi

ma'i don grub nas: longs spyod sha khrag ri ltar spung te bskangs: smon log mtha' yi dmag dpung zhi zhing gzhom: bhanta bdud rtsis bskang ba'i mchod pas bskangs: rgyal bstan nub med srung ba'i brin las mdzod: g.yab dar bla rdo sgog gi 'khor los bskangs: rdo rje'i theg pa yangs pa'i tha grur spel: go khrab mda' mdung mtshon chas thugs dam bskangs: dam log bstan dgra'i sgog rtsa rbad kyis chod: 'gags med dbyings las shar ba'i mchod pas bskangs: bslu brid rgyal bsen rgya 'dre'i za kha phrol: dar dmar li khri zangs kyi lcags kyus bskangs: 'gro blo chos la 'god pa'i mnga' thang bskyed: rnga dung sil snyan rol mos thugs dam bskangs: gzhan snang zil gnon nus mthu phun tshogs bskyed ma tshang med pa 'dos kyis thugs dam bskangs: ma rung dus kyi g.yo 'khrug mtha' dag sol: mnyes bskang drag po e yi mchod pa 'bul: las bzhi gang brtsam thogs med grub par mdzod: 'khor 'das ro mnyam bde ba chen pos bskangs: nyon mongs ru bzlog tshe gcig sangs rgyas mdzod: nyon mongs rang grol 'dzin zhen dag pas bskangs:

gtsa/ sgrub dus dngas ma'i 'ja' sku grub par mdzod: mtshan ma med pa 'od gsal dag pas bskangs: gnas lugs kun bzang rgyal sar byang chub mdzod: lhag bsam dge ba'i spron 'bras gang btab pa: gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mchog: rdo rje padma'i gar bsgyur seng chen rjes: 'bad med myur bar gang ga'i rgyun bzhin stsol: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: ces ka ma tha la ra tsa na sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul mnyes pa bskangs: phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: ma da na dang me sa sogs: bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams bsags: chang chu nang mchod sman gyis gso: rnam par rtog pa ma bsres par: byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ni: āḥchos dbyings dang mnyam rang byung ka pā lar: snod bcud 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rol bar dmigs: zag med zag bral kun bzang mchod sprin gyur: a āḥhūṃ: bzhi pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūṃ hrīḥ rang byung 'od snang lhun grub dpal gyi ri: rdzu 'phrul gar gyi rol rtsed srin po'i grong : ma skyes brjod

bral ye shes gzhal med khang : gnyis snang zil gnon pad nyi zla steng nas: bde gshegs 'dus zhal rang rig padma 'byung : mnyam nyid rol pa 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas:zhen med rang grol 'du ba tshogs la gshegs: gnyis med zlum 'khyil bde ba chen por bzhugs: dmigs med byang chub sems kyi tshogs chen la: rol rtsed gar bsgyur bde mnyam stobs chen pos: rtsa gsum dam can chos nyid rol par bskangs: lnga pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūṃ hrīḥ skrang blang med pa 'dod yon ro mnyam tshogs: ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i 'phrul rtsed bsgyur cir yang ma 'gags kun tu bzang po'i sprin: rmad byung rdo rje gsang ba'i dbyings su 'bul: yin ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: drug pa bstod cing bshags pa ni: ho dpang gyur skyabs mchog rdo rje'i bla ma dgongs: bdag rmongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur ma rig nongs: sor byang sngags kyi dam sdom nyams pa kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shukhye āX bdun pa bsgral bstab bya ba ni: / bye ma rig lenag 'khrul khams gsum 'khor ba'i gdon: bdag med shes rab mtshon cha

gas/: 'bar bas bsgral: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i zhal du bstabs: 'khrul bral rig pa chos skur byang chub shog : dṛḥtram̐rū tra mā ra ya phaṭa: sarba pu dza khā hi:brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' nyan mkha' la 'gro: zhing khams gnas yul nyul zhing bstan pa srung : sgrub pa'i drod 'dzin dbang phyug ma sring tshogs pham phab lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'bul nas ni: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams kun: thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig: sa ma ma hring hring ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūṃ hriḥ bzhengs shig bde gshegs rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha: bskul lo snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs bcom pa dang: mdzod cig phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmag bstan dgra sod: bzhes shig brngan pa'i mchod gtor dgyes par rol: sol cig sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mtha' dag bzlog: stsol ba'i smon pa'i 'bras bu myur 'grub mdzod: bcu pa chad tho brtan ma ni: bhyoX rdo rje rgyal po bde bar gshegs pa yi: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dregs pa can: sde dpon sum cu dmar po lha lnga dang : dregs

chen bco brgyad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi sde brgyad dang : 'dzam gling skyongs mdzad ma yam bstan ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bod khams dkar po chos kyis 'tsho ba dang : nad yams dus 'khrug rgud pa mtha' dag sol: sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang : nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar bskyed: tshe sgrub mthar phyin dngas ma'i 'ja' sku 'grub: mi ldog gdod ma'i rgyal sar skyel ma mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: babyu gcig rta dro bya ba ni hūṃ hrī ༷ rang bzhin mnyam nyid chos dbyings eXklong du: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom la bar gcod pa'i: ma rig las nyon dam sri 'byung po brub: mnan no ldang med ye shes rol pa'i rgya: sa/ āḥhūṃ swa hā: tswa bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: tri tri khung thum dza rbad nan nan: brgya gnyis bzod gsol bya ba ni: ho0 ye shes dbyings las 'phrul ba'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag rmongs las nyon 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin ma gsal rdzas ma tshang : lhag chad nor 'khrul gang mchis bzod par gsol: badzra sa ma ya

ba tshu bhi shukhye āḥ bcu gsum bsngo ba smon lam ni: ho bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i rnal 'byer dge rtsa gang : 'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings chen por bsngo: mi gnas mi dmigs sku gsum rgyal sa nges 'ub chub bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal thob regag: bcu bzhi rtag chad mtha' bsal ni:āḥ mnyam nyid ka dag dbyings las bskyed pa'i lha: blo 'das chos sku de bzhin nyid du.āḥ gsal snang 'gag med sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i lha: snang stong zung 'jug ye shes spyod lam bya'o: a ā phaṭa phaṭaḥ bco lnga bkra shis bden brjod ni na mo ka dag dri ma med pa chos kyis dbyings: chags bral snang mtha' yas pa'i bkra shis shog: ma 'gags byams dang snying rje'i rta bdun rgyas: dri bral phyag na padma'i bkra shis thegag:rtsol med thugs rje'i zer 'phos brdzus skyes sku: rang grol mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bkra shis shog: bsil zer bdud rtsi'i dad ldan myu gu smin: lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: mthong thos dran reg rnga yab dpal rir dgod: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: dge mtshan rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho yis: 'dzam gling phyogs kun khyab

pa'i bkra shis sgo ga: thub bstan mdo dang gsang sngags rdo rje ches: skye dgu srid mtha' brgal ba'i bkra shis re/ga: phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan dang sbyin bdag rgyas: bstan 'dzin 'dus sde rab rgyas bkra shis re ga: bsnyen sgrub lhur len skal bzang pho mo yang : thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i bkra shis regag: ces brjod me tog phyogs kun bkram bden tshig gang 'os dge bar brjod: rol mo sna tshogs sgra yis bstod : dge ston rgya chen bya ba dang : dge rtsa bsngo zhing spron lam gdab: gnad des don gnyis lhun gyis grub: spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba 'di: skal bzang dad ldan pho mo yis: kha tsam ma yin snying gting nas: sgrub pa lhun len ma byas na yid bzhin rted pas dbul ba sel: thar lam gru bo bdag ngan ltor: chos brgyad brel lang 'tshubs mas khyer: sangs rgyas byon kyang rang skal chad: byang kyu'i brag phug nyi ma'i dben: bdud rtsi rtsol yang btung mi shes le lo chog shes can skal skems chos kyi nyi mas skyid 'og nas mun pa'i gling du rgod 'phyang byed phrin las rgya mche'i gral dbus nas gcig bsgrod 'khor ba'i lcags kyus zin: de 'drar gyur na snod chag nas: bcud zag rdo rje'i dmyal bar mnar: zhal byang skal ldan snying gtam 'di las can yongs kyis sems la brlan: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: rjes kyis rim pa3/rgya: che'i ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang

btsasdo: po padma thod phreng ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub dbang 'grag mi 'a dotsā khyod la sbyin da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan dpa' bo ni:o rgyan rig 'dzinanus ldan rdo rje dang :'phrad nas zab gsang chos bdag rnams la 'doms:gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god :'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang srung shigadamar po lha lnga po skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya phyi sgrub dngos grub dpal ster rdzogs so:gter rgya:gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu rgya:yi rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dramakhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim:snyi:ces pa 'di'ang lung zinadharma ku mud kyis bskul ba dang:chos bdagadharmā /lta'i thabs shes rdor dril bkra shis shog dkar mdzes pa'i lha reg zhabs pad brten pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang ces pa 'di'ang lung zinabla ma dam ches kyis shin tu dge ba'i rdzas dang bcas nas bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dranus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams bkra shis rdzong gnas nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi: nang sgrub bde stong bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas/mi na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: sto2ja'askoche/rta bde bshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: phrin las gcig bsdus ye shes sku 'gro ba'i mgon po padma 'byung : snying dbus padmo'i ze'u 'brur rol snyigs ma lnga bdo'i smag rum nas skal ba bzang po re mchis na: de yi bgo skal snying po'i nor man ngag bla ma'i sgrub zab bstan: sa ma yā: rig 'jin rgyal ba gong ma yi: zhabs bcag byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa g.ya' gangs rdza brag gangs ljongs sogs rgyu 'grul dben pa'i gnas su phyin dkar phyogs skyongs ba dkar gyis mchod: nag phyogs sde brgyad dmar gyis brngan sa bslang phrin las grogs su bcol: bgegs tshogs 'bras chan glud kyis brngan dpag tshad mang po'i pha mthar bsgrad: bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rim brgyad phub dam sri mnan zhing bcad tho 'dzug phyi nang mtshams srung bde bar gnas khrus dang gtsang sbra nan du bya dkyil 'khor mda' gang zla gam bya ba byung lnga dang dri bzang chu: chag chag gdab cing yid 'ong bya: gsang thod a mṛ skyems bzang po chos sman thabs shes bcud kyis gtams rin chen me long li khri'i byug: chos 'byung zur drug ma nyams par:hrīthahamarnasaX dgod: dkar dmar dar gyis na bza' gsol bde skyongs bhanta'i kha kheb bya steng du sgrub gtor mdzes pa dang : bla rdo sgog gi 'khor lo bkod sman gtor rakta la sogs pa'i nyer spyod 'dod yon bkod pa sprin: rnal 'byor bde ba'i stan la gnas:

gtsa( shes rig ngal bso 'tshubs reg bral: dad mos gdung ba drag po yis zab mo sgo 'dir 'jug par bya: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: sta gon bca' bshams rim pa'o: 27rta sa sgo 'di la sbyor dngos rjesadang gsum sbyor ba rnam grangs bdun gyi bstan dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na moḥ ma skyes brjod bral chos sku snang mtha' yas: lhun 'grub rang gsal longs spyod nam mkha' rgyal:rtsol med blo 'das rta mgrin dbang gi lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed bsgom pa ni: hoḥ ma rig gsum gyi smag rum 'thib po dza las nyon zug rngus mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams: rang grol sangs rgyas sa la 'god bya'i phyir: rig pa 'od gsal ngang nas sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni na moḥ sku dang ye shes dpal la phyag 'tshal lo: zhen med rang grol kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul: kun rmongs ma rig las bsags mthol zhing bshags: dag mnyam rjen grol gshis la rje yi rang :'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i chos bskor bskul: ka dag zang thal klong las 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs 'khor gsum dag par 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang rang rig sku

gsum rtogs par shog: bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūṃ hrī nga ni ma bcos ye rdzogs don gyi lha: dpal chen khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ste: 'di la log 'dren gnas pa'i skal ba med: mchod sbyin bzhes la rang rang gnas su dengs: hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: lnga pa bsrung gabar bsgom pa ni: : hrīḥ chos rnams ye dzadal kun bzang dkyil 'khor la: log 'dren bar chad bgegs kyi ming yang med: 'on kyang glo bur mtshan 'dzin gzhom pa'i phyir: byang chub sems kyis bsrung gur bla na med: dzñā na badzra rakta rakṣa sbyo drug pa byin chen dbab pa ni: sa sku rdo rje 'chang gi byin phob cig: 'gags med zlum 'khyil bde 1nga rol pa nas: longs sku snang mtha' yas pa'i byin phob cig: zang thal 'jin bral ye shes ro mnyam nas: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje'i byin phob cig: ma chags padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas bde mchog hya ṣṭṛ wa'i byin phob cig: rngam brjed rol pa chen po'i dur khrod nas yum mchog rdo rje phag mo'i byin phob cig: tshad med phrin las lhun 'grub dkyil 'khor nas: dpa' bo yab yum ging bzhi'i byin phob cig: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyongs

btsan rnal 'byor grogs mo che: dbang phyug ma sring ko'u seng byin phob cig: rgyal bstan nub med bsrung ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa: pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i byin phob cig: grub rtags dngos grub mtshan ma bzang po ston: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod: ces badzra sa ma yā: a we sha ya a āḥ bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrīḥchos nyid stong pa rang byung snod yangs par: zhen med ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol rtsed gar: phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: ngo mtshar ting 'dzin rol pa'i dga' ston 'gyed: byas ma hā badzra pu dza spra ra ṇa sa: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rtse gar bsgyur: mtshan ma med pa bde sang 'byil: sngon 'gro'i rim pasnyirgya: sa ma yā: 24 gzu / khog phub dpal gyi gzhung bsrang ba dngos gzhi rnams grangs bcu yi bstan: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: blo bral rig stong ngang brkyangs te: cesaḥ byurshas rnams ma skyes brjod bral de bzhin nyid: āḥ rang gsal dag mnyam snying rje kun tu snang :hūṃḥzung 'jug ye shes rtsal las rgyu ru spros: sku gsum mnyam nyid 1nga las 'di don bstan: e āḥhūṃ badzra sa ma dhi ྅: gnyis pa lha bskyed bya ba ni 〉ཿ gzhi dbyings mi shig bde chen

dag pa'i mkhar:lhun 'grub rang gsal zhing bkod phun sum tshogs:tshogs yul gnas dag dur khrod bkod pa rdzogs:ye shes lnga ldan rab mdzes gzhal med khang :chags bral dbang dbyibs zla gam sgo gcig pa:ma rig g.yul bsregs ye shes me lnga 'bar:chos nyid zhi rdzogs nang khang khrag 'thung dal:'khor 'das mnyam nyid rgyan bkod lhun gyis grub:de dbus ma chags padma nyi zla'i khar hūṃḥdamar las spros 'od zer dpag med pas:'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dngas bcud dpal yon bstims:yongs gyur bdag snang rta masprin dbang gi sku:dmar gsal padma rā ga'i gzi 'od 'bar:khro 'dzum sgegs nyams smar smin me ltar 'bar:dmar ser ral pa zlum 'khyil rdo rjes brgyan:thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod pan 'phur:ratna'i snyan cha mgo phreng sbrul chun mdzes:rus pa'i rgyan drug stag gi sham thabs klubs:phyag gnyis gri thod thugs gar bsnol thabs 'dzin:zhabs gnyis he ru ka dpal stabs su bzhugs:gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo ni:mthing gsal rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs 'khril sbyor rol :ral pa

gtsa(7 rgyab 'phyangs sgra gseb phag zhal ngur thod skam ratna'i phreng ba snyan cha mdzes:phyag g.yas ātpal g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin:bde stong zung 'jug chu zla'i rnams rol gsal:spyi bor rigs bdagaphyag rgya zel gnon bskyed:shar du rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum dkar:lho ru rin chen dpa' bo yab yum ser:nub tu padma dpa' bo yab yum dmar:byang du ga dpa' bo yab yum ljang :kun kyang zhi ma khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'bar:g.yas rnams thod rnga g.yon pa dril bu 'dzin:dar dang ratna rus rgyan 'ja' 'od bkra:dar gyi dpyangs pa padma'i do shal mdzes:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur 'ja' 'od sang nas 'gying :yum rnams gcer bu pad phreng bhanta 'dzin:gnyis med zung 'jug bde ba'i rol rtsed bsgyur:de rgyab las mdzad ging chen sde bzhi ni:rus pa'i gzugs can gtum drag me ltar 'bar:dril bu g.yer kha cod paṇa mang pos mdzes:rdo rje'i dam rtags ru dar wa la la:phyag g.yas thod rnga g.yon pas lcags phur gdengs:dar dpyangs 'ja' sham me rlung 'du 'phro 'khrigs:tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul bar byed:

sgo srung rta mgrin nag po khro gtum rngams: mi lpags g.yang gzhi thod skam dbu rgyan mdzes: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas sbrul zhags bsdam: sku smad lcags phur me yi tsha tsha 'phro: bar chad dam sri 'byung po'i snying gar zug bar mtshams dbang phyug ma tshogs rdul ltar 'tshubs: kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: dbang chen hya ṣṭṛ wa'i rnam pa dza sbyan drangs gnyis med badzra sa ma yā: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni:hūṃ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nas bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang : chags bral dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: khro rgyalarta mgrin phag mo sprul 'khor bcas: dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs nas: sgrub pa po la dbang byin dngos grub kun: thogs pa med par dus 'dir stsal du gsol: snyed badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: : hrīḥ rdo rje gsang ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral yang ye shes gar: gnyis med ro gcig chu la chu bzhag

gtsa/ bzhin: gdod nas yongs grub bde ba chen por bzhugs: a badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ lnga pa phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na moḥ rang byung ye shes mtha' bral byang chub sems:mi 'gyur 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i zhal: sku dang ye shes padma dbang gi lhar: gnyis med gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag bgyi'o: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūṃ trīḥkhro chen rig pa'i rgyal po'i brtul zhugs kyis: bdag rtog mtshan ma'i rū tra bsgral ba las: dbang yul phung khams skye mched nang khrol dang: snod bcud 'dod yon rgyan gyi bkod pa kun: ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: dbang chen khros pa ma mo'i tshogs bcas la: gnyis med mnyam pa chen por 'bul lags na: 'ub chub bde ba chen por bzhes rol nas: blo bral chos sku mjal ba'i dngos grub stsol: 31 ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho: bdun pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūṃ trī: rngam pa'i khro rgyal gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dpal:gnyis med bde ba'i rol rtsed phag mo yum: bdud 'dul las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'gyed: padma dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di bzung ji srid gdod ma chos smra'i bar:

'du 'bral med par brtse bas rjes bzung zhing: nyams rtogs rab rgyas sa lam mthar phyin te: he ru ka dpal go 'phang mchog thob shog: gnyis snang dri ma'i nongs pa gang song yang: snying nas 'a༄1da pas bshags so dag tshangs stsol: badzra sa ma ya sdokhre āḥ brgyad pa 'dzab kyi bzlas dmigs ni hūṃḥ rang nyid bla ma drag po'i skur gsal ba'i: thugs gar nyi steng padma sgod phreng stsal: tshon gang rgyan med gcer bu phyed skyil bzhugs: de yi thugs 1nga padma zla ba'i steng: dbang mdog las grub rdo rje nas 'bru tsam: lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor ga'u dza rig pa hūṃḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas ma rig gnyis snang dbyings su bsre: ye shes 'od sku stong gsal 'dzin med gyur: 67 badzra ma hā gu ru padma ta krita hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra wa ra hi sarba sirnyi hūṃ: yengs med ting 'dzin gnad ldan pas: bzlas pa dbugs kyi rta la bskyon 'od zer rdo rje'i rol rtsed bsgyur cir yang 'gag med phrin las kun gegs med dus su 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā dgu pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni: lha hrī: bdag nyid he ru ka dpal skur bsgom pa'i: thugs ga'i sngags phreng rā ga'i gzi 'bar 'khor: thabs mchog dpa' bo bde chen dbyings

badzra kyis bskul: shes rab bde ba'i 'dzab rgyun rdo rjes dbab: padmo 'od 'bar nor bu'i khong seng nas: mi shig sngags kyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba las: dga' ba bzhi bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon gyur zhing: bskur thob bral ba'i spyi blugs dbang chen thob: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags phyag rgya cheḥ gang shar rang grol bde chen rdo rje'i ngang:sgo badzra ma hā gu ru padma ta krid hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra wa ra hi sarba tsaṇḍa surya sidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bde chen rig pa rdo rje che'i: lug brgyud 'od zer 'du 'phro dkrig cir snang rang grol ye shes che: zhen med rang grol dga' bzhi yis: 'od gsal bde klong mngon du 'gyur: sa ma yā: bcu pa las sbyor 'dzab dmigs niḥ shātrīḥ lha gsal sku dang sngags kyi breng ba las: 'od zer me 'od mtshon cha'i tsha tsha niḥ drag cing tsha la rtsub pa dpag med 'phros: gdug sems 'chang ba'i bdud bgegs bsreg gtungs brlag: byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun dang bral: mi mthun phyogs zhi legs tshogs nyams rtogs rgyas: 'khor 'das dbadwa gyur log 'dren drag pos bsgral: rab 'byams phrin las thogs med grub par dmigs: tshod badzra ma hā gu ru padma ta krita hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra

wa ra hi sarba duṣṭan ka la ru pa gnod byed sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: dmigs pa ting 'dzin ldan pa yis: drag sngags me yi tsha tsha 'di bsre bslad bral bar 'bum bzlas na: bdud dpung chas kyang g.yul 'joms 'gyur dngos gzhi'i rim pasnyirgya: sa ma yā: 24 'byu / phrin las las kyi ngar 'dogs phyir rjes rim rnam pa brtso lnga las: dang po 'dzab bsnyen mchod bstod ni dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying gsum gsum bzlas la lhag chad bskangs: de nas rol mo'i sgra bcas teḥ hūṃ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi gzhal yas nas: bdud bzhi zil gnon padma dbang gi lha dbang chen rta mchog rol pa gar dbang sku: gsung chen gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam brjid dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol: tshad med bzhi sgrub phrin las dkyil 'khor nas: dpa' bo dpa' mo ging bzhi gshegs su gsol: bstan pa srung zhing legs nyes ltangs 'dzin pa'i bdud 'dul rta nag gī la gshegs su gsol: ma nyams rnam dag rten 'brel rdzas la bzhugs: lhag pa'i lha mchog khyed la gus phyag 'tshal: zhen 'dzin blo bral ting 'dzin mchod sprin dang rmad byung 'dzab

gtsa/: dbyangs sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul:dgyes bskangs 'bar ba chen po'i gzi mdangs rgyasaḥdam tshig chags nyams nyes lhung sor chud tshangs:sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 1nga la bstodaḥmachog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol:sa badzra ma hā gu ru padma ta krita hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra wa ra hi baṃ haḥriḥniḥsaḥkiṅka sa pa ri wā ra e dam ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi:lan bdun gyis phul mnyes pa bskangs rgyu hrīḥspyan ras gzigs dbang padma dbang gi lha:khro chen gar gyi rgyal po 'khor bcas dgongs:bdag ni rtse gcig yang dag don la mos:dka' ba dang blang ngal ba khyad bsad nas:lus sgog 'ben btsugs bsnyen sgrub lhur len byas:'di snang bor la phyi ma dang du blang:mi med nags khrod sbas mtha' mtsho gling snyegs:gcig pu bya btang ri khrod dben pa la:skyabs dang dpung gnyen re sa gzhan med pasaḥlha khyod thugs rje ma g.yel brtse ba'i dgongs:dngos nyams rmi lam zhal gzigs lung bstan stsol:chags med 'khor ba spang ba'i rnal 'byor bdag:bablu brid mda' lnga'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod:zhen med brtul

zhugs sgom pa'i rig 'dzin bdag: pham rgyal re dogs 'phrang las bsgral bar mdzod: gzhan phan byang chub sems sgom rnal 'byor ngas: bstan 'dza'i phan bde spel nus mthu stobs stsol: o rgyan chen po'ibargyud 'dzin dpa' bo ngas: dus kyi rgud gso rdo rje'i bstan skyongs shog: lha mchog dbang gi rnal 'byor sgrub po ngas: gsang chen sbyor sgol spyod pa mthar phyin shog: ye shes sgyu mar rtogs pa'i rig 'dzin bdag: 'di snang zhig tshe sku gsum sa thob shog: smon lam sems bskyed dag pa'i rnal 'byor ngas: phrin las nub med 'gro khams dong sprugs re ga: u snang ba ma 'gagasadapa' bo dbang chen la: stong pa mnyam nyid gar dbang phag mo yumaḥ gnyis med bde sbyor dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed ste:'gags med gang shar rang 17la sprul pa sgu: zung 'jug rig pa khyab brdal chos sku'i ngang: byargo āḥhūṃ: ces brjod la 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bde 1nga yangs pa gcig shes kun rtog rig pa'i rgyal po'i zhal rjen par mjal bar byas te: bzang rtog gis mi bsre: ngan rtog gis mi bslad bcas bcos dgag sgrub spang blang med par skyongs ba naḥ zang thal g.yo med cig shar ba yi dam lha yi dngos grub kyi drod rtags theb pa yin no: sa

bas/ ma yā:gnyis pa pho nya gsol mchod ni: mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs ni:repogoḥ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed khar: stong gsum rgyar mnyam ka pā la yi nang: bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs rnams kun: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rol bar gyur: sa āhūṃ: lan gsum rjes su spyan 'dren ni:: hrīḥ gtum drag bde chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil gnon ye shes khro bo'i rgyal: hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra gī la ya: dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs la: bskal ngan g.yo 'khrug gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ sgrub mchog phrin las stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: dam tshig rten la brtse ba chen po'i bzhugs: dpa' rtags mdzad pa ston phyir phyag 'tshal lo: yin badzra sa ma ya dza dza dzña na tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: hūṃ hrīḥbastan pa'i dgra sdobadud dpung rdu la brlag pa'i: sha khrag rus pa go ro tsa na dang : ba su ta dang tsitta dmar chen po: 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med pa rtsa sngags dang phyag rgya

teng 'dzin gyis spel nas: rdo rje'i las mdzad rta nag gī la yar: mngon spyod phrin las grub phyir 'bul legs na: dgyes brtses rkan sgra dang bcas bzhes rol nas: gdug pa bdud dgra'i sde tshogs stong par mdzod tī badzra gro tahya ghi wa ka la gī la ya sa pa ri wā ra e dam bā lirha kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul 'dod gsol ni hoḥ bdud dpung zil gdonagyi lha: khro chen rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can: dpal gī la ya'i phrin las nus stobs 'bar ba: dregs pa can gyi pho nya'i dmag tshogs sbran pa: dam ldan la snying nye zhing phrin las sgrub pa: dgra bdud la za rngam che zhing g.yos sbyor shom pa: legs nyes kyis stangs 'dzin par byed pa'i dpal nag po chen po la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rgya che la phud ma nyams pa: rgyan dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum tshang ba: ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i gter chen poḥ rnam pa 'dod pa'i thon tan ma tshang ba med par sprul nas 'bul lo: thugs dgyes shing brtse ba chen pos bzhes nas: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam mkha' la dar bzhin du phyor zhig: sems can

ba:na gyi bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho ltar spel zhig: rnal 'byor ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs pa med par sgrub shig: sbyin bdag la mnga' thang tshe dpal 'byor ba bskyed cig: dgra dpung la bab na thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog cig: bgegs dpung la bab na ming med drungs 'byin mdzod cig: ci dang ci bcol ba'i las rab 'byams myur ba nyid du stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: rol mo dang bcas bstod gsol ni: hūṃ trīḥ dbang drag rol ba bde chen pho brang nas: ye shes sku mchog bdud daphung zil gnon lha: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dregs tshogs pho nyar 'gyed: rta nag gī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba mnyam nyid sku stod khro zhal rngam: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i ral gri mkha' la phyar: dpa' gtum zil gnon sbrul zhags dam du bsdams: lcags ral srid rtser 'khyel la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bstan pa srung ba'i spyan gsum bsgrad: ma rig log 'khrul rab bsgral zhal hom gdangs: bdud bzhi zil gnon mche ba zla ltar brtsigs: 'byung po gzhom bsreg smar smin 'bar la bstod: dug lnga ro

mnyam thod skam dbu rgyan la: ye shes lnga sbyor dar sna'i cod pan 'phur: phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan cha spras: 'dod 'byung ratna'i phreng bas brgyan la bstod:zhen med ro mnyam mi lpags g.yang gzhi dang: kun rtog gnas dag mgo phreng se ral kha: phrin las lhun grub dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: 'gags med rgyan rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku smad 'khor ba dbyings sgrol lcags phur ste: dug gsum rtsad gcod zur dang log gsum ldan: ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i dpa' rtags mdzes: rgyal bsen snying gar gzir la phyag 'tshal bstod: las nyon rag bsregs ye shes me chen 'bar: bka' yi gnyer skyongs pho nya bu yug 'tshub: sgyu 'phrul rol pa ye shes 'od kyi sku: rdo rje'i las mdzad dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byer phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrubs: bka' dang dam las ma g.yer sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs: phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra sde rlog rdo rje theg pa dar rgyas byed phrin las las kyi lha mchog 'di: dam ldan yongs kyis

btsa( gces par zungs: sa ma yuḥ gsum pa chogs mchod 'bul ba la bza' btung ldag gzhib shing tog rigs: sman phor sna tshogs 'du bar bya: khyad par sha chang med mi rung: thams cad 'du bar 'tshogs pa'i tshe: chang chu nang gi bsre bslad bya: byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ni: ā: brdal khyab mtshan rje gas bhanta yangs pa'i nang: bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs rnams kun: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan rol pa nas lha sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgyas sbyangs spel spro: ma āḥhūṃ hrī hoḥ bzhi pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūṃ trī: bde chen padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: chags bral dbang chen gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren na: dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sa badzra sa ma ya dza dza: lnga pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūṃ hrīḥ 'dod yon sna tshogs 'dzom pa bza' bca' tshogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs: zhen med ro mnyam bla med bdud rtsi'i tshogs: rtsa gsum dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: snyen ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: drug pa bshags pa bya ba ni:hoḥ dpang gyur padma gsung gi lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i

dbang gyur te: so byang sngags kyi dam sdom gang 'gal ba: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: 31 badzra sa ma ya shuddhi ā: bdun pa bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: ྅ hrī: ma rig log 'khrul nyon mongs dgra gdon bgegs: rtog bral bde chen rig pa'i rdo rjes bsgral ro mnyam 'ub chub chen por bstab legs na: chags bral bde stong yangs par bzhes su gsol: sarba ྅ tra sha hūṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: ha hi stobs: brgyad pa lhag ma labyul ba ni:hūṃ bye: rdo rje rgyal po bde bar gshegs pa'i bka': bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyongs spel mdzad cing: gsang sngags sgrub pa po yi grogs mo che: dbang phyug ma sring ging lang 'bar ma rnams: 'dir byon pham phab lhag gtor rab bzhes la: phrin las rab 'byams thogs med grub par mdzod: 37 ma ma hring hring ma ma uṣṭi ṭa bha lirnya kha kha kha hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul lo: dgu pa thugs dam gnad bskul ni:hūṃ hrī: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub ma 'gags mtshan rdzogs ye shes sku: thugs rjes bdud dpung zil gnon rta mchog dpal: ma rung 'dul phyir thugs dam gnad nas bskul: brngan pa'i

btsa(: skyems phud mchod gtor 'di bzhes la rgud pa mtha' dag bsal ba'i phrin las mdzod: bcu pa chad tho bstan ma niḥ hūṃ bhyoḥ gsang sngags bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: bka' dang tha tshig srung bar mdzad pa yi: thog mtha' bar gsum rgyal ba'i gnyer bsgos pa'i: sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad dang: phyin nang gsang ba mchog gi sde brgyad rigs: dmar po lha lnga spu gri mched gsum dang: rta nag dgongs 'dus lcags kyi ral pa canaḥ bod khams skyongs mdzad bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams: dam rdzas mchod gtor bshal chu'i skyems bzhes la: phrin las rnams bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: bka' gter bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang : 'dzam gling skye 'gro rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod : nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyur: bstan pa dar rgyas 'dus sde thugs mthun zhing: sbyin bdag 'byor rgyas bde legs dpal 'bar dge: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ brgya gcig rta bro bya ba niX hūṃ hrī0 ye shes zang thal mnyam pa chen po rtsa nyon 'khrul log

par blta ba'i rū tra brubaḥ mnan no sdang med sku lnga'i dbyings su rgya: byang chub snying po'i bar du bro rgyas 'debs: sa ā:hūṃ swā hā stam bha ya nan nan: bcu gnyis bshags pa bzod gsol niḥho: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs: bdag rmongs ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin g.yel zhing dam nyams pa: mi 'chab mi sbed 'gyod sems drag pos bshags: badzra sa ma ya sdokhre ā: bcu gsum bsngo ba smon lam ni: ho: dus gsum kun tu bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun: gcig bsdus 'khor gsum yang dag chen por bsngo: gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen por byang chub zhal: mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku mngon gyur regag: bcu bzhi rtag chad mtha' bsal ni: āḥ snang cha lha sku sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dal: mtha' bral ma bcos thig le nyag gcig ngangaḥ slar yang stong dang thugs rje zung 'brel rtsalaḥ ye shes snang stong rol pa'i spyod lam bya'o: a āḥ phaṭa phaṭaḥ bco lnga shis brjod bya ba ni: hūṃ hrīX chos dbyings zhing du rig pa'i myu gu smin: brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shogaḥ dngos grub dpal bum gsol btab byin rlabs 'bebs: yi dam

0〈2 rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: bde stong dga' bzhis dad ldan nyams rtogs gso: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shogaḥ phrin las nub med gaṅgasne dīn bzhin stsol: pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: sgog mtha' bar gsum kun tu dge byed pa'iḥ zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: rdzogs ldan lang tsho yar tshes ltar 'phel bsaḥ yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'chos ba'i bkra shis rdzogag: de ltar gsol gdab 'bras bu niḥ gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: nyams rtogs gong 'phel 'byor ba rgyas bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyuraḥ rjes kyi rim pa3)rgya: sa ma yāX 24( gzu/ ye ma: rgyal bsladabang po padma 'byung gnasangs ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snying las gces pa'i yang zab rmad byung ba: grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog mi khyod la sbyin: da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims: mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga sprul snying gi bu mchoganus ldan gling gang gis gdams zab rmad byung 'di rnyed nas las ldanatshas bdag nyer lngar bgo skal sbyin: gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god 'gro don nyi ltar gsal ba'i rten 'brel yod: bka' 'di thub par

srungs shig dmar po lnga: bka' log lag tu ma re ra sbu gri gsum: dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya nang sgrub bde stong bum bzang zhes bya ba rdzogs soḥ gter rgya: gtad rgya sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim snyiX ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud kyis bskul ba dang / lung zin dharma kirti'i thabs shes rdor dril bkra shis shog dkar mdzes pa'i lha reg zung 'jug rol ba'i brda yi glegs shing sogs kyi skyes dang sgrub bzhengs kyi me tog dang bcas bskul ba dang: chos bdag bla ma dam chos kyis brda rtags zung du 'jug pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang grogs ratna sa ras nan tan chen po bskul ba rnams rtags dang rten 'brel bzang po ru shes nas bdag 'dra o rgyan nus ldan gling pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo rtog pas bsre bslad med par mdo khams bkra shis rdzong mdun nas sa pho stag lor bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan 'gro la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig:

'a:tshu them med brda yi gab mdzodazhwag:zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi phyi nang gsang sgrub kyi bskang ba dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs dres: rmi: na mo gu ru padmā ka ra ya:01rwa11spyo rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: phrin las gcig bsdus thod phreng rtsal: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can: snying dbus pabye'i ze'u 'brur mchod: sgrub la snying rus che ba dang phyi ma'i don gnyer ldan pa yis: zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtson: de tshe dgyes pa bskang ba'i thabs: phyi nang gsang ba'i rim pa bstan: sa ma yāḥ snang srid 'jig rten dag pa dang rang lus phung khams skye mched bkod kun zhi rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyas bskang dang mi bskang khyab brdal ngang de kho na ru bskang bar bya: sa ma yā dang po phyi yi bskang ba ni rol mo snyan pa'i sgra bcas ste hūṃ trīḥ ka dag cesas sku'i dgongs sang byang chub pa: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: nyag gcig thig le chen por mnga' brtes paḥ rig 'dzin brda rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: kun mkhyen ye shes ma 'dres sa ler gsalaḥ gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs: mi 'byed 'jig rten zab mo'i chos kyis 'dul: rig 'dzin gter

brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:lta sgom mkhyen pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa:rtsa rgyud rig dzen bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:brdzus skyes sprul sku 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon:gu ru bde chen rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs:bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes dbyings:gu ru a tsarya mchog thugs dam bskangs:'bum phrag ḍasko'i gtsug na rab spud pa'i:dbyings can ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskangs:'og min bde chen 'khor lo'i gting klong nas:'bar ba khrag 'thung lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:'bar 'khrigs rngams ma thig le'i bde klong nas:drug ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:kun bzang dngas ma 'od lnga 'khyil sang nas:rdo rje dbyings klong zhi ba'i thugs dam dbyings phyug lnga 'dus gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs bde skyongs phrin las rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:ging lang dpa' bo dam can thugs dam bskangs:dgongs pa zang thal don ston phrin las sgrub:seng chen 'dzam gling skyes gcig thugs dam bskangs:dgra 'dul bgegs 'joms sangs rgyas

gtsa/ bstan pa srung:dgra bla wer ma'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskangs:chos nyid dngas rtsa bde ba'i 'od 1nga nas:pho rgyud rig 'dzin rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:mnyam brdal rol ba padmo 'khyil klong nas:mo rgyud mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bde stong zung 'jug dbu ma'i gting klong nas:mnyam 'khyil dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bskangs gyur rig pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol:hūṃ hrīḥmatha' bral lta ba dag pas thugs dam bskangs:byung rgyal 'dzin med sgom pas thugs dam bskangs:re dogs la dor spyod pas thugs dam gnyis snang dbu mar grol bas thugs dam bskangs:zag pa chos skur sad pas thugs dam bskangs:bde stong 'bar ba 'dzag pa'i thugs dam bskangs:khyab brdal rje gas pa chen pos thugs dam bskangs:'khor gsum yongs su dag pas thugs dam bskangs:dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskangs:snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskangs:gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskangs:bde sdug ka nas dag pa'i slong du bskangs:ma bcos blo zad chos

sku'i ngang du ā: de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs: sgrib dag dbang dang dngos grub zob nyams dang rtogs pa'i yo tan 'char: the tshom med do sa ma yā: phyi yi bskang ba3/rgya gu khya: gnyis pa nang gi bskang ba ni lta spyod 'dzin pa rnam dag pas dbang chen padma gsung gi dal mnyam nyid bde ba chen por spyod: hūṃ hrī: ma ngaye sa dri bral bde chen ye shes sku: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskangs: byams dang snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid can: longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: chags bral brtse ba chen po'i dbang phyug pa: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs: shes rab gsang ba dbu ma chen po'i dbyings: lha lcam manta ra bas thugs dam bskangs: spran ras gzigs dngos padma gsung gi gar: dbang chen hya ṣṭṛ wa'i thugs dam bskangs: rigs dang dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i bdag nyid can: khro chen rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i drogs dam bskangs: bde chen yab la dga' bzhi'i rgyas 'debs dpal:mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangs: 'byung ba rnam dag yum chen lnga yi klong: dgyes bskyed ḍakki rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba

gsarte 'dul mdzad pa'i las kyi dpa' bo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thabs tshul mkhas: gar bsgyur dpa' mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:shugs chen mgyogs ma bstan pa'i sgog 'dzin paḥ pho nya ging chen rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: dus kyi rgud sel bdud 'joms ye shes sku: rta mgrin ma hā ka la'i thugs dam bskangs:ngo bo gcig la rnam rol mtha' yas pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs: rang bzhin mnyam nyid mdzad pa rmad byung ba:las byed pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs: thugs rje rtsol bral thabs mkhas spyod pa skyongs: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtshos thugs dam bskangs: hūṃ hrī: lha rdzas phyi mchod bdun gyis thugs dam bskangs: nyon mongs rang grol nang gi mchod pas bskangs: dug gsum dbyings sgrol sman gtor raktas bskangs: thabs shes dbyer med byang sems bcud kyis bskangs: mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang rtog pa bsgral bas bskangs: bcu drug rol rtsed 'dza' rgyun sbyor bas bskangs: thams cad mnyam nyid chos sku chen pos

bskangs: snang srid gzhir bzhengs lta ba dag pas bskangs: gang snang khyab brdal rig pa sgom pas bskangs: mtshan bcas snang rtog ro snyoms spyod pas bskangs: sgrib bral kun bzang 'bras bu'i thugs dam bskangs: bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs: 'khor 'das ro mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang: gnas lugs spros bral chos //'i dbo/ngas par bzhag: de ltar bskang ba tshogs chen rdzogs dbang dang dngos grub rgya mtsho thob: nyams rtogs yo tan nyi bzhin 'char:don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yuḥ nang gi bskang baljagargya: gu rgya: gsum pa gsang sgrub bskang pa ni thod rnga snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te: hūṃ hrī: ka dag spros mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangs: lhun grub bde stong thig le'i dngas klong nas: mkhas pa shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskangs: zung 'jug ye shes gsang ba'i 'od klong nas: paṇa chen bi ma mi tra'i thugs dam gsang chen dur khrod brgyad brten brtul zhugs mdzad: bka' bab grub chen brgyad kyi thugs dam rgya bal bod yul dam pa chos kyis skyongs: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad thugs dam

gtsa/ bskangs:smin grol dga' ston gdul bya'i khams la 'gyed:bka' gter brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:mkhyen rig ye shes dgongs pa sang nas rdol:rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:kha sbyor bdun ldan sku gsum mngon gyur dpal:rdo rje 'chang chen sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs:bde ba chen po'i yab la dgyes pa bskyed:rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi thugs dam bskangs:'byungs khams rnam dag ye shes lnga yi sang:bde ster mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskangs:phrin las thogs med gdul bya'i re skongs dpal:ging dang laṅka rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med stsol mdzad pa'i:rtsa gsum nor lha gter bdag thugs dam bskangs:dgongs pa kun bzang phrin las bstan gnyer 'dzin:sngags bdag e ka dza ṭi'i thugs dam bskangs:gdug pa'i dpa' sto ngas gegs sri thal bar rlog:ma mo 'bum phrag yangs pa'i thugs dam bskangs:sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can phan bde spel:pho nya yongs rdzogs sprul 'khor thugs dam bskangs:g.yar dam bskang ngo

tshe dbang dngos grub stsol:hūṃ hrī:thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa chen po dang:ma hā me sa dza gad a dṛ taḥbyang chub sems bcud tan gaṇa sngags ston dang:zhen 'dzin rtog bral phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs:thams cad rgyan rdzogs ro mnyam bkod pa dang:mi gnas mi dmigs chos nyid ye mchod che:rmad byung sgyu 'phrul ting nge 'dzin mchod rnams:dngos po yangs dag rnam rol mnyam brdal ba:thams cad dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod pa yis:rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:ma mo mkha' 'dza'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs:dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can thugs dam bskangs:gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs:dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i sang du bskangs:snang ba shes rab gsal ba'i 1nga du bskangs:bde sdug ro mnyam ka dag ngang du bskangs:'khor 'das mnyam brdal chos dbyings lhug par bskangs:thams cad mi dmigs khyab brdal chos sku'i ngang:de ltar ro mnyam bde bas bskangs:tshogs chen rdzogs la sgribs

keshāX pa dag:don kun gegs med yid bzhin 'grub:the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā:agam rgyal b.lidabang po padma thod phreng ngas:ma 'ongs gdul bya rnams la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag bcud tig mchog grub dbang 'aprog mi lo tsa khyod la sbyin da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims:mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs pra sdoms:ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bonus ldan rdo dzeedang:gdams pa 'di 'phrad chos bdag rnams la 'doms:gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god:'gro don mtha' rgya chen po'i rten 'brel yod:bka' gsang srungs shigadamar po lha lnga yod:skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par re ga:sa ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya:them med bskang ba rnam gsum rdzogs so:gter rgya:gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu rgya:3( rgyan gyi blo/ba dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dramakhar na bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim:༷/༷ces pa 'di'ang lung zin masanyid grags pas thabs shes rdor dril bkra shis lha reg zhabs pad brtan pa'i skyes dang sgrub pa'i me tog bcas nas bskul ba don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan0( rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

btsan lha chen gsol bsdus bzhugs: trīḥ spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' nyan pa: lha chen dmar po 'dod pa'i rgyal: yum chen u ma de wa dang: sras mchog tshogs bdag glang po'i gdong: dus bzhi'i lha mo sde brgyad bcas: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: gus pa chen pos gdan la bzhugs: bstan pa srung phyir phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid zag med bde ba che: thun mongs khyad par bla med kyi: mchod sprin 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod: gsol mtshod bstod do thugs dam bskangs: gang gi yid la re ba'i don: ma lus 'bad med shugs kyis bsdus: snang srid skye 'gro mos pa bzhi'i dbang gi phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: tshe dang dpal 'byor rab tu rgyas: gnod byed dgra bgegs rtag tu zhi: gang bcol lhun gyis 'khru/ba par mdzod: de ltar gsol mchod brten pa yis 'dod dgur lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: ces tsha bu bsod nams chos ldan ngor dzan las ming pasagatan la phab pas yi ge pa ni dharma bha dra'o/ dge'o/

gtsa( ye shes khyung gi srog sgrub bzhugs: za'ima'i drag sngags 'bum gyi rno nus ldan: gdon gsum dran pa tsam gyis mthar: sa gsum srid na mngon mtho ba'i ye shes khyung nag sgrub par bya: sa ma ya pya ༄rgya rgya balnga/ 'a sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na moḥ 'jigs byed 'jig pa'i mthu mnga' ba: ye shes khyung la skyabs su mchi: dug lnga'i myos pa'i 'gro ba rnams: rnam grol thob phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gnyis pa dngos bzhi lha bskyed ni: ྅: snod bcud brtan gamo'i snang ba rang sar brdal: yum lnga'i mkha' klong dug mtsho dug sprin 'thibs: lcags kyi ser ba thog 'brug 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khroḥlas dug khyung lcags kyi mchu sder can: rlung gi baXgs pa me yi tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: sbrul rigs lnga gsol klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'dul kring trīng sgra 'byin sa gsum 'byung po 'dar: dug shing rtsub shing tsher ma can dag la: sha za lce sbyang gaṅka dur bya 'tshogs: sra brtan brag brjid rngam pa'i khro rdul 'khrigs: las kyi pho nya mang po'i bu yug 'tshubs: lcang lo can dang 'og min gnas mchog nas: ye shes khro tshogs bya khyung rnam par bskul: dam ye ro gcig

bde ba chen por bzhugs: nyon mongs 'khrul ba rtsad gcod khyod phyag 'tshal: dbang lnga'i mchod pa sman gtor rakta 'bul: ci bder bzhes nas gti mug gdon tshogs sgrol:rngam pa'i gser mig 'khyil ba khyod la bstod: rang mtshan blta ba'i dri ma bshags bgyi'oḥ thugs shar khro la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: rgyal kun gsang ba gsum gyis dbang bskur zhing: 'khor 'das gsang srog 'phrog la mthu nus bskyed: snang grags dran rig ye shes khyung chen sgrubs: a khrojug ru ṇa dug khyung tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: nā ga'i dug phyungs phyungs ste la ste la swā hā: nus pa gnam lcags thog dang 'dra: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: sa ma yu: gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni: skyed ga dza ṇa badzra rū pa shabha ghandhe rā sa sparnye pa( mi.a dṛ ta rakta bā ling ta kha ram khā hi: kaka kakakaka byed dus mtha'i me lta bu: bskal ba stong pa'i 'thor rlung can: srid pa gting sprug rgya mtsho 'khyil: ram̐ ye khaṃ mdzad khyung la bstod: mthong ba'i klu rigs lnga yang 'dar: dran pas phal pa 'bogs shing brgyalaḥ thos pa'i nā ga rgyang ring byer: bsgom pa'i dug rnams dbyung la 'dud: 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar: ye

btsarsha shes khyung gi rjes bzung nas: sdug bsngal nad gdon kun las rgyal: rdo rje gshog pa'i rlabs bsgyur nas: lcang lo can du dbug dbyung mdzod: lha tshogs 'phro 'du mang po yang: sems kyi chos nyid mkha' la bsdu: yi ge yid bzhin sprin 'bar bas: lha tshogs phyag rgya'i gar du rol: dag mnyam gzhi yis bkra shis shog blo bral lam gyis bkra shis shog: 'ja' lus zang thal bkra shis shog:don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis shog de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshangs bas rnal 'byor sa lam bar chad sel: nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas: don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaX brda thimaXsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang rang dang rus rigs gcig pa'i dad ldan slob bu zhes chung nas bskul ngor/ kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

༄༅/ dag snang las: gu ru'i rnam thar gser gyi bum chung mkha' 'gro'i glu bstod zhes bya ba bzhugs so: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs: dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid:o rgyan chen po thod phreng rtsal: bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol: snyigs ma'i gdul bya las can rnams bar chad bdud las rnams rgyal phyir padma'i rnam thar bdud rtsi'i bcud gang zhig theb pas zug ngu zhi: sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel: gu ru padma'i thugs rjes zin o rgyan mkha' 'gra'i tshogs gral spyod rnga yab dpa' rir the mi tshom: de bzhin dwangs spros 'dir lajug 'tshal: 2424sgo na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: mi mjed zhing gi bla ma padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal mas: gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas kyis: zag med rin po che'i mdzod khang las: ye shes gzigs tshul rnam pa lnga dang bcas: dha na ko sha'i pad sdong ze'u 'bru'i khar: sangs rgyas sprul pa mtsho skyes rdo rjer bzhengs: rgya mtsho'i gling gi mkha' 'gror chos 'khor bskor: iṇḍa bho dhi rjes bzung rgyal srid bskyangs: 'od 'chang lha mor bde stong rol rtsed bsgyur: bka' skyongs phug tu rdo rje dbyings dkyil sgrubs: rig pa'i gnas mkhyen dbang po'i sde zhes grags: blo ldan

mchog srid rnal 'byor yo gar phul:kun dga' bo bsnyen sangs rgyas gnyis par grags:brgyad khri bzhi stong gter sbas shākya seng:mu stegs tshar bcad gdug pa rwa dza btul seng ge sgra sgrogs 'jigs lta zil gnon rgyalaḥ za hor gson bsregs me dpung mtsho ru bsgyur:rgyal po btsun mo lha lcam smin grol mdzad:padma saṃ bhas bka' 'dus bstan pa btsun:lhun grub brtsegs dang padma brtsegs sogs par:bdud rtsi bam sgrubs gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor:nyi ma 'od zer bstan pa'i sgron me bzhugs:so kta dī bas 'dod chags bzhi sbyor gsung:nor bu'i smin mtshams hūṃ bkod thub bstan bskyang:kun dga' bor bstan mchog dbang rnam lnga gsan:padma rgyal po'i o rgyan chos la bkod rgya nag kun rdzob rtsis kyis gdul bya bskyangs:bal yul bar chad bdud btul zab gter sbas:ni sha'i zhabs btegs manta'i 'gro phan bsgrubs:nyi ma seng ge'i spyan drangs gsang bsngags spel:bstan pa'i che bskyed sems can bde skyid mdzad:padma'i rnam thar gser kyi bum chung las:rgya gar yul byon le'u dang po'o: cotshokhrig de nas bod

༄༅/ rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis:yab mes kun gyi thang yig gzigs pa las:phyag rdor sprul pa'i dam chos dbu brtes 'gyur:spyan ras gzigs dngos gtsug lag bstan dkrol btsug:'jam dpal sprul ba bdag gis bshad sgrubs mdzad:thugs dam gnyer bzhes blon la bsdam ga bskor:gtsug lag khang phyir gsang rten sgrubs khas blangs:sa dpyad mkhan po bi rjes bsngags pa brjod:mkhan chen bho dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas:sa 'dul sa ris bcad nas rtsigs rmings bting:nyin mo mis bzhengs mtshan mo lha 'dre'i bshig:sa rdo rang mal so sor bskyal tsa na:rgyal po yid pham mkhan po'i lung bstan pa:bod khams lha 'dre zhi bas mi thul bas:g.ya' ri gong bzhugs brdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku:padma spyan drongs dbang dang drag po'i 'dul:myur bar song dang smon lam dbang gis byon:zhes gsung bang chen brdzang nas zhu phul tshe:dgongs par bzhugs nas gu rus lan gsungs ba:bod khams lha 'dre'i gzigs pa langs 'dug pas:khyed cag sngon song nga ni rjes nas yong:bod kyi rgyal po'i thugs dgongs 'grubs

po gsungs:nam mkhar gshegs bzhugs grub rtags du ma yis:bal bod lha 'dre'i dam btags gter kha gtad:phyogs bzhi'i brag dang grags pa'i mtsho bzhi la:sprul sku'i zhabs dang phyag rjes dad rten bkod:drag 'dul dpa' rtags mon brag sku rjes bzhag:dong ba'i gdong nas dro btab lha chu drangs:stod lung mda' ru slob dpon chen po dang:rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs bcas mjal tsa na:gdug sems khengs pa bcom phyir lta mgur blangs:nga che nga btsan sgrogs pas rgyal blon 'dar:ngo mtshar rdo yi mchod rten bzod gsol phul:yon mchod thugs 'dre'i bsam yas dgyes mchod phul:sa 'dul nas bzung dregs pa las la sbran:lha mi gnyis kyis nyin brtsigs mtshan bzhengs nas:stag la rmings btsug rta yi lo la 'byung:phyi rten gling gzhi srid pa'i chags tshul bkod:ri rab nyi zla gser ri gling phran ltar:bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams sgrub rgyud kyi:sku rnams lugs blugs 'bur bris thags su 'thag:rab tu gnas shing byin rlabs me tog 'thor:mkhan slob rnam gnyis byon par dgongs pa la:rgyal po'i chos

༄༅/ gsungs sgra bsgyur zhu ba phul: bod blun phru gus shes par ma gyur tshe: slob dpon lung bstan bee ro ka cog drangs: sgra bsgyur nus pa'i shes rab mchog dang ldan: rim par sad mi mi bdun slong lnga dang: sgra bsgyur lo car bsngags nas rgya gar btang: mdo sngags chos sde ma lus bod du bsgyuraḥ bī ma mi tra sangs rgyas gsang ba'i gtsos: paṇa chen nyer lnga spyan drangs dag ther mdzad: bstan pa'i che 'don lo tsa cha shas 'byung: yul gru so so dam pa'i chos la bsgyur: rgya gar paṇa chen rnams kyis bsngags brjod mdzad: rgyal blon 'bangs bcas bzod gsol 'gyod bshags phul: nang rgyud yo ga mang po bsgyur bar mdzad: rgya nag mkhan po sde lngas rtsis gzhung bsgyur: mdo sngags rtsis sman mdos chog bon la sogs: kun la mkhas pa'i bee ro'i grags pa rgyas: tshe dang ldan pa kun gyi gleg bam khur: bsam yas mtha' bskor cho ga sna tshogs pas: rab tu gnas shing nang gi rten du bkod: bshad sgrub rig 'dzin ngan sngags drag las sogs: gling bzhi gling phran so sor phrin las re bī ma mi dra rgya nag 'dul phyir byon: o rgyan

padmas bod khams sgrub gnas kun:'khas bcag byin rlabs dbang bskur bsgrubs pa mdzad:mkhan chen byang chub gling du mnyam bzhag bzhugs:re 'ga' so thar 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel:ārya pa lor bka' bab bu dgu la:bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bstan pa gtad:bsgrub pa mdzad pas grub rtags re re brnyes:ya thag ring po ma thag ring mo dang:khug pa bco brgyad skyo shas can la gzigs:gter kyi gzhi bzungs gter rigs bco brgyad tabs:gter ston gter chos gter gyis gling gleng mdzad:sa rtags dus kyang 'phel 'grib 'byung lung bstan:bod khams mtha' dbus gtsug lag phyur bur gtams:chos srung dam can rgya mtshor gnyer byang bcol:thugs sras bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab:bod 'bangs snyigs mi'i sems can thugs rje'i bzung:bka' drin 'dran gyi zla med pad 'byung yin:padma'i rnam thar gser gyi bum chung las:bod 'bangs skyong tshul le'u gnyis pa'o: drenasno11 de nas rgyal bstan chos khrims dar ba las:bod kyi rgyal po sku yi zol tshul gshegs:mu tig btsad po rgyal sar

༄༅/ bton nas su: chos dang 'jig rten bstan pa'i mdzod chen gtad: sems klong man ngag snying khus yang yang brlan: dbang po'i dwangs ma mig dang snying lta bu:'od gsal snying thig nang skor gsang skor bshad: tshe gcig sangs rgyas mngon byed man ngag gnang: de nas srin po 'dul byon zhal kyis bzhes: bod kyi rgyal pos bshol btab ma gnang nas: khra 'brug bka' 'dus gsang ba'i sman sgrub mdzad: dngos grub skal ba rje rgyal sras la gtad: lha lcam mngon byung brda bstod bde stong phul: gu rus sku tshab mchod bstod phul 'bral bstan: bsam yas dkar chag phug gsum rten bshad gnang: srog bdag gza' klus nga gal btab sku la rgor: thams cad dbang bsgyur zil gnon dam la btags: bstan gzhi spyi dang gtsug lag bsgrub gnas gtad: dad ldan jo mo gsum la man ngag sbyin: bod 'bangs yongs la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bstan:man ngag gcig chog bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis: bsgom rim zag med bdud rtsi'i snying po sbyin: ces kyang dgos med bya ba ro snyoms bskul: nyin mo byung tshe thugs rje chen po dang:

mtshan mo bden chen zhing la 'dun pa sbyang: dag pa'i rgyu bzhi bsgrub par man ngag gnang: bar skabs dzad rgyan nga la gsol ba thob: skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung re ltos mdzad: nga dang ma 'jal sku tshab nga 'dra ma: gsol 'debs phyag mchod dad pa'i rten du gyis: gtan bde'i sa lam o rgyan sprul pas sbyin: gser dang zha nye chang dang chu bzhin du: brtags bzhugs btang nas khyad par bye brag byed:rno so byin rlabs nus mthu gang 'dug der: re ltos bcol na mi bslu nges pa yin: rje 'bangs lo paṇa skye bo pho mo sogs: bod 'bangs yongs kyi nor sna 'dod yon bcas: slob dpon bskyal nas gong thang la khar mchod: bod 'bangs mi rer zhal gdams sna re gnang: de tshe yangs chen nyamamakha'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpa' bo sde bzhis rta mchog rin chen drangs: lha mo mang pos dar gdugs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi gu ru nam mkhar dpag:rta mchog rin chen sga yi khar bzhengs te: bod 'bangs yongs la phyir gzigs 'di skad zlo: kyi rgyal po'i gtsor byas rje 'bangs rnams: ste sngags gdung bus mi 'tshal bar:

༄༅/ nyams len rang thog bstan sa zungs:da lta bod na dam chos dar:bshad sgrub nyi zla ltar du gsal:chos byed thams cad rang dbang 'byor:phyi mar sdug pa'i dus zhig 'byung:o rgyan nga yis skyobs par skad:yang ltos yang ltos nga phyir ltos:gsol ba thob la thal mo sbyor:thugs yid dbyer med mnyam bzhag gis:don dam dgongs rgyud rtogs pa 'pho:sku dngos 'di la zhen phreng chod:khyed cag 'phos ma thag pa ༄/rnga yab dpal rir the mi tshom:zhes gsungs rta mchog rin chen steng du bcibs:o rgyan yul gyi lho nub phyogs la phebs:'ja' 'od lam lam zer zer dpa' rir bzhud:srin gling brgya dang brgyad cu chos la bkod:bod 'bangs phyir phebs mdo sngags bstan pa srung:chos dang 'jig rten khrims la gnas par bslabs:padma'i rnam thar gser gyi bum chung las:srin po 'dul byon le'u gsum pa'o: chu/rdo/11 rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i:gu rus bka' bzhin rnam thar brgya stong phrag:bsam gyi mi khyab 'phrul gyi brdar bcug nas:dag snang sa gter dgongs pa'i gtang du bkod:

las 'phro can dang 'phrad pa'i spron lam btab: snyigs dus 'gro ba'i rgud pa skyobs byed yin: log lta ma byed kun gyis dang du longs: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs gza' klu rgyal po sogs: 'jigs pa kun las skyobs 'gyur bsgru ba med: padma'i rnam thar don bsgom sus brjod pa: rnga yab dpal gyi ri la skye bar re ga: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: padma'i rnam thar gser gyis bum chung dzadags so: bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: gu hya: brda thim: 3ni: ces pa 'di'ang dad mos bkur bsti phu dud la skyo ngal med pa de wa nas bskur ba don dang ldan phyir kho bo nus ldan rdo rje'i dag snang rin che'i 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin me tris bgyis pa legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

727 dag snang las:padma'i rnam thar dri med shel bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so: thatha'irsāblajo em ho:sku gsum kun dngos bla ma rdo rje 'chang:rgyud /dro zlob sde'i sprin 'khrigs lhag pa'i lha:dbyings gsum ma tshogs ḍākki'i gtsug rgyan mchog:dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs brin las dngos:gsung gi rdo rje snang mtha' 'dzum pa'i gar:spyan ras gzigs dngos gsang sngags ston pa mchog:mi mjed zhing 'dirasprul sku padma 'byung:sidhi rgya mtshor padma'i sbub las byon:ma rig log 'khrul sems can 'dren pa'i phyir:ind+ra bho dhis spyan drangs rgyal srid gtad:rgyal po thor cog can gsol rgyal srid bskyangs:re zhig dus na rdor sems lung gnang tshe:srid spangs bsil ba'i tshal gshegs brtul zhugs spyod:stan gan mdzad pas mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus:gnas lngar mkhas pa'i thos rakṣir grags:phyogs bzhi'i dur khrod kun bzhugs spyod pa mdzad:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro las dang grib bzhin 'grogs:rdo rje phag mo'i zhal gzigs dngos grub stsal:sde brgyad bran bkolardo dzidrag rtsal gsol:bya

khyung tshal byon pra bha hasti mjal: rnal 'byer yo ga gsan cing sgrub pa mdzad: lha tshogs zhal gzigs shākya seng ger grags: rgya gar gnas rnams kun tu sgrub pa mdzad: rig 'dzin grub thob mang po'i rjes su bzungs: mtshan nyid chos dang yo ga rnam gsum sbyangs: mkhas pa blo ldan mchog srid zhes su grags: sa yi lha mos chos gos phul zhing bstod:za hor yul byon lha lcam rjes su bzungs: bdud blon 'dus nas rgyal sras mer bsregs tshe: me dpung mtshor bsgyur pad sdong rol rtsed mdzad: rgyal blon snang ba dbang bsdus 'bangs su bkol: bka' 'dus chos kyis za hor rgyal khams smin: skye bdun gter sbas ma 'ongs 'byung lung bstan padma saṃ bha wa zhes grags mtshung zla bral: o rgyan yab yum ma ra ti gar byon: tshe yi rig 'dzin zla ba gsum du sgrub: 'chi med mgon po mdun gyi nam mkhar byon: byin gyis brlabs shing skye 'chi med dbang bskur: sems rtags lus shar tshe dbang rig 'dzin grags: o rgyan yul byon gshed ma'i tshogs 'dus nas: yab yum dam bcing ta la'i shing gis bsregs: lha rnams cho ngus 'don zhing bsil

'o/ char phab: sol ba'i gur phub til mar mtsho 'khyil dbus: pad sdong ze'u 'brul yab yum rol rtsed mdzad: yul khams ngo mtshar chos kyis dbang du bzla1: rgyal po btsun mo 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas: rig 'dzin sa la nges par byang chub mdzad: padma rgyal po srid na yongs su grags: lhun grub brtsegs dang padma brtsegs pa nas baṃ ro sgrub cing mkha' 'gro ma tshogs la: gsang sngags chos kyi dga' ston bde stong 'gyed: mchod rten rgyab brten ting 'dzin mchog la gnas: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer zhes su grags: zangs gser gling sogs mu stegs 'dul ba'i phyir: lho phyogs yul gshegs mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul mas: byin rlabs gzengs bstod bse sgom man ngag sbyin: mu stegs rtsod bzlog gnam lcags thog char phab: ngan sngags bdag po bsgral zhing rgyal bstan srung: bdud 'dul seng ge sgra lja/gas zhes su grags: bal bo'i yul byon yang le shod du gnas: yang dag sgrub pa mdzad tshe tho 'tshams bgegs:rdo rje phur pas tshar bcad zab gter sbas: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mchog thob pa'i: 'phrul

mtshan kun 'dus rdo rje thod phreng rtsal yon tan phul phyin gzhan las ya mtshan gyur:byang phyogs bod yul rgyal khams 'dul ba'i phyir:bod skyongs rgyal pos gdan 'dren pa dang 'phrad:'byon par zhal bzhes bar snang dbyings nas pheb:lam la bod skyongs bstan ma bcu gnyis dang:mi srun gnod sbyin spun dgu dam la btags:lha 'dre gnad dbab gter kha re re gtad:yon mchod zhal mjal lta mgur dgongs pas gzir:rgyal blon btsun mo'i khengs sems phrag dog bcom:bsam yas mnga' gsol rgyal po'i dgongs pa sgrubs:gdong dmar bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbar:sprul sku padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags:bsam yas 'chims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du:sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas:las can rgyal po rje 'bangs smin par mdzad:'bras bu gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me sbar:mtshungs med gu ru thugs rje can zhes grags:stag tshangs seng brag bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du:mu stegs bon dang bdud bgegs dam sri btul:gnas chen gangs brag thams cad gter gyis gtam:gu ru rdo rje

shāX gro bo lod zhes grags: ma 'ongs dad ldan sgrub mchog skyobs pa'i phyir: gangs can rnams dang sgrub gnas kun byin rlabs: brag phug chen po brgyad la /dro rdoben mdzad:sbyongs lnga gling drug mtha' dbus zhabs kyis bcag: bka' drin brjod 'das bod kyi nyi mar grags: phyogs bzhi'i brag la 'gyur med zhabs rjes bkod:grags pa'i mtsho bzhir bka' rtags phyag rjes bzhag: mon kha'i brag la rdo rje'i sku rjes gsal:sku tshab gsung gter thugs sprul bsam yas pa:bod 'bangs yun du skyobs pa'i btsas su bzhag: de tshe o rgyan gter bdag rgyal por grags: nyid dang ma mjal ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i phyir: bsam yas mchod bstod bskur sti'i yon tan dang:sku tshabu bzhengs dang rin chen sna lnga'i rtsi:phul tshad 'phags pa'i nor bdun thob po zhes:mi bslu nges pa rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags:ma rgyan chos kyi rgyal po zhes su grags:ma 'ongs sa rtags dus kyi g.yo 'khrug dang: nad mug mtshon gzengs bskal ba'i 'phel 'grib dus rgud gso co rgyan rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku: mtshan dang chos bdag lde'u mig lung du

bstan: dus gsum kun mkhyen padma zhes su grags: zab mo'i gter gnas ya mtshan mchog brnyes brgyad: kong po'i yul gtsos gangs ljongs mtha' dbus kyis: zab gter chu bo bdun gyi sgo 'byed cing: snyigs ma'i bod 'bangs ngas skyobs zhal bzhes pa'i: 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon phrin las nub med grags: gsang sngags snying po nang rgyud sde gsum dang: khyad par kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa mchog: mi nub mtha' ru yongs su rgyas mdzad cing: 'bras bu 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sar 'god pa'i: snyigs ma'i lha gcig 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs: khyad par rmad byung gangs can mtsho zhes grags: chos rgyal btsad por bstan pa'i gzhi gtad cingaḥ dad ldan jo mo gsum la man ngag bstan: bod 'bangs yongs la zhal gdams snying byang bkod: nyid kyi sgrub pa yon tan drug ldan gsungs: rje 'bangs yongs kyi tshogs ston maṇḍal phul: dad ldan mi re thugs dam sna re gtad: don la 'du 'bral med pa'i rtse gtam bstan: bod kyi bla ma padma badzra grags da lta gdong dmar srin pos kha gnon mdzad: sha za dam sri rakka chos la bkod: paṇa

shā grub rnams la bshad sgrub nyin mor byed: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjer mnga' dbang bsgyur: thugs rje rgyun chad med par bod la gzigs: drin /dro gyel sku 'od zer rgyal por grags: lnga brgya'i sems can bod 'bangs nyam thag la: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal rgyun chad med: de tshe mgon khyod dran pa'i dad gus kyis: rnam thar yid la bsgom zhing gsol gdab na: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos te: bdag sogs sgo gsum nyes sgrib kun bcom nas: byin rlabs rjes bzung nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs te: rig 'dzin bla ma'i zhing mchog dpal gyi rir: o rgyan padma'i zhabs drung la 'khod nas: smin grol chos kyi bdud rtsi'i legs spyod cing:ma gyur 'a11 ba 'dren pa'i mthu ldan thegag: padma'i bka' bsdus dri med shes bum 'di: yid la dran cing kha ton byed pa'i mi gza' klu rgyal sogs gdon tshogs rgol ba zhi nad mtshon mu ge nye bar 'tshe ba bzlog mo rtsis pra ltas ngan pa thams cad sel: tsha ring dpal 'phel bsam don yid bachen 'grub byin rlabs nus mthu bsgrangs 'das bsam mi khyab: the tshom med do rdo rje padma'i bka': sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu khya: brda thim:snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang

rje gong thang rin po che'i phrin las kyi cha 'dzin shī la bi ma la zhes bya ba tshul khrims dang dam tshig gi phyug cing sgrub brtson rnal 'byor ba gang des bzhed ngor padma'i rgyal tshab nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba maṅga le/

shāshā dag snang las:padma'i rnam thar rin chen sgon me bzhugs: sum̐ḥ na mo gu ru padma ratna di baṃ ka ra ya:rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa chos kyi /bye sa nyid la:bde ba chen po'i 'od gsal phyogs dang ris med dag mnyam par:rdul bral gzigs pa mtha' yas gang des mi mjed khams skyongs phyir:dha na ko shar bram za'i rigs bltams mtsho skyes rdo rjer bzhengs:dpa' bo mkha' 'gros yongs bstod pradzñā kirta'i sras dbang bskur:lo lngar srid bskyangs brtul zhugs spyod pas o rgyan rgyal khams spangs:dur khrod brgyad gshegs rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhas shing grub pa brnyes:kuñdza ra brnyen kri ya u pa yo gar mkhas par bslab:pra bha hasti brten nas rnal 'byor ma hā yo ga grub:lag na rdo rje'i zhabs brnyen a nu yo gar phul du phyin:kun dgar rab byung thub pa'i gsung rab mdo sngags chos la sbyangs:rgya nag yul du 'jam dpal gtsug bkur rtsis gzhung ma lus bsgyur:rigs ngan yul gzhoms sa rgyan mkha' 'dza'i gling du chos 'khor bskor:za hor lha lcam rjes bzung phra mas mer bsregs chu ru

bsgyur: bka' 'dus chos gsungs rje 'bang nyer lnga rgyal khab smin grol mdzad: ma ra ti gar yab yum gnyis med tshe yi rig 'dzin grub rgyal po a shwa ka btul rdzu 'phrul thabs kyis nang par bskul: nyi ma'i shugs can gza' mi rjes bzung log sbyor thugs rten bkod: rā dza zangs kyi dregs can rdzu 'phrul dmag gis tshar bcad nas: bstan pa'i gzhi btsug mu stegs nags bsregs dmangs rnams nang par btsud: rgyal po klu yi khyab 'jug mu stegs ston pa sde drug bcas: rigs gsum sprul pas tshar bcad rdo rje gdan la so nams byas: ka la siddhi rjes bzungs nor bu go leb grub par bkod: dga' rabs rdo rje brten nas sems klong man ngag khong du chud:bṛ seng has chos kun dbyer med don brtan rtogs pa phul: mtshan mchog drug gi che ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bstod:ṭī bhi'i blta stangs rdzu 'phrul skye bdun sha yis 'gro phan bsgrub: o rgyan khab kyis mer bsregs pad sdong mtsho dkyil rdzu 'phrul bstan: rgya gar bsod nams cher 'phel bi nas chang khal lnga brgya drangs: rigs kyi rtog spangs maste bzang mos sku lus 'gro

shā don btang: rgyal po nyi ma seṅges gdan drangs bshad sgrub bstan pa bzungs: 'phags pa'i yul gyis gdul bya ma lus sbyor sgol thabs mang pos: lha 'dre bye dum dbang bsgyur 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byas padmami rnam thar ram̐n chen sgon milas: rgya gar yul byon le'u dang po'o: thajarsā ོ de nas dzad rgyal khyesdelibatsug bstan rgya za zungs 'jug sras: 'jam dpal sprul pa khri sgong lde btsan sku 'khrungs bī rjes bsngags: bcu gsum lo la yab gshegs bco lngar bod kyi rgyal sar bkod lo gsum nang du dmag jag dgra las thams cad mnga' dbang bsgyur:bcu bdun le mjug yab malisrol mthong chos kyi bsam pa skyes: blon 'bangs bsdus nas gdams bka' bskul tshe gtsug lag sgrub gros mthun: brag dmar mtsho mo mgul nas bi rjes bsam yas sa dpyad gzigs: rgyal ba'i blo gros gru gu e bag ru gyong bidu sogs: blon rnams gamago bcas phyogs phyogs sa 'dul mkhan po tshol du phyin: smon lam dbang gis bho dhi sa twa spyan drangs bsam yas byon: rgyal pos sa bskos bcud zhag kha dog lnga byung dbu

zhal byugs: rtsigs rmings btsug kyang lha 'dres ma ster sa rdo rang mal bskyal: mkhan po'i bdag ni byang chub sems la yang dag nyid gnas pas: bod khams lha srin mi thul o rgyan padma spyan drongs gsungs: bang chen mi gsum gser bye bre re gser gyi pa tra bdun: bskur nas o rgyan rje dang rgyal por phrad nas zhu rten phul: phyon par zhal bzhes mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyis bshol btab kyang: ma gnang gdul bya'i bskul bas rtsi thogs 'bus bzhin 'gogs pa med: smin drug zla ba'i lag sor nyin par lam zhugs bal yul pheb: bod khams lha 'dre gzing lang mngal skyes dag gi zer mi thub: byin rlabs srung mdud btags nasabang chen mi rnams sngon la btang: yang le shod du shākya dhe was grogs byas dgongs par bzhugs: bstan pa'i gzhi srung gter rigs bco brgyad phan bde'i so nams sgrubs: bar chad bzhi byung yang phur sgrub pa'i gdul dka' dam la btags: e yi gtsug lag khang dusems can bde ba'i gter gcig sbas: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mchog thob gdul bya smin par byas: slob dpon byon bskul rnams

7༷ 'phrad gser phul mang yul bal yul gtor: phang sems skyes tshe mthu ba zed gsungs sa rdo gang re spung:thams cad rin chen nyid gyur sku la mos mthong snga bye ༷rsharsha: de nas o rgyan chen po rdo rje thod phreng nam khar gshegs:sa hūṃ zhes bsgrags bal bod lha 'dre kun 'dus glags tshol tshe: phur pa'i srung ma ma mo bcu gnyis skyes gang bran du bkol: ri brag mkhar g.yo zhang zhung dgra bla dza mun dam la bzhag:ting lo sman sogs byang thang lha 'dre ar gtad gter srung byas: gangs dkar sha med spyan bcar sha rus lpags bsreg bstan ming bkod: ma yams sol dum rer bsgyur bka' rtags bcing la gter re gnyer:kha mithang lha dgobasnyen tshogs 'dus dam blangs tshogs mkhor phul: gla ba rkang gcig the'u rang kun 'dus mna' bor bran zhal bzhes: mal gros 'gram du klu rigs srog 'phrog sa 'og nor gter bcol: na dmar btsan rigs dud mdog dri ku g.yu lung pho rgyud btul: bod kyi lha 'dre pho mo ma ning kun bsdus gter re gtad: bstan pa'i srung mar bskos shing mdo sngags chos kyi man ngag sbyin ma 'ongs

sangs rgyas thob par lung gnang de bar srung mar bskos padma'i rnam thar rin chen sgon me las lha 'dre dam btags le'u gnyis pa'o: thaja de nas lha bzang dpon g.yog rgyal po'i tshabs btang yar klung mjal: dro bar btab pas chu dben dong pa'i gdong nas lha chu 'dren: bod kyi rgyal por pho mo chas rgyan mdzom dang mjal 'phrad skabs:khri sgong sde'u btsan nga che nga rgyal phyag la 'gyengs tsa na: dus gsum sangs rgyas padma rgyal pos mdzad pa'i che ba brjod: sdigs mdzub spyan gzir rdzu 'phrul me mched rgyal blon 'khor bcas 'dar: phyag ni gyang 'gyel bzhin btsal ngo mtshar rdo yi mchod rten bzhengs: yon mchod thugs 'dres bsam yas chags pheb klu gter sgog chu blangs: rus rbal mgo non rjes chags rdo rje log bzhir gtad kha lcags: 'gram par me btsa' shing la sbos par chu yi rlan phab nas: rdzu 'phrul mkhar lding pad 'byung bka' bsgrags sku grib gar byung sar mi min lha 'dre kun 'dus grogs su zhal bzhes sa rdo bskyal: nyin par mis brtsigs mtshan mo lha srin ki co dang bcas bsgrub: rgya gar bal dang li yi yul gyi

7༷ gtsug lag thogs gsum pa: nyi zla gza' skar ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi tshul:jo mo gling gsum mchod rten dkar dmar sngon po bcas pa yang:bye rdo nang rten lugs blugs 'bur bris dkor srung be har drangs:ngo mtshar rtags ni bsam yas bcas te rab tu gnas pa mdzad: mkhan slob byon par dgongs kyang rgyal pos bzhugs par zhu ba phul: gu rus zhal nas rgyal po rnam g.yeng blon rnams gdug rtsubs che: btsun mo chos la gnags shing bod kyi mi rnams nyon mongs rags: de dag gdul bar dkab zhing smon log bon gyis bsgyur bar srid:zhes gsungs bod kyi rgyal po chos khrims bka' khrims dam du bsdams:byis pa skye mched tshang ba mang bsdus mkhan slob sgra bsgyur kyang: sus kyang mi shes log smras rje gnyis bzhad cing thal mo brdab: rgyal po mang bshum gu rus thabs yod gsungs nas lung bstan gnang: gan cag thang ta cog ro klu rgyal ska ba dpal brtsegs drangs:shes rab sgo bskyed dkar gsum mngar gsum zas sman thabs mang bslabs: gzhung chen dum bu lnga brgya ma gtogs thams cad

bod du bsgyur: de nas sad mi mi bdun dge slong mi lnga mchog dbang bskur: gser gyi pa tra bcu gsum gser bye bre lnga re gtad nas: ci ka las dang nyo ka tho se las gzhan man ngag mchog: rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du chos tshol la btang paṇa grub mchog: nyer lnga brten nas mdo ru sems phyogs rgyu 'bras phyogs rnams bsgyur: bla ma'i bka' bcag rtsang sngon legs grub dpal seng sngon phyin bkum bee ros rkang mgyogs grub nas bod phyin paṇa chen rmi ltas log: rgyal po'i gtsug bkur chos gsungs bon blon dmar rgyan phrag dog pas: yang nas yang gtugs mkhas pa bee ro rgyal mo tsha rong sprugs:nam snying dge sgong mi bzhi rje yi bla mar bkur dbang zhus: zab gsang sngags la sgo skur smon log rnams kyi yang yang gtugs: rgyal po the tshom nam snying lho brag gzhan gsum zhang zhung rgya: li yi yul sprugs bsgrub pa'i grub rtags yul gru so sos bsdags:bye ro tsa nas rgyal mo tsha rong dkar po'i chos la bsgyur: lo tsa ska cog rma ban gsum byon chos rgyal dharma dzar: gser bye bre gang phul la skyes lan parnyi ta zhig zhus: bla mchod stong la gser
