77 3 phul bka' bsgos bang chen 'dir shogs gsungs bī ma'izhal mthong sku la mos thob brda chos rten 'brel 'grigs:lo tsa gsum dang a tsar sa'i snying garberte bcas paṇa chen drangs:mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog chu tshod dbyu gu'i rtsis 'khrugs rmi ltas log:ci nyes bsgo gling rgyal po'i bla mchod bod du ma shor ram:zhes pas gsang brtol mu stegs phra man yin zhes mdo byang bskur:bon blon rnams 'phrad rgyal po la zhus kho bo'i brtags dgos zer:lo tsa ba gsum nyam thag yi chad 'dre ldog byed bzhin gnas:zhag gsum rdzu 'phrul grub rtags bstan nas rgyal pos yid ches bsngags:bod khams yongs kyi che brjod nyan bshad 'gyur mang bsgyur la zhugs:mkhas pa nyer lnga rgya gar yul nas spyan drangs lo tsar bcas:chos la dag ther lta log bon gyi bstan pa bsnub par mdzad:g.yu sgra la yog 'dor btang bee ro tsa nas dam chos gtug:rgyal po btsun mo blon 'bangs bshags byas bee ro bod du drangs:rtsis sman mdos bon rgya chos ma lus bsgyur nas glegs bam byas:nam snying dam pa'i rgyud bsgyur rgyal po'i bsnyun

sna/sa chags nyams bshags: tshe dang ldan pas glegs bam khur nas bsam yas lan gsum bskor: cho ga mi 'dra re res rab tuganas shing brtan bzhugs gsol: sku sa gsung rten bzhugs byang dkar chags ri mor rgyas par bkod: nam snying rgyal po phyag la ma 'cham slob dpon rdzu 'phrul bstan: rje 'dar blon 'byel btsun mo 'khor da bshags byas bla mar bkur: rgya thod paṇa chen lo tsarnams la sku drin maṇḍal phul: rgyal po slob dpon rnam gnyis yas mas gtam dang mdo bsngo gsungs: blon 'bangs ra gyis paṇa chen rnams ni rang rang gnas su bskyal: bi ma rgya nag la byon mkhan chen byang chub gling mnyam bzhag: bsam yas mchod bstodabakur 'bras phan yon bsam 'a yas par bshad: gu rus mtha' dbus zhabs bcag sgrub gnas thams cad byin gyis brlabs: rgyal pos tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa phul skabs lha lcam pad ma gsal:na zin byin rlabs zhu phyir gu ru'i mdun phyin tshe dus byas sme sngags 'o dod gdung tshigabarjod tshe rje nyid thugs lhod gsungs: sa steng 'dus byas 'di 'dra mi rtag lha lcam skye

/shā rgyud gsungs:lha sa bsam yas chags 'jig dar rgud rnam thar bsam yas bstan:sang phod rgyal po nyid gshegs nyams len rang thog brtan sa zungs:( 11sa 'byung 'gyur kun la thugs ngal ma mdzad las yin gsungs padma'i rnam thar rin chen sgron me las:bod khams skyong tshul le'u gsum pa'o: 7pakhyazu) ོ de nas btsad pos gus phyag dgu sprugs phul nas gsol btab pa:ma 'ongs snyigs 'gro'i rgud pa bsal phyir man ngag chos zhig zhus slob dpon zhal nas yas mas thog dang khug pa skyo shas gzigs:phun tshogs lnga yi gzhi bzung gter ston gter chos gleng bslang mdzad:'phel 'grib sa rtags dus dang dus su 'byung 'gyur lung bstan gnang:re brgyad lo gsar dus ston rkyen ldang rgyal po zhi bar gshegs:mu nee btsad po rgyal sar bton kyang phra men smon log gis:bkyon phab dug gis bkrong nas mu tig btsad po rgyal sar bkod:slob dpon padmas brtse bas rjes bzung dbu rtser dam rgya mdzad:yid ches brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bka' bab gter gyi phreng ba bstan:gdams ngag dug tu ma gyur sngags

srung bdud mar gyur ba'i tshul: sngar byon rgyal bas ma gsungs man ngag snying thig phra yig can: dbang po'i dwangs ma mig dang snying las lhag pa gces nor gnang:srin po mi zan 'dzam gling phung byed so kha srung zhal bzhes:ces kyang nor sna mang phul nga gal btab ma gnang zhal gdams brtsal:phug gsum ljongs lnga gling drug gangs chen nyer lnga'i che ba bsgrags: nyid dang ma 'jal ma 'ongs gdul bya'i re ltos sku tshabs kyis: gsungs nas jo mo gsum la tshe gcig grol ba'i man ngag sbyin: yar klung shel gyi brag phug 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa mdzad: nam snying mtsho rgyal sngags pa zla shar rtogs pa grub 'bras smin:'chang phug mkha' 'dre dgongs 'dus a mṛ sgrub pas gnas brgya rtsar:dus skabs dhe wa ko ṣa'i btsas su phan bde'i gzhi mar bzhags: khra 'brug bka' rnams 'dus pa'i sgrub chen rje 'bangs nyer brgyad kyis: mdzad tshe dpal chen yab yum zhal bstan rdo rje'i gad rgyang sgogs:rtog med ngang brgyal nang don 'od gsal sgon me kun la 'bar: bsgrub pa'i tho ring lha lcam manta ra bas brda bstod mdzad: rjes 'jug phyir du kun rtog

/rdo rang grol bde stong gsang spyod bstan:dngos grub skal ba rje rgyal yab yum sras mchog lha rjer gnang:sku yiphrong ba legs bstan rtsa gsum gces nor (1 1 brtsal:nor bu mchog gsum bod spyi'i bsod nams bskyed phyir gter sbos gsungs:dus kyi ru 'dzid skyobs phyir bla gter nyer lnga'i che ba bsgrags:sems can yun du bde phyir ming can nyer lnga'i dgos pa bstan:bskal pa'i rgud pa bsal phyir ming med nyer lnga 'don lung gtad:sgrub pa bka' brgyad babs so rjes 'bangs bu dgu'i bsgo skal bzhag:sku gsung thugs tshabs bsam mtha' yas pa ma 'ongs don phyir blan:skye bdun sha yi phan yon gsungs shing 'gro don rgya cher bshad:bod 'bangs yongs la zhal ta gnang nas thams cad tshim par mdzad padmalirnam thar ren chen sgon milas ma 'ongs don mdzad le'u bzhi pa'o: 11jache/ denas bod kyirgyal dren 'bangs bcas nor sna bsam yas spungs:gong thang la khar bskyal bcug bza' btung tshogs 'khor re ma cig gsungs:bod sngags lo tsa mkhas btsun jo mo rgyal blon 'bangs kyis bskyal:

chib lam rdo yi mchod rten la bab 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bstan rgyu 'bras bslu med don bstan yi dam thugs rje'i sgom lung gnang: bla ma'i skal ba 'gro 'dul gu ru drug gi yon tan brjod: ma ni gti mug gnas stong dud 'gro'i 'dren ston seng rab bstan: badzra zhe sdang gnas stong na rag dong sprugs rnam par gnon: gu ru dug lnga rang grol mi yi skyabs mgon padma 'byung: padma chags pa ka dag yi dwags gnas skyobs sgron me 'bar: sidhi phrag dog tshar gcod lha min 'dren mdzad thag bzang rgyal: hūṃ ni nga rgyal g.yeng sgol lha yi dbang po gser thub zhal: gang zhig dran bzhin tshig nyung don 'dus bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dis: 'brel tshad don ldan rnga yab dpal gyi ri la the mi tshom: sems can las kyi mnar kyang gsang sngags chos la mos gus kyis: dam ma nyams na na rag rdo rje'i skye sgo nga yis 'gogs: snyigs ma'i bu sdug thugs rje yal bar mi 'dor rjes su 'dzin:ma 'ongs 'gro ba ngan song mnar rnams nga nyid bsu ru 'ongs: 'jigs tshog gang gis gzir kyang gsol ba thob dang nga yis skyobs: kha lag dal khom med par nga sgom gsol

78 'debs snying po sgrogs med med 'jin rten bya ba zin pa'i dus med ro snyoms thongs:skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung o rgyan nga la 'dun pa gtod:bya ba brtenas nas kyis la sdug bsngal rin gyis ma nyo zhig:snga 'byung phyi nub tshong mgron gyes 'dus lta bur mkhon zlo rtsod:chos byed mgo ma stong la log spyod brel 'tshubs ma langs shig:gom pa 'degs 'jog nga phyir snyogs la lta spyod yang dag gyis:mi mjed 'jin rten bye ba phrag brgya'i skyabs mgon pad 'byung nga:skyabs gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum kun dngos gcig sgrub yongs 'grub 'gyur:gu ru mtshan brgyad sgrub pa bka' brgyad kun dngos byin rlabs myur:'di phyi'i re ltos nga la gtod dang bslus na padma zhan:dad pa can la 'du 'bral med do ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams:zhes gsungs rta mchog rin chen la bcibs dpa' bo sde bzhis drangs:yangs chen baiḍūr nam mkha'i gzhir btegs rje 'bangs cho nges 'ur:sku 'gyeng zhal phyir gyu la bod 'bangs zo mdog bde mor bzhugs:da lta smre sngags mi dgos bod na dam chos nyi bzhin gsal:nga 'gro lta

ze'i rdzongs chen chos sku khyab brdal klong la 'gro:bsgom pa'i 'phreng brgal longs sku 'od gsal nges pa lnga ldan 'gro:spyod pa sgog 'phrog sprul sku padma 'od kyi gling la 'gro:srin gling bco brgyad gsang sngags chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'gro:lus med mkha' 'dza'i yul gling bde stong kha sbyor smin grol 'gro:thugs rje bod skyongs sprul pa bsam yas spro bsdu byed bzhin 'gro:shes byar ma rmongs thams cad mkhyen gzigs gdul bya skyongs bzhin 'gro:zhes gsungs lha dang lha mos dar gdugs rol mo 'phan yab bcas:'ja' 'od lam lam zer zer zangs mdog dpal gyi ri la gshegs:rje 'bangs lo paṇa chos kyi khrims bsdams brgyud pa'i gdung 'tshob mdzad padma'i rnam thar rin chen sgron me las srin po 'dul byon le'u lnga pa'o: (patha6) 7 oṃ ཿsa badzra gu ru padma sirnyi hūṃ:ngo mtshar sprul sku o rgyan chen po padma gangs can mtsho:khyed kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar dran bzhin snying nas gsol ba 'debs:gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i lha srin rgyal bsen dam la thogs:skye rgu'i shes rgyud dam pa chos kyi lam du drangs ba dang:phyin log

'o/ bdud kyi dbang du ma gtong sbyor dngos rjes tshangs ba'i: nyams len rang ngo sprod la mtha' ma'i dbang du mi gtong bar: mdo sngags chos kyi lhag zhabs yang /rgo dge ba'i 'tsho bzhin par: 'chi 'a nad gcod med par dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu mar bcas: rje btsun bla ma pad 'byung gang bzhugs zhabs drung skye ba dang: theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dpal spyod sa lam yongs rdzogs mthar phyin nas: med snang stong gzugs a 'thus 'gro khams ma lus dong sprug regag: bla ma'i rnam thar mtha' yi rgya mtsho thig pas mi gzhal kyang: bdag bye'i pad mtshor dad rten thig tsam shar 'di'i dge ba yis: snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i rang lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang: 'brel thog ma lus tshom bur bcas nas dpal rir 'tshogs par regag: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya: brda thim:sni: zhes pa'ang dus kyi rgud pa dang dam sri 'byung po zhabrugs pa'i la yog zhi phyir: bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dag snang mkha' 'gro'i brda glu yig gzugs su bkod pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig: sarba maṅga lo/
o rgyan padma'i rnam thar shel dkar bum pa bzang po zhes bya bzhugs so:

77 tshonasgetshwa'idzakhri zo ma.uḥhūṃ badzra gu ru padma sidhihūṃ:ngo mtshar sprul sku o rgyan rin po che'i:mdzad pa'i rnam thar bsgrang 'das blos mi dpogs:cha tsam /rdo rsha'i rten 'dir bkod pa la:ma 'ongs rnams kyis phyag bcas gsol ba thob:e maho:sku gsum rgyal bkun dngos rdo rje 'chang:sprul pa'i dbyings brgyad bzhugs pa'i gnas brgyad dang:brten pa'i ri brgyad bsgrub pa'i mchod rten brgyad:gsang ba'i yum brgyad gtsug bkur bla ma brgyad:sbyang pa'i yon tan brgyad dang grub rtags brgyad:gdul bya slob ma mtshan gyi che ba brgyad:zab mo'i gter brgyad de 'dzin sprul sku brgyad:'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar bkod tshul ni:e ma ho:rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan btsun mo'i dbyings:bde ba kun gyi phul du phyin pa'i dbyings:zag med ye shes chags thog bal ba'i dbyings:sher rab ma rmongs phrin las nub med dbyings:gdul bya mi 'gagasagang yang gsal ba'i dbyings:'dul byed ston pa 'char gzhi shar cha'i dbyings:mi nub zag bral chos gter mdzad med dbyings:dam tshig gnad nas bskul

shāshā mkhas dhakki'i dbyings:thams cad lhun grub dha na ko sha'i mtshor:me tog padma bram ze'u dmar po'i lhum:dus gsum sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rje byon:dag jenge sa zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:sprul pa'i dbyings brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o: sgo75) yims snye'atshibasgres bral snang ba mtha' yas kyis:zag med mkhyen brtse'i lde mig dpal be'u las:nyer 'khrungs rgyal sras padma rgyal po ni:lus med mkha' 'argya'i gdul zhing skyongs pa'i phyir:o rgyan dha na ko ga'imatsho gling bzhugs:lta log mu steg bstan pa tshar bcad phyir:rdo rje gdan dang zangs gling gser gling bzhugs:ma chags thabs shes rol ston mdzad pa'i phyir:thor cog dgu ldan ratna'i pho brang bzhugs:sangs rgyas bstan la so nams byed pa'i phyir:kun dga'i nye 'dabs a su ra la bzhugs:li yi yul khams chos la 'god bya'i phyir:gsang sngags chogs ra lcang ra smug por bzhugs:bal yul gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs ba'i phyir:yang phur bsgrub bzhin yang le shod du bzhugs:bod yul gdug pa'i lha 'dre dam 'dog

phyir:has po ri rtser ar gtad dgongs pas bzhugs:bsam yas lhun grub gter gyi mdzad pa rtsal:da lta gdongs dmar srin po'i yul du bzhugs:rgya bal bod kyi bstan 'gro'i so nams sgrubs:bka' drin mtshungs med mgon khyod yang yang dran:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:bzhugs pa'i gnas brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: shā snye/go/ zo e ma ho:sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma thod 'phreng rtsal:thams cad kun mkhyen shes rab blo gros rgyas:ye shes gzigs pa chags thog bral ba'i sku:mi 'byed zhing gi mgon du pheb pa'i dus:rgyal srid spangs nas bka' skyong ri la brten:gsang sngags spyod phyir ma la ya rtser brten:ting 'dzin skyongs phyir nam mkha'i dbyings la brten:zab gter rgya 'byed bde byed brtsegs par brten:kun rdzob rtsis mdzad rgya nag ri la brten:thub bstan spel phyir gnas yul nyer bzhir brten:dregs pa 'dul byed gangs chen brgyad la brten:'gro don mdzad phyir bod yul mtha' dbus brten phyi tshes dgra dang bgegs sgog 'phrog la brtson:nang gnyer lta dgongs mdzad pa'i phrin

47 / las spel:gsang ba rang sems 'od gsal lha skur smin:sgyu lus 'pho chen dwangs ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengs:srid na mtshungs bral sangs rgyas thugs rje can:nga sa snyigs 'gro'i gdul bya ma 'dor kye:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:brten pa'i ri brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: sgom18nya em hoskyabs gsum mchog gsum sku gsum rin po che:tha mi dad pa rje btsun thugs rje'i gter:'gro re'i snang ngor 'dul byed sprul sku re:gang 'dul mdzad pa sbyor sgrol bsam mtha' yas:spu gris gtam pa'i mchod rten rgyab brten nas:'jig rten chos brgyad bya ba ro snyoms btang:rdo rje mi shig phug par rgyab brten nas:bla rgyan mkha' 'gro'ibarda chos mang po bsgyur:padma brtsegs par chos rdzong rgyab brten nas:bdud rtsi bam ros sgrub pas gzhan phan brtsam:smon lam grub pa bya rung kha shor brten:nang rgyud yo ga gsum la sbyangs pa mdzad:kha che'i yul du bde byed brtsegs par brten sgrub sde dgu yi bka' bab dngos grub brnyes:mun pa can der gzi 'dra'i mchod rten brten:'das

dang ma 'ongs da lta'i 'byung lung bstan: ngo mtshar rdo las grub pa'i mchod sdong brten: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i so nam rgya cher spel: lto phyogs mon brag rdo rje'i brag rdzong brten zab mo'i gter dang chos 'byung lung byang bkod: chos kyi sgron me'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'gyed: snyigs 'gro'i gdul bya thugs rje brtse bas 'dzin: bod 'bangs mi 'dor bde skyid sprul skus spel: ci la bsam kyang mgon khyod snying nas dran: dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: bsgrub pa'i mchod rten brgyad brten pa'i le'u ste: bzhi pa'o:21'o/dza)ru e ma he: dga' bzhi'i dpal sbyin gu ru ā tsārya bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas zur mig g.yo: gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i mkha' 'gro dang: dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor rtag tu 'dud: gdul bya'i yul la rdo rje'i sku bskyed yum: bram ze dmar po chags pa'i rdul bral yin: 'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal srid skyongs bde ba'i yum:mi dbang zla ba'i sras mo 'od 'chang yin: 'dod chags bzhi sbyor dga' ba'i zil mig btud: bal 'bangs ka la sidhi bya ba yin: tshe yi rig 'dzin 'ja' lus sku bskyed yum:

shāshā lha lcam me tog manta ra ba yin: bal yul bstan dang gter gyi gzhi 'dzin pa'i: thugs byon bu mo shākya dhe wa yin: gangs ljongs bod yul chos kyi sgron me (11mdzad pa'i sde'u mig ye shes mcho rgyal yin zla zhol mon khal tsakras 'deg pa na: bde ba'i mchod 'bul bkra shis khye 'dren yin: 'dzam gling tha gru gter gyis phyur bkang tshe: ngang byung dpal gyi sgron me bya ba yin: nyid dang ma mjal ma 'ongs las can la: lam la sgrub yod 'bras bu btsal yod pa: reg grol phyag rgya'i nye lams nusachos sgyu lus lha skur smin pa'i thabs mchog bstan: bde chen chos kyi 'byung gnas dpa' bo khyod: yang yang dran bzhin dga' bzhi'i tshogs ston 'bul: dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: gsang ba'i yum brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste: lnga pa'o: 214gadze oṃmalta sangs rgyas kun gyigasang ba mchog 'dzin pa: mi phyed rdo rje gdul bya'i skyabs gcig pu: rgyal dgongs lag bcing gdams don rang ngo sprod: rig pa rang byung bla ma pad 'byung gis: 'og min gnas su rdo rje 'chang chen brten: dgongs brgyud byin

rlabs rgyal thabs spyi blugs thob:rig 'dzin gnas su lag na rdo rje brten:gling bslang mdzad pas rig 'dzin brda' rgyud thobs:rgya mtsho'i gling tshal dga' rab rdo rje brten:a ti yo gar mkhas grub phul du phyin:dur khrod gnas su bṛ seng ha brten:don dam gnad gcig 'ja' lus man ngag rnyed:ston pa'i nye gnas kun dga' bo yang brten:chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' lung nod:rgya nag yul du 'phags pa 'jam dpal brten:rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong nyan:nyi ma sprin char 'khrigs pa'i 'ja' 'gyu'i nang:mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo brtes:mchog dbang rnam bzhi tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes:bde byed brtsegs par zab rgyas sgo 'byed pas:he ru ka dpal bde chen 'khor lo bsnyen:zab pa'i yang zab shams 'dogs gnas byang dang:man ngag mdo rtsa lkog yig snying byang bcas:gdul bya'i lhag ma skyobs pa'i bka' drin brtsal:skyid rgyan thugs rje'i gter chen de nyid dran:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:bla ma rnam brgyad bsten pa'i le'u ste:drug pa'o: 23yig / e ma ho:yon tan du mas

shāX spras pa'i padma 'byung:phyogs dang ris med thugs rje'i gter chen po:gdul bya'i khams su phan bde'i char ba phab:o rgyan thugs rje'i gter chen gang de 〉(1dang po bzo gso sgra tshad nang don ste:rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la mkhas par sbyangs:'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa rnam gsum ste:nyan rang byang sems chos la sbyangs pa byas:kri ya u pa ya dang yo ga ste:rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa dag la bslab:rig pa'i rtsal 'dod ma hā yo ga yis:snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur sbyangs:cho 'phrul nyid du 'dod pa a nu yis:dbyings ye sras gsum bde ba chen por sbyangs:rig pa'i dkyil 'khor rang snanga.a ti yis:ngo rang thugs rje ye shes gcig tu sbyangs:lhun grub 'od gsal dbyings thig lu gu rgyud:shes rab rang byung 'od kyi phung por sbyangs:gdul bya'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya —3gang 'dul mdzad pa phrin las du mar sbyangs:bshad dang sgrub pa sbyor sgrol sna tshogs pas:gang 'brel don ldan rig 'dzin zhing la 'god:mthong thos dran reg rnam 'dren mgon po khyed:nyin dran mtshan dran ci la bsam

kyang dran: dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: sbyangs pa'i yon tan brgyad kyi le'u ste: bdun pa'o: sodza/dza/rta e ma ho:phul byung mkhas grub bye bas brgyan gcig pu: 'bum phrag dhaski'i sprin phung 'brugs pa'i rje: dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rin po che'i: che ba'i yon tan blo yis mi dpog kyang: mdzad pa dang po'i tshul de mthong thos mdzod: pradzñā kirti'i spyan gsal grub rtags bstan: zangs gser kha che'i kun rgyus dug 'gyed kyang: gang gis ma tshug tshar bcad grub rtags bstan: za hor phra mas til mar mer bsregs kyang: ma tshug pad sdong rtser bzhengs grub rtags bstan: bal yul 'gro ba'i bde skyid stel ba la: bar chad bzhi byung bsal ba'i grub rtags bstan: bod khams lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul mang bstan kyang: bka' gzir dam btags gter gtad grub rtags bstan: bod rgyal bdud blon phyag la 'gyeng tsa na: nga che nga btsan dpa' glus grub rtags bstan: bsam yas lhun grub rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub:srog bdag gza' klu ar gtad grub rtags bstan: phyag zhabs sku rjes dad pa'i rten du bzhag: bod

723 khams mtha' dbus byin rlabs grub rtags bstan:zag pa zad pa'i sku yis 'dul ba dang:theg dgu'i sgo 'byed gsung gsang chos kyis 'dul:thams byed )na mkhyen gter gyis rgud pa 'dul:dngos grub rgen 'byung /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs padma 'byung gnas 'di byeligatsug rgyan bkur:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:grub rtags rnam brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o:thorgadza/rta em ho:padma las pyon brdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku:'chi med ye shes grub pa'i dpa' bo des:dpal chen sgrub sde dgu yi dal zhal phyes:bka' bab bu dgu'i grub pa'i rtags brnyes pa:nam mkhalisnyeng po nyi ma'i zer la byon:ye shes ma mo bdun la gsang spyod mdzad:rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad gtsug nas bton:yul gsum gyad du gyur ba'i grub rtags bstan:dzñā na ku mas brag las tshe chu bton:snang ba dbang bsgyur che ba'i yon tan 'byor:sangs rgyas ye shes rtogs pa phul du phyin:yongs rdzogs brag la sgrub phur 'dzug par mdzad:yeshes mcho rgyal bsad pa'i mi ro bslang:gnam mtshor sngags

bsgrub phur pa'i lha zhal gzigs:'brog mi dpal gyis ma mo bran du bkol:dbang phyug gser gyi sring mo'i bde stong stobs:khye'u chung lo tsa'i sgyu lus rtsa mdud grol:grub rtags snying rus rdzu 'phrul phul du phyin bee ro tsa na o rgyan lta dgongs mnyams:mngon spyod lhun gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug gyur:gzhan yang rgya bal li dang bod kyi yul:grub pa'i mtshan ma brtes pa'i rig 'dzin ni:nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu tshad bzung bral:thams cad gu ru nyid kyi phrin las so:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:gdul bya slob ma brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste:dgu pa'o:〉shā ma2) e ma ho:gangs ljongs nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur bstan 'gro'i mgon:o rgyan slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis:tshe yi rig 'dzin rdo rje sku mchog 'grub:dus gsum kun mkhyen mi 'byed zhing kun brkyangs:gling dbus mtsho dkyil padma'i ze'u 'brur byon:snang ba mtha' yas mtsho skyes rdo rje grags:o ṭi ya nar bde stong gsang spyod bstan:he ru ka dpal padma rgyal por grags:bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs mdzad pa brkyangs:rin chen sems

77 3 dpa' nyi ma 'od zer grags:sa yi lha mo bstan mas chos gos phul:sangs rgyas gnyis pa shākya seng ger grags:thams cad kun mkhyen shes rab gter rge ༷rshad:shes byar ma rmongs blo ldan mchog sred grags:'jigs tshogs lta dman rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i:dam sri'i dpa' rkong seng ge sgra sgrogs grags:rgya bal bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbar:sde gsum mdzod 'dzin padma saṃ bhar grags:dregs pa tshar bcad gangs brag gter gyis gtams:snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rdo rje khro lod grags:mi 'byed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya na:mdo ltar rgyal ba shāka thub bye phrag brgya:sngags ston gu ru pad 'byung de ltar yin:gang la gang 'dul mdzad tshul bsgrangs las 'das:sprul gzhi 'chi med gnyug ma'i rdo rje che:rgyal ba gangs can mtsho khyod snying nas dran:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:che ba'i mtshan brgyad bstan pa'i le'u ste:bcu pa'o: ོ e ma ho:srid na mtshungs bral padma thod phreng rtsal:bde ba'i 'byung gnas mkha' ldeng dbang phyug gis:dus tshig dgongs nas rje 'bangs bu slob la:phun

tshogs gzhi bzungs dgongs pa'i gtad rgya mdzad: thugs kyi gter mdzod rdo rje brag la sbas: sku yi zab rgya rin chen sa la bkod: yon tan mi nub 'byung ba chu la bkram:chags pa'i rdul bral padma shing la gtams:bya ba lhun grub bre ku pha wong bkod:chos dbyings mi nub nam mkha'i slong la bzhugs: rin chen rigs can shel lam bse la byas:rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo dang shing la gtams: padma nyid ni rdza ma zang la byas: las kyi snod mchog lcags dang lpags la bzhugs: chos dbyings thod rgya sred len bral ba'i mdzod:gzhi yang ta la shel re ga skya nul ma: rū tra'i snying re ga phun sum tshogs pa'i nor: g.yu dang beeḍūr zangs mtshan snag dag gis: dkar nag khra bo thig le lug rgyud tshul:dgongs pa'i ring bsrel brda ru brgyud pa yin: rig lnga'i rtags 'dzin dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma:rdo rje'i bka' skyongs phyi nang drong 'dzin yin: zab pa bdun ldan yid bzhin nor bu'i gter: sems can yun du bde phyir bla gter sbas: bsod nams spel zhing rgyas phyir nor gter sbas: 'don dus gter tshab 'dzud dgos gter kha bkod: ma bton

ma 〉 mkha' 'gro 'khu ba'i gter kha sbas: 'don mi rung ba snying po'i gter mchog bkod: 'dzam gling spyi la dgos pa'i gter kha bzhag: dgos su skal ldan rgekhyedro nor gter kha sbas: 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing bkod man ngag sbas: padma'i pha nor rin chen nor bu'i dpal: dper na dug sbrul mgo yi gter dang mtshung: phung 'tshangs nus pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod yin zhwa nye rin chen gser gnyis 'dra ba min: brtags gzhig btang na rno nus khyad par che: sku tshab sa gter gsung tshab sde gsum mdzod thugs tshab sprul sku mdzad phrin smon lam mthus: nam zlas bskul ba'i rtsi thog 'bus pa bzhin: las 'phro o rgyan gter kyang de bzhin no: dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: zab mo'i gter kha brgyad kyi le'u ste: bcu gcig pa'o: 234 ོ e ma ho rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug he ru ga'i: thugs bskyed dag pa'i smon lam las 'khrungs ba: dgongs spyod dag pa'i rdo rje gling pa yis: rig pa shar ba shar gyi gter sgo 'byed: byam pa chen po'i rin chen gling pa yis: nyams rtogs rgyas pa lho yi gter

kha 'byed: bde ba mchog sbyin padma gling pa yis: chags pa'i skyon bral nub kyi gter sgo 'byed: phrin las lhun rdzogs garma gling pa yis: mthong thos rnam grol byang gi gter sgo 'byed: mi 'gyur lhun po skyes rgyan gling pa yis: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang bsgyur gter kha 'byed: yid bzhin bsam 'phel sangs rgyas gling pa yis: dgos rgu 'byung ba dpal bum gter sgo 'byed: 'brel tshad don ldan gter bdag gling pa yis: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi phan bde 'gyed: smon lam 'phro btsan bde chen gling pa yis: chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzod kyis brda chos ston: gang 'brel0( rgyan padma'i zhabs drung 'tshogs: nga dang gtan gyis 'phrad do ma 'ongs rnams: mkha' 'dza'i zab mdzod rin chen gser 'gyur rtsis: gdul bya'i lcags khams ratna nyid du bsgyur: gter chen re dang sprul pa'i gter phran brgya: sa rtags dus kyi 'phel 'grib gso ba'i phyir: dus ngan tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'byung: bka' drin zla bral o rgyan chos kyi rje: skyid sdug legs nyes 'di phyi'i re ltos yin: dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: thugs sras gling pa

rshardoX rgyad kyi le'u ste: bcu gnyis pa'o: rtsi e ma ho: nyon dang bod kyijo mo mtsho rgyal ma: dus ngan snyigs ma sum cu kha ral skabs: lo yi snyedarsha ma lcags yos chu mo sbrul: spron logs mu stegs zhang zhung bon po yi: khra byang spre'u mgo can tshe 'phos pa: gnod sbyin spun gsum mtha' dang gling bar skye: sems can bde skyid 'phrog pa'i sngon por 'gyur: gnam gyi kha leb sa gzhi beeḍūr mdog: bya ba mi 'dra spyod pa du mar 'gyur: shog khra dngul gyi rgyal khams lab lob byed: skye dgu thams cad blo sems snang ba 'gyur: gra sa chos dgon mdog bslad khra bor byed: rang srid chas la gzhan gyis hab thob byed: phyogs mtshams mi rnams gral kha so sor 'thor: gza' mi skyid por 'dug pa'i skal ba dman: bstan pa dar ba lo gsum zla ba dgu: gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa de grangs zla ba bzhi: lhag ma tsam yang lo gsum mthong tsam byed: stod nas gdong lnga'i nga ro bsgrags pa na: 'bras bu sngags kyibastan pa dar bar byed: bar nas rma bya'i gshog 'gyur byed tsa na: 'dul bstan me ro lta bu lhab lhab 'bar: smad nas

dbyar rnga'i grags snyan ldir ba las:gnas skabs 'gro la bde skyid nyin mor byed:gling bar me yis zer thag 'phreng ba spreng:sa chen ldir bas rgyal khams yom yom bsgul:mtshon cha gtor bas nyes dang nyes med gzir:dkar po'i bya 'phur gnam sa yo log byed:sngon po'i bya tshogs me long hub chu 'dren:smon log bu mos bstan zhabs sdud pa na:skyid rgyan nga la 'di phyi'i re ltos gyis:lho nub dpal rir 'dun pa yang yang gtod:kha lag dal med badzra gu ru sgogs:rig drug sdug bsngal padma nga yis skyobs:mi bslu nges pa dam tshig sa ma ya:'jin rten chos kyi ci bya sngon pos bsgyur:bsam pa sne mang 'grub khom 'dug gam ci:che bzhag chung bskyur dkon mchog gsum la gtod:phyi mar 'gro ba'i dam chos rtsol ran yin:chos 'bri chos 'don chos bshad nan chags kyis:mun pa'i gling na nyi zhur 'dren mi ni:a/ rgyan nga sprul rdo rje gzi brjid yin:bya ba brtags nas thams cad rjes su zhugs:bod 'bangs bslu bar mi byed na ra gan:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse ba'i snying byang le'u ste:

rsharsharsha bcu gsum pa'o: ོ e ma ho:gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams:thabs mang lam gyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yis:(11 rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas dang:rgyal tshab sprul ba'i gter ston rgya mtsho yis:snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dmu rgod snying rjes yul:'phel 'grib khug pa bar bar rgud pa gso:mthar ni bstan 'dza'i bde skyid dpal 'byor rgud nad mug mtshon cha'i gzing bas rab tu mnar:sa steng mu stegs mtha' mi'i bstan pas khyab:dkar po'i chos ni nyi zhur tsam yang med:gsod gcod sdig pa'i las ni bsam mtha' yas:rtags chad gnyis kyi lta la rab gnas tshe:sa rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsal:rig ldan drag po lcags 'khor phyag rgyar bzhengs:rje 'bangs nyer lnga gyad stobs rgyal po re:gter chen brgya rtsa mi sdug gtso bo che:gter phran stong ni dpung gi kha lo ba:las dmag dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i tshogs:rdo yi rta mchog khro ngar gling po che:gyad po che rnams shing rta'i mtshon 'khor 'dren:nam mkha' bar snang rdzu 'phrul dmag gi gang:mtha' yi dmag gi

dpung tshogs thams cad kyang:rgyal pos rgyal po gtso bos gtso bo dang:blon gyis blon po rdo rta'i rta mchog 'dul:khro ngar glang pos glang po tshar bcad nas:mtshon 'khor shing rta'i lcags bya ri li bsad:dmangs rnams thams cad dam pa'i chos la bkod:bde gsang kye 'jigs dus kyi 'khor lo yis bstan pa'i sgon me bshad sgrub mdzad pas brkyangs:tshom bu 'bum bcas drag po mtshon 'khor can:'og min chos dbyings gnas su mngon byang chub:sras dang yang sras bdun rgyud tshun chad du:sgyu lus mi spangs tshom bur mkha' spyod gshegs:de nas phyi dar gsang sngags bstan pa ni:brgya dang brgya cu'i bar du dar zhing rgyas:mthong thos dran reg thar lam zin pa ni:o rgyan chen po'i mdzad pa phrin las yin:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las:rigs ldan byon par bstan pa'i le'u ste:bcu bzhi pa'o: ོ e ma ho:skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i phyi gzugs bla ma rje:o rgyan chen po padma thod 'phreng rtsal:da lta o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus bzhugs:zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo tsitta'i dbyibs:rtsa ba klu rgyal

(77 'jog po'i thod du btegs:gling bar srin gling brgya dang brgyad cus bstod sked par dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor mas:nyin mtshan rtags par gsang rtergormi tshogs ston spro:bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston spyod pa skyongs:padma'i phrin las spro bsdu sna tshogs pa glu gar bro dang rol mo'i skyel bsu byed rtse la padma 'od kyi gzhal med khang:rin chen sna bzhi'i rtsigs pa 'dod rnam dang:pha gu drwa ba drwa byed shar bu mda':sgo bzhi rta bab phyi nang gsang ba'i brgyan:ma lus phun tshogs gzhal yas khang mdzes nang:rin chen zur brgyad pad zla nyi ma'i khar:bde gshegs yongs 'dus padma 'byung gnas sku:snang srid zil gnon rgyal po rol thabs bzhugs:g.yas phyogs rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu yang:he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs rol ba'i tshul:g.yon ngos rje 'bangs lo paṇa 'ja' ltar 'khyugs:mdun tu sprul pa'i gter ston mu mtha' yas:ging dang liṅga'i dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdung:rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bshad sgrub bsgro gling mdzad:dpa' bo mkha' 'gra'i mchod bstod bkur sti 'bul:thugs rje'i 'od zer gangs ljongs

bod la 'gyed: sku dngos sprul bas mi 'byed zhing kun 'dul: nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs bcibs skal ldan skyongs: 'di phyi'i re ltos o rgyan chen po la: ma 'ongs skal ldanarnams kyis gsol ba thob: mi basmu jes pa padma'i zhal bzhes yod: skye 'chi na rga sdug bsngal gdung ba kun: dran pas zhi 'gyur bdud rtsi'i char ba 'bebs: bde skyid kun 'byung baspu ba med pa'i skyabs: dus gsum sangs rgyas pad 'byung rjes su slob: phyi ma sprul sku'i zhing khams dpal gyi rir: o rgyan chen po'i zhabs drung 'tshogs par 'gyur:dag snang mi zad dpal gyi bum bzang las: dpal ri'i zhing bkod bstan pa'i le'u ste: bco lnga pa'o: 23yi za e ma nyo dbyangs can sprul pa ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis:padma'i rnam thar 'di brjod dge ba yis: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid chos kyis 'tsho: nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dus kyi rgud pa zhi: gza' klu rgyal pos sgog dbug sdud pa bzlog: mo rtsis rmi lam cho 'phrul ngan pa sel: gnas skabs mthar thugs o rgyan thugs rjes gzigs: rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su skye bar shog: a.āḥ( badzra gu ru padma

rsharsha) sirnyi shāḥ padma'i rnam thar dpal gyi bum pa bzang po rdzogs so: kho mo mtsho rgyal thugs dam gsang ba'i mthil gcig go: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang mgo zloshā bye ma shī la'i mtshan can nas bkra shis lha regs shog gu'i mthun rkyen bcas nas bskul ba dang: lung zin dharmā kirta'i dum gcig mi yi nor bu bkra shis lha reg snag gi skyes bcas snga sor nas bskul ba'i dgongs bzhed 'grub phyir dang: nye gnas mkhar lo nas kyang dad mos kyis bskul ba la brten nasakhobanus ldan 'dus pa rtsal rgyas dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig: sarba maṅga le
—1༷ dag snang las: rje btsun sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i don bsdus bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhugs so:

'o/ na rmo gu ru padma ka ra yi: gastso1 khyed shes dad pa drag po yis:gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya:e ma nyoskye med dbyings su mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i:chos rge) rtel ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs:'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa:longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rnams la gsol ba 'debs:mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon:sprul sku'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs:'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi:rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs:byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i rtsa gsum dam can rnams la gsol ba 'debs:sdug bsngal srid las dbugs dbyung mchog thun gyi:dngos grub kun thob bslu ba med pa'i skyabs:rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs drung skye bar thegag:bla ma'i sku gsum gsol 'debs 'di:mos gus nam 'byung dus su bya:sa ma yā:e ma ho:bskal bzang bye na mer gsang sngags bstan pa byon:ma tram̐ rū tra thugs rje'i thabs kyis bsgral:phrin las rnam bzhi'i bde gshegs bka' bsgros mthun:ma la ya rtser dpa' rtags rol rtsed mdzad:rta phag sgyu 'phrul sprin

7༷ la gsol ba 'debs:sangs rgyas thugs gsang chos sku kun tu bzang:dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang:byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs bye rshardo pa:rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing la gsol ba 'debs:he ru ka dpal che mchog dbyings phyug yum:thugs kyi bdag nyid badzra khrag 'thung rgyal:'jam dpal ya manta ka gshin rje gshed:rjes chags rol mdzad rnams la gsol ba 'debs:dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal:'chi med mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med:mkha' spyod dbang bsgyur rdodzirnal 'byor ma rgyu 'bras don ston rgyal bar gsol ba 'debs:zab mo'i don ston dga' rab rdo rje dang:ri bo rtse lngar 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs:po ta la ru snying rje'i gter chen po:mthu stobs dbang phyug rnams la gsol ba 'debs:mkhyen pa'i drod thob lha dbang brgya byin dang:nus pas dbang bsgyur klu rgyal 'jog por grags:stobs kyi byin phebs rig 'dzin rgyal po dza:lha klu mi yi tshom bur gsol ba 'debs:sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun padma 'byung:rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gang gi

tshogs: sku gsum rgyal ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang: sras bcas 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs: bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum smin grol mdzod: sa/ rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: srod dus gsol ba 'dir ltar gdab byin rlabs dngos grub drod thob 'gyur:sa ma yā: e ma ho: snyed nub rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul: rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: dū tra'i tsitta sa rgyan yul du grags: rten 'brel rmad byung gnas der gsol ba 'debs:rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sprin 'khrigs:gsang sngags brda chos glu yi dga' ston 'gyed: yid la dran pa'i zhing der dbugs dbyung ba'i:ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gling la gsol ba 'debs: klu rgyal 'jog po'i dza lan dha rar bstod: lhun chags bkod mdzes dpa' bo dpa' mos bkur rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jin rten bsnyegs 'dra ba'i: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri la gsol ba 'debs: rin chen sna bdun 'od kyi gzhal med khang: phyogs mtshams steng 'og gru chad glo 'bur mdzes: ye shes 'od 'bar phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khyud: lhun grub gzhal yas khang la

/rdo gsol ba 'debs:rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang:shar bu mda' yab sgo 'byud rta bab ldan:mdzes pa'i do ra bdud rtsi'i pad tshal sogs:ya mtshan rterdo rshang khang par gsol ba de dbus rin chen zur brgyad pad zla'i khar:bde gshegs kun dngos sprul sku padma 'byung:sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rnams lhun gyis grub:rnam mang phrin las 'gyed la gsol ba 'debs:ri rgyal las brjid nyi zla'i 'od 'bar zhing:mkhyen brtse klong yangs sprul pas 'jig rten khyab:gsol btab phrin las nam mkha'i glog ltar myur:thugs rje khyad par can la gsol ba 'debs:sbyor sgrol zhi rgyas 'gro ba'i don du mdzad:zhal 'dzum spyan dwangs skal ldan mos mtshor phyogs:gsang sngags chos char gdul bya'i dpal du 'gyed:'brel tshad rnam grol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs:sgrub dang rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor spro bsdu 'gyed:phyogs mtshams rigs bzhi ging dang mkha' 'gror 'dud:dur khrod rus rgyan brtul zhugs pro gar bsgyur:ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs:'dod snams mchod pa'i lha mos pu dza spro:sras

bcas rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang bsod nams stel: rgyal chen sde bzhi drags pa'i bu yug 'tshubs: rtsa gsum kun 'dus rje la gsol ba 'debs: dzñāḥ bzhengs rodeg rnga yab dpal gyi ri nas gshegs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu bcas: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ngom bzhin du: snyigs ma'i smag khrod dug chus myos pa'i 'gro: bdag dang bdag 'dra yal bar mi 'dor bar: dgongs rgyud byin rlabs drod tshad 'bebs bzhin du: phrin las rgyang thag ma ring myur bar rtsol: bgegs dpung log 'dren bar chad 'dulab dang: mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter rtsol la: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol: sa rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: 'dun pa drag pogatad bgo du: tho rangs gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: sa ma yā: e ma ho rgyal ba kun bzang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang: rdo rje 'chang dbang byang chub sems dpa'i rje: chos sku longs sku sprul sgu rnam pa gsum: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debasaḥ grwa ma lnga dang rig 'dzin rgyal po dza: lha dbang brgya byin sems dpa' rig pa'i brgyud: byed po rdor sems

/rdo dga' rab bṛ seng:rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs:rgyal ba chos sku rig lnga rig gsum mgon sgegs rdor sangs rgyas gsang ba bi ma (11 ban rin mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug rje:sgyu 'phrul brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs:'jam dpal gshin rje rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal:ro lang bde ba sku yi brgyud pa dang:padma he ru dbang gi lha mo dang:klu grub gsung brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs:badzra he ru dga' rab mañdzu bṛ:ka chen ka ra thugs kyi brgyud pa dang:che ba'i mchog gyur sprul ba'i rig 'dzin tshogs:bdud rtsi yon tan brgyud par gsol ba 'debs:rdo rje gzhon nu phyag chen rig pa 'dzin:thod pa'i phreng ba phrin las brgyud pa'i mdzod:mngon rdzogs lha mo dha na saṃ kri ta:srid pa ma brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs:dregs pa kun 'dul ram bu gu hye'i zhabs:shakya seng ge mchod bstod brgyud pa 'dzin:stobs ldan nag po shidzha garbha dang:gro lod drags sngags brgyud par gsol ba 'debs:tshe dpag med mgon lha mo tsanta li:padma 'byung gnas rdo rje tshe yi brgyud:phag mo seng gdongs rdo rje

drag po rtsal: gsang sngags ma brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs: rdo rje khrag 'thung o rgyan thod phreng rtsal 'dzam gling las ldan gsang sngags 'dus pa'i brgyud: shakya thub pa bho dhi sa twa'i bar: rgyu 'bras don ston bla mar gsol ba 'debs: rig 'dzin byang sems gang zag las skal ldan: lnga brgya'i bar du gsang sngags bka' bzhin sgrubs: dam tshig dag pa snyan nas snyan khung brgyud: rnal 'byor snyan brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs: snang yang bdag med 'dod chags rang grol sku: grags stong skye 'gags 'gyur med rgyal ba'i gsung: 'gyu ba rang bzhag rnam par mi rtog thugs: ye shes bla ma de la gsol ba 'debs: phyi ltar gzung ba'i yul snang dag pa dang: nang ltar 'dzin pa'i sems nyid grol ba dang: bar du 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa dzas bka' drin gsum ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs: sa rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: nam lang nyi ma shar gyi bar: khyed shes dad bas gsol ba gdab: sa ma yu: e ma ho: lho nub 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho na rang byung sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rjer grags: int+ra bo dhis spyan drang rgyal srid phul: rig 'dzin

727 thor cog can la gsol ba 'debs:srid spang bsil ba tshal gshegs stan ghan mdzad:mkha' 'gro dbang mdzad shatna rakṣir grags:mkha' 'gro'i byin byedrozlo dregs pa bran du bkol:rdo rje drag po rtsal la gsol ba 'debs:brag dmar ke'u tshang pra bha hasti brten:rnal 'byor sbyangs sgrub lha tshogs zhal gzigs thob:shakya seṅge yo ga gsum phul phyin:blo ldan mchog srid sku la gsol ba 'debs:ma ra ti gar tshe yi rig 'dzin grub :sems rtags lus shar 'chi med pad 'byung grags:za hor yul btul rdzu 'phrul rmad byung bstan:padma saṃ bha'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:o rgyan yul du gshed mas mer bsreg kyang:de nyid mtshor bsgyur padma rgyal po grags:dur khrod rnams su mkha' 'gror chos 'khor bskor:nyi ma 'od zer sku la gsol ba 'debs:rgya gar lho phyogs mu stegs bstan pa bsnubs:mkha' brgya'i byin rlabs seṅge sgra sgrogs grags:yang le shod du yang phur dngos grub brtes:rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs:kha ba can byon dam sri spun dgu btul:dregs pa'i gtsug bkur padma 'byung gnas

grags: bsam yas lhun grub bod yul chos bstan spel: gu ru thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs: brag dmar ke'u tshangs sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor gzigs: bka' bab bu dgu rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: 'bras bus gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: bka' drin bsam las 'das la gsol ba 'debs: stag tshang seng phug bdud dang dam sri btul: gnas chen gangs brag thams cad gter gyis gtams: snyigs ma'i bod 'bangs skyongs par dam bca' bzhes: rdo rje khro lod rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: gangs chen bzhi ru sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: brag phug brgyad bzhugs mtsho bzhi phyag rjes bzhag: phyogs bzhi'i brag dang mon khar sku rjes bkod: bod kyi lha gcig de la gsol ba 'debs: sku gsung thugs tshab 'gro ba'i don du bzhag: bstan pa mtha' rgyas dus kyi rgud pa bsal: da lta gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnod mdzad: rig 'dzin mkha' 'dza'i rje la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i 'od zer gangs ljongs bod la 'gyed: lnga brgya'i 'gro ba spyi mthun las kyis mnar: rje khyed rnam thar dran bzhin gsol 'debs na: sdug

47/ bsngal 'dza ra ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol:skyes rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs:dgong mo dbang gi dus skabs su:gsol ba snying nas gdab par bya:sa ma yu:byede ho:nub phyogs bde ldan padmo bkod zhing nas ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi:thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'o ma can mtshor byonaḥ sprul sku thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs:phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs:dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyis mnga' gsol phul:pha ma rus rigs rgyu rkyen las 'das sku:rang byung ngo mtshar can la gsol ba 'debs:mtshan dpe'i yon tan dpe med brjod las 'das :nyi ma stong las gzi byin mchog 'bar ba:mchog gi mtshan dang 'phrul mtshan 'gro 'dul rje:rgyal kun sku yi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs:ma chags thabs kyis rol rtsed bsam yas bsgyur:'brug chen stong gi sgra las gsung gdangs che:'gro la theg rtse'i yang snying chos char 'bebs:rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs:gting med mtha' klas mtsho gling pad sdong byon:skye med dbyings las thugs rje'i phrin las myur:

dgongs pa dri bral ci yang sa le ba:rgyal kun thugs kyi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs:'gro ba'i skyabs gcig yid bzhin nor bu'i sku:mtshan thos ngan 'dza'i sdug bsngal gdung ba zhi:dran pas byang chub sa lam dngos grub ster:yon tan kun 'byung khyed la gsol ba 'debs:padma'i zhal can bde ba'i 'od zer 'bar steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'gro don mtha' yas kyang:bod yul kha ba can du thugs rje myur:rje 'bangs bu slob skal ldan skyongs zhal bzhes:mtshungs med thugs rje can khyod 'di phyi'i skyabs:bla rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs:nga yi rjes 'jug 'khor ba spang 'dod rnams:nyin mtshan rtag par snying nas gsol ba thob:bcu drug ltag sprod gdungs dbyangs glus bskul nas:gces pa'i bu ngus ma yis mi bzod ltar:rnga yab gling nas byin rlabs dbang bskur zhes:sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam gnad nas bskul:dus drug spyod lam rnam bzhir gsol ba 'debs:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang:bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlob:nam gong gnyid las nam sad dus gsol 'debs 'o dod drag tu

72 'bod:sa ma ya:e ma ho:snang ba mtha' yas ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku:'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'gro don mdzad phyir byon:o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba (11sa:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:bod kyi rgyal pos gdung rgyud mtha' gtug par:dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs:chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:rnga yab gling nas bod la thugs rjes gzigs:nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can 'dul mdzad pa'i rjes chags brtse bas gzigs la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams yal bar 'dor med skyong:nang dgong nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs chibs byon:'gro don mtha' yas mdzad la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:rtsod dus snyigs 'gro'i nyon mongs dug lnga rags:'chor nogs spyod pa thugs rjes skyob po zhes:dad ltan 'dren stobs can la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:hor

sogs mtha' mis bstan 'gro 'jig pa'i dus:o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad khyed dran na:ru 'dzing rgud pa skyob la gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:'gro rnams sgyu lus nad kyis nyen pa na:sa/ rgyan sman bla khyed la gsol 'debs na:tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:sa yi bcud nyams skye rgu'i g.yang nyams tshe:33 rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha khyod dran bzhin:bkres skom dbul phungs bsal byir gsol 'debs na:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:gter rigs bco brgyad gdul bya'i dpal 'gyed tshe:o rgyan yi dam lha tshogs khyod dran bzhin:pha nor bu yis lon par gsol ba 'debs bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:sbas yul nags khrod sgrubs tshugs 'dzin pa'i tshe:ma rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po khyod dran bzhin:chos mdzad bu bzhin skyong phyir gsol ba 'debs:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:'drog chen phreng bsgod 'jigs tshogs gzengs langs tshe:o rgyan dpa' bo gangs tshogs khyod dran

shā mi bzhin: gdug pa'i sems can bskrod phyir gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhis 'jigs pa na:rme ༷rsha 'byung ba'i lha mo khyod dran bzhin: 'byung ba rang sar zhi phyir gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'jigs pa'i 'phrang 'grim chom rkun dgras 'jigs tshe: o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi ldan khyod dran bzhin: snying nas gsod gcod skyobs phyir gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gshed ma'i dmag 'khrugs mtshon cha 'debs nye tshe: o rgyan rdo rje gur khang khyod dran bzhin: gdung ba skyob phyir snying nas gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe zad 'chi khar gnad gcod sdug bsngal dus: o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas khyod dran bzhin: bde chen zhing du skye phyir gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'jigs pa'i bar dor 'khrul snang sdul bsngal tshe: o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa khyod dran bzhin: 'khrul snang dbyings su grol phyir gsol ba

'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe rabs las rkyen ngan pas gdung ba na: o rgyan bde chen rgyal po khyod sdug bsngal rtsad nas gcod phyirwa gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro drug spyi dang bod 'bangs sngug bsngal tshe: o rgyan thugs rje 'gyur med khyod dran bzhin: sku gsum zhing khams 'byung phyir garbesal ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'a spyob par byin gyis rlobs: rtag par rgyun du gsol bdebs shing: rje nyid dran pas sdug bsngal skyob: byin rlabs rno nus bsam mtha' yas bde rdzun lag tu long dang gsal: sa ma yā: e ma lha brag nor bu'i yang rtse nas: yin zhes ḍakki rus rgyan can gang gis 'di ltar gsol btab bas brag cha'i ri mo yig gzugs byas skal ba can la phan pa che: log ltas mnar la bsod nams dbul bka' ni sngags gyi bdag mos srungs rig 'dzin thugs kyi sras la sprod sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu khya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med yon tan rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas nan tan chen po'i bskul ngor/ kho bo sbas ba'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'gro phan gling bas gsal bar spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

cas dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las: o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i thugs dam gnad bskul zab mo bzhugs so: dzasha na mo gu ru ya:2061spyorashi sbyar spos dud spro rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs dang gdung ba'i glu mos gus dad pa drag po yis: gsol gdab thugs dam gnad bskul ni: shā dza: rngam brjid srin po'i ༷ nga khyer dpal ri nas: thod pa'i sku mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i 1nga: rin chen pad zla gnyis snang bdud bzhi'i khar: mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig thod phreng rtsal: ma rtog nga bdag gdon gyi gshed po che: srin po'i rgyal po rakka thod phreng rtsal: snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs bsal phyir thugs dam bskul: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal byung la: log rtog spyod ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs dang: bstan pa'i chom po shan pa lag dmar mkhan: khrel med rkun po sdig pa'i kha dpon pa: bsam spyod log 'khrul ngan song skye 'gyur can:thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis: shes rab ral gri bdag med phur bu'i dbal: ye shes mtshon cha 'bar bas rab bsgral te: kun rdzob mdangs byung sngags

kyi che ba bskyed: rnam shes skye med dbyings su dgongs rgyas thob: shin tu chags pas myos pa'i sems can la: thabs kyi bde ster dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: bsam bzhin mi yi rdzu ru mngon snang ste: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang bsgyur mnga' 'og bsdus: mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing der dbugs dbyung mdzod: kye ma kye hud dus kyi smag rum 'dir: snyigs ma lnga yi rang mtshang mngon sum snang: mtha' yi dmag 'khrug 'byung po mngon rgyug byed: nad dang mug ge mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'khrug: dge ba'i sma phab sdig la gzengs pa bstod:dkar phyogs byin yal nag po'i mgo 'phang mtho: dam pa'i chos khrims mkhon 'dzing log sbyor ste: bshad sgrub sgo gcod bstan pa'i chom po mang: dgra yi dpung 'tshubs bgegs kyi za kha dar: rang gi rang la yid mi ches pa'i dus: bka' khrims zab mos 'dul bar shin tu dka': ma rung bdud kyi dpung 'tshubs smag khrod 'dir: o rgyan chen pos thugs rje'i stobs rtsal phyung: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po'i rnam rol gyis: rgyal tshab 'gro 'dul rig 'dzin rjes su zungs: chu bo bdun ldan zab gter sgron me sbor: 'od

rtedu kyis snyigs ma'i rmongs mun sangs bar mdzod:zab mos gdul skal med pa'i smon log rnams:drag po mngon spyod las kyi stobs su dril:'byung po'i kha phrol phyi nang bcud g.yang bskyed:dmag dang 'khrug rtsod log sbyor zhi bar mdzod:lha srin ma mo'i dal yams sman gyis gsos:dkar phyogs dbu bstod nag phyogs dam la thogs:bka' sdod dregs pa dgongs pa'i dbyings nas bskul:chos 'khor gtsug lag bstan pa'i gnyer ka sdoms:smon log dam sri ting 'dzin sgrom rgyar chugs:rgya 'dre 'byung po rgya mtsho'i pha mthar skrod:rgyal ba'i bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar spel:gsang sngags nyi 'od mtha' dbus med par sbor:snying po'i dga' ston skal bzang tshogs la smin:gu ru'i mdzad pa phrin las rnam pa bzhis:gdul bya'i zhing khams ma lus yongs bzung ste:sprul sku'i zhing khams rnga yab dpal gyi ri:longs sku'i bkod rdzogs padma 'bum 'khyil klong:chos sku khyab brdal phyogs lhung bral ba'i zhing:rang rang dbang skal smon lam dang mtshams par:rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros lam sna drongs:mkha' spyod

mtsho rgyal ḍākkis sun ma mdzod ging dang laṅga'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: sku gsum ston pa padma rgyal po yi: thugs son sras gyur rig 'dzin mchog thob mdzod: 'dod don gsol ba btab pa'i re 'bras kun gegs med yid bzhin rtsol cig thugs rje can: rdo rje'i zhal bzhes dus bab sa ma yā de ltar dgongs pa'i gnad bskul 'di: bstan 'gro'i dpal du yang yang bya: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya 3/:zhes pa 'di'ang chos bdag kun bzang rdo rje nas bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus ste dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin sa manta bha tra'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

dzas dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las:gsol 'debs thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs: cas 14tshun2) e ma sa:sku gsum kun dngos bla mapadma 'byung:sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrigs yi dam thod phreng rtsal:ma tshogs gtsug rgyan bde mchog a tsaryaḥsnying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na:zab gter sgron me 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs:mi mjed phrag brgya'i bla ma mtsho skyes rje:bod khams mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil lta bu:zab gter gzhi ma rdo rje khro lod la:snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs lags na:phan bde'i gzhi ma zab gter rgyas gyur cig:snyigs ma'i skyabs gcig gu ru gter 'byung rgyal:zab gter gnyer bskul ye shes mtsho rgyal ma:smon lam dag pa'i ngan lam rgyal mchog la:gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes nye bar gzigs:zab gter gegs med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs:dus kyi rgud pa nad mtshon mu ge sogs:dpa' bo khyed zhal dran pa'i byin rlabs dang:zab gter pha nor 'gyed pa'i phrin las kyis:nyes tshogs kun zhi legs yon sgo 'phel nas:rdzogs ldan gsar

31sa lta bus mdzes shākyar cig: de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs 'jug: dngos grub rgya mtsho gegs med thob sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: zab gsang thugs kyi sgon me 'di: las ldan snying gi padmor rgya gu rgya brda thim:snyi: zhes rdza rgyal 'phan phyug dang 'brel ba'i gnas nas kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis gdan drangs shing dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/
cas dam chos gsang ba yong 'dus las: o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i zab sgrub yid bzhin bum bzang bzhugs so:

110 na 51 gu ru padha ka ra ye: shānatsan430 dben pa'i gnas su dam rgyas sgrub: phun tshogs lnga yi gzhi bzungs shing: bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi gzhung bsrang nas: rig pa 'dzin pa'i gsang lam spyod: sa ma yā spyi don dang po sbyor ba la skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: rang rig stong gsal ye rdzogs 'dus ma byas: sku dang ye shes ris med mnyam brdal 1nga: rtsa gsum spyi gzugs gter 'byung rgyal po la: blo bral rjen pa'i ngang nas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni: ho: brgal dka' srid pa'i rba sang sdug po rtsa las nyon zug rngu'i mnar ba'i pha ma rnams: rang snang 'khrul ba'i 'dams las rab bsgral te: ye shes sa la 'god phyir sems bskyed do: tshogs bsags ni: na mo: thams cad mnyam rdzogs bla ma'i dkyir 'khor la: ngo mtshar lta ba mjal ba'i phyag bgyi'o: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rol ston mchod pa 'bul: las nyon sems gyi dri ma mthol lo bshags: rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rjes yi rang: 'gro ba'i dpal du zab gter chos 'khor bskul: rgyal rnams 'da' med rtag par bzhugs gsol 'deb: dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: 'gro rnams rang rig mngon gyur

dzas byang chub shog: bka' bsgo ni:trī: snang sred thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul te: nga bdag mtshan mar blta ba'i dug gsum gdon: ro mnyam 'dod lnga'i dga' ston 'di khyer la: rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i gshis su dengs: ( hūṃ bisnan ta krita pāṭa pāṭa: srung 'khor ni:hrī: yenas gzham med thig le byang chub sems: rang byung yeshes lnga ldan srung ba'i gur: 'di la gnyis snang gdon gyis glags mi rnyed: srung dang bsrung bar bya ba ye sangs rgyas: dzñā na dhartu tsakra rakṣa: byin 'bebs ni: hrī: 'di nas lho nub rngayab dpal ri nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje bdud 'dul padma 'byung: o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po gtso 'khor bcas: gnas 'dir byon la ye shes gzi byin phob rgo dzña na dhartu a be sha ya a ā: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni:hri: rab mdzes zhing khams yangs pa'i khyon mnyam par: ngo mtshar phyi nang gsang mchod sprin rabs 'byams: rdo rje lha mo'i mdzes gar gla dang bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i gter du spel: ka badzra pu dza spa ra ṇa dza: sngon 'gra'i rim pa'o: rogagru spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ting 'dzin rnams gsum ni:

āX chos sku mi 'gyur spros dang bral ba las:longs spyod rdzogs mdzad snying rje yongs su 'khyil:thugs rjes ye shes 'gags med snying po tri:rten dang brten pa'i rgyu ru rnam par shar:sa badzra sa ma dhi hrī:zhing khams lha bskyed ni:hrī:dag gsal bde chen rdo rje'i rang mdangs su:phyi snod dag pa rnga yab dpal gyi ri:nang bcud mnyam rdzogs dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i dal:pho brang 'od 'bar lhun grub gzhal med khang:brda don rtags rdzogs 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil 1nga:chags bral ge sar bde stong nyi zla'i khar:rang rig bla ma 31 rgyan gter 'byung rgyal:dmar gsal dbang gi 'od 'bar zhi 'dzum chags:phyag g.yas lcags kyus gdul bya dbang du sdud:g.yon pas nyi zla zhal sbyor sgrom bu 'dzin:gsang gos dkar po 'dung ma dmar po dang:sngags phod mthing gsal za 'og ber chen klubs:pad zhwa sgro dar me long nor bus mdzes:rgyal po rol pa'i thabs bzhugs gzi 'od 'bar:lha lcam sbas tshul khā ṭwāṃ mchan du brten:rigs bdag hūṃ gar yab yum nam mkhalimadog:longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs dkyil krung 'khril sbyor rol:phyag mtshan rdo rje

dzas dril bu bsnol 'byud 'dzin: mdun tu mtsho rgyal dmar gsal zhi 'dzum mdzes: phyag g.yas bhan thod ratna'i lde'u mig 'dzin: g.yon pa gter bum bcud kyi bkange ba brten: lha mo'i chas rdzogs stong gsal 'od skur bsgom: g.yas phyogs dpa' bo sde bzhis bro gar brgyur: g.yon ngo dpa' mo rigs bzhis brda glu len: rgyab tu ging chen bzhi yis nor sna stobs: 'bum phrag mkha' 'dza'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskang: kun kyang ma 'dres dngas mtsho'i gza' skar bzhin: stongs gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal: sgog gis bskul te rnga yab dpal ri nas: gu ru pad 'byung lha tshogs sbyan drangs bstims: spyan 'dren ni trī: rnga yab gleng dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: pho brang padma 'od 'bar gzhal yas nas: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje sgod phreng rtsal: o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i rnam pa rtsa gnas 'dir byon la rig pa'i dbang chen bskur:khyed kyi mdzad pa phrin las rnam thar kun: skal ldan sgrub po'i 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla badzra ma hā gu ru sarba sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni: trī ren chen pho brang

'od 'bar nyams re dga' nyi zla padma bkrag gsal mdangs dang ldan: rtog bral bde chen rdo rje'i gdan khri la: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni: na mo: skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i phrin las can: rang byung thugs rje mi mjed 'gro ba skyobs: yid bzhin nor ltar gdul bya'i re skongs dpal: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: phri na mo na ma ya ho: mchod pa ni: hrī: dngos bshams gzungs rigs ting 'dzin las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod kun bzang sprin phung po rdo rje lha mo'i rol ston dang bcas pa: rdo rje pad ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du nye bar bzhes su gsol: gdung sems mos blos bskul ba'i dam ldan la: tshe dang dam chos gter gyi dngos grub stsol: sa ma hā pu dza sarba sa ma ya ho: bstod pa ni: hrīX ma chags bde chen dbang gi zhal bzang ngoms: gdul bya'i rgyud bskul padma'i lcags kyu dang: yid bzhin re skong gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin: o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye bzhi'i ma gos 'chi med ye shes sku: yi dam rgyud sgrub lha dang

110 gnyis med zhal: mkha' 'gro'i gtsug rgyan zab gsang chos kyi gzhi: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde ba'i sman gcig gangs ljongs skyabs pa'i ma: thugs son mtsho rgyal dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kyi man ngag mdzod 'dzin grub pa'i rje: rig 'dzin hūṃ gar yab yum sku la bstod: padma'i phrin las zab gter rgyas mdzad pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo ging tshogs bcas la bstod: bshags pa ni ho: rang rig bla ma o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal: ye nas rang dang gnyis med mnyam nyid kyang: ma rig 'khrul bas bdag mtshan bzung ba'i gnongs: dbyer med mnyam nyid klong du bshags bgyi'o: yig brgya bzla 'dzab ni: hrī: rang rig bla ma'i thug gar 'od lnga'i klong:gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar nyi zla'i sbubs: rig pa hrīḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas 'khor 'das dpal yon dbang 'dus shing: tshe dang chos dang nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas shing: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur blta: tshod gu ru ni dhī ka ra rā dza sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ ā: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer ldan pas: bzlas pa skye med dbyings las sgrogs: 'gags

med nyams rtogs mkha' ltar 'phel don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za: grangs tshad bye ba gcig tu'o: sa ma yā sgrub 'dzab ni: ā: snang ba thams cad rnga yab dpal gyi ri: srid pa'i bcud kun dpa' rnge mkha' 'gro'i dal: rang rig ngo bo bla ma padma 'byung: don dam rang chas gter 'byung rgyal po'i tshogs: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs kyi 'dzab bskul na: ye shes gzigs pa'i phrin las mngon bstan nas: chu bo bdun ldan gter gyi dngos grub stsolaci rgo gu ru ni dhi kā ra rā dza ni dhi pha la sarba sirnyi hrī: sgrub sngags ting 'dzin dgongs pas bzla bye ba gcig grub nyams rtogs 'phel zab mo chos gter rin po che'i mdzad pa phrin las mkha' ltar rgyas: sa ma yā: las sbyor ni: trī: bdag je gnas lnga nas spros pa'i: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang ba: dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam spros: gang 'dul bla ma pad 'byung gi: mdzad pa phrin las yongs grub dmigs: cha ma hā gu ru ni dhi pha la sarba sirnyi hrī: las sngags bye ba bzlas gyur na: gu ru'i thugs rje myur zin cing: phyi nang gsang ba'i gter rdol nas: mdzad pa nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'byung: sa ma yā: gsol gdab ni: yis ma bskal ba'i rtsub 'gyur dus kyi ru 'dzing skabs: 'jin rten

110 bde sdug zug rngu nyer 'tshe kun skyob pa'i sems bskyed rnam par dag pa yis: las can 'gro ba'i don la gter 'don phyir: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol 'debs na: o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu la stsol ba'i dus la babs: thugs dam ma g.yel o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs: mos bzhi dbang bsdus gter gyis 'dul bar shog: zhes gsol ba grangs mang du gdab pas dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par 'gyur ro: sa ma yāX dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o: thag40 spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la tshogs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni: ā: 'dzanar 'das ro mnyam sbyor ba bhanta'i snod: stong gsum mnyam par sha lnga bdud rtsis gtams: bza' ba tshogs kun ye shes 'khor lor spel: rig stong lha mo'i gar bcas 'dod yon spro: sa badzra pu dza spa ra ṇa dza: spyan 'dren ni: shā trī:sgyu 'phrul chogs sprul srin pa'i gling dbus nas: rang rig ngo bo bla ma padma 'byung: 'pho 'gyur mi dmigs gter 'byung rgyal po'i sku: ye shes gcig las rnam rol 'khor dang

bcas: ro mnyam tshogs la sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtogs pa rmad byung mngon gyur dngos grub stsol: tho badzra gu ru ni dhi kā ra rā dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs phud rim pa gsum las dang po ni: hrī: skye med mchen pa'i snod mchog ka pā lar: 'gags med brda ston sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs: rtsol med ro mnyam dgongs pas dang blang nas: rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: sa ma hā gha ṇa tsakra pu dza ya ho: bar ba ni: ho blo chung rtogs pa dman pa'i dbang gyur te: nyon mongs 'khrul bas bsrung shing sdom dam nyams: ma rig gzung 'dzin 'thas pa'i dri ma kun: ye shes rig pas bshags so bzod par bzhes: badzra sa ma ya bhi shukhye ā: tha ma ni: kaka kakaka gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i dug gsum gdon: tshogs yul mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'dre bo che: shes rab mtshon chas kun rdzob mtshan ma mthar: bdag med phur bus skye med dbyings su gzhig sarba ru tra ༄bye ma ra ya phaṭaḥ tsū hrī: chos nyid mnyam pa'i zhal hom gdengs pa dzas log rtogs mtshan ma bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabs: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por 'dren rol nas:

11 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod:ma hā me sa rakta tsitta la khā tī:lhag ma ni:phe:dgongs pa skye med dbyings la mnyam mod kyang:rnam rol cir yang snang ba'i phrin las sku:stong nyid mkha' la sna tshogs spyod bzhin 'gro:ye shes rjes su 'jug pa'i dam tshig can:mnyam nyid rol ston lhag gtor 'di bzhes la:nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas mdzad phrin mtha' yas pas:gdul bya'i zhing khams 'dul ba'i phrin las sgrubs:ma ma hri bā lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi:bskul ba ni:hūṃ hrī:rdo rje khrag 'thung padma he ru ga:rnga yab srin po yongs kyi tshogs rje bo:mi mjed zhing khyab thugs rje'i bdaganyid can:snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal phyir thugs dam bskul:dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos nas:mos ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams byin gyis rlobs:log par lta ba skye med dbyings su sgrol:chags pas bcing rnams mnyam pa nyid du sbyor:gnyis 'dzin bdud bzhi gnyis med chen por bsres:'khrul ba'i 'khor lo ka dag dbyings su gzhom:don dam mdzad pa med byung 'byung bar mdzod:chad tho ni:nyu bhya:'og min

gnasadang rnga yab dpal gyi ri:sa spyod mkha' spyod gnas yul kun nyul ba'i:rdo rje'i chos skyong bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pa:ma mgon lcam dral dregs pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs:sngon nas gnyer blangs dam tshig ji bzhin du:'dir byon chad kyi gtor ma dgyes bzhes la:phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sol:sgrub pa zab mo mtha' ru phyin pa dang:dngos grub rgya mtsho thogs pa med par stsol:bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma dbyings su zhi ba dang:ro snyoms rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas par spel:tshogs yul chos khams rig pa'i dbang bsdus te:mngon rlom 'dzin pa de bzhin nyid du sgol:thugs kyi bstan pa yangs pa'i khams su spel:snying po'i rnal 'byor 'du ba rgyas par mdzod:rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sa lam du:skyel zhing bsu ba'i phrin las ma g.yel zhig:bstan ma ni:bhyo slob dpon padma khrag 'thung rgyal po yis:spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig gnyer thob pa'i:bod skyongs brtan ma bcu gnyis g.yogs dang bcas:'di ru 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byon:dam rdzas bshal chu'i skyems dang gtor ma bzhes:'jin rten rgud pa nad mug

110 mtshon 'khrug sol:zab gter bstan pa phyogs rnams kun du spel:chos kyimathun snang dgos 'dod char phob la:sde gnyis 'dzin rnams dge legs dpal 'byor te:don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig:sarba lo ka ḍākki ni pañtsa rakta bā lirha khā hi:rta bro ni:trī:chos nyid lta ba rtogs pa brtul zhugs kyis:gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin bdud dang dam sri kun:skye med dbyings su ar la gtad par bya:rang byung rtogs pa blo bral ma 'khrungs bar:nam yang ma ldang chos sku'i dgongs rgyas btab:mtshan ma rang grol phyag rgyas bcing bar bya:37 ā& swā hā stam bha ya nan:dngos grub ni:shā trī:nam mkhalimatha' dang mnyam pa'i dbyings nyid las:ye shes thugs rje'i yongs gang bla ma'i dal:gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du sgrub 'bras ni:rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i dngos grub dang:chos kun byin gyis rlabs pa'i nus mthu stobs:zad med gter dang smin grol dbang byin rlabs:ma lus sgrub pa po la rab rtsal nas:sku gsum lhun grub dpal la mnga' brnyes mdzod:siddhi pha la a la la ho:bshags pa ni to ma

rig 'dzin pa'i dbang gyur 'khor bar 'khyams:sems la lam byas sor byang sngags dang 'gal:thams cad sgrib med rig par rab bcom te:gnas lugs ka dag dbyings su bsal bar bya:badzra sa ma ya ā:yig brgya bzla:bsngo smon ni:zwa dge kun gcig bsdus 'aX ra gsum dag par ba〈sna:yid chos dri ma ka nas dag pa dang:gnas lugs sku gsum lhun rdzogs dpal gyi rir:rang rig bla ma'i gsang gsum mngon gyur re ga:bsdu rim ni:ā:snod bcud zhing khams lha sku'i rol pa kun rim bzhin bsdus te thugs ga'i sgog yig la:'od zhu nā da mtha' bral de bzhin nyid:smra bsam brjod pa bral ba'i ngang la bzhag:a ā:lhar sdang ni:phaṭa mkha' las ste ga dang chu las nya ldang bzhin:chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar ldang:phaṭa phaṭa:shis brjod ni:na mo skye 'gags med pa chos sku de bzhin nyid:lhun grub rang byung rang gsal longs sku'i zhal:thugs rje ma 'gags sprul sku'i rol gar bsgyur:ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po'i bkra shis shog:ye nas spros bral don rtogs lta ba'i dbyings:rang byung rang ngo shes la sgom pa'i

110 ngang: re dogs blo bral rnam rgyal spyod pa'i babs: thams cad mnyam nyid 'bras bu mdzes gyur cig: rten 'byung bkra shis legs tshogs 'phel ba dang:don dam rang byung ye shes mngon gyur te: rtogs pa'i 'bras bus rang klong gdeng rnyed nas: khyab brdal dgongs pas yongs su mdzes gyur cig: sa ma yā: rjes kyi rim pa'o: cas sgo.i ma gnyug ma rang babasadan rgya gzhal yas nas: rang byung rig sku padma rgyal po yis dgongs pa'i rtsal dbang bu la rgyas btab tshe: gter 'byung rgyal po'i pha nor srid la 'byor: rang babs gnas tshe dgongs pa'i klong brda rdol:yi shas gzigs pas dag snang sgyu 'phrul mjal: rten 'brel dbang gis sgyu ma'i rdzas gter nod: smon lam dag pas snyan brgyud sgron me gsal las 'phro bzang pos yang gter skal ba rnyed: dri ma phra bas rjen dran rtsol med 'byung: rdo rje 'chang gi bka' dang mtshungs pa'i chos: 'dzam gling yongs khyab nyi ma thugs la 'chang srid gsum gsal byed sgron me lag na thogs: gang la mos pa de yi ma rig sel: gang zhig brten pa de yi sgrib pa byang: gang la 'dun tshad thar ba'i lam sna zin: 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin rgyal po yi: gdul bya'i dpal du phrin las 'di rnyed shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya:snyi: zhes pa 'di yang chos bdag padma chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i bkra shis lha regs bcas te bskul

ba dang smon lam 'phro bzang 'dzom pa reb kong ba kun bzang rdo rje nas sngags kyi gsang gos dkar po dang sgrub brtson gyi me tog bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis o rgyan bha tra ma ṇis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

bee sha dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las:bajod mid dan rgya khyang bshags bzhugs so:sgrib bral gdod nas dag pa'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo:66rtsa sa sku dri mid mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings:ye nas grol ba'i sangs rgyas spros pa dag:nyag gcig thig le kun bzang khyab brdal klong:bskyar gzhi mi dmigs don gyi dgongs par bzhag:ā:'dangs sku 'od gsal ngas pa lnga ldan klong:rang grol chen po'i ngang las rtsol ba med:don gyi 'og min rang bzhin rnam dag la:gnyen po mi dmigs rtsol sgrub bshags par bgyi:shā:sprul sku mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid ye shes gter:shar grol gzigs pa sna tshogs bsam mtha' yas:gzung dang 'dzin pa'i spros pa yid chos khams:snga phyi ris med rig pa rjen parashar:swā:spang bya'i mas khams yi stong med mnyam dang:sgrub bya'i sdom dang sdom pa dam tshig dag:blang dor gnyis med rig pa gcig pu dza 'da' nyams spros pa ka nas dag par bshags:hā:'khor ba spangs nas 'das pa sgrub tu med:gnyis ga'i spros pa phyal mnyam brdal ba che:rnam thar gsum ldan de bzhin nyid rtogs nas:shes bya'i

chos khams lhun grub chen por bshags:rlu:ye nas ka dag rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha':yangs dogs sgrib g.yogs med pa'i rang bzhin la:'dzin shes phra ba'i rdul gyi rnyogs ma phyung:thog ma'i sgrib pa chos kyi dbyings su bshags:swe dri ma med pa'i dngul dkar me long la:rlung dang 'dzin pa'i has sgrib g.ya' yis 'khyud:'od gsal lkog gyur rags pa'i rnam par 'phos:lhan skyes sgrib pa ye shes rjen par bshags:shrī:'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs res med mod kyang:yid chos spros pas bar dang mtshams bcad nas:rang byung 'od gsal lkog gyur rten 'brel tsam:kun btags sgrib pa shes rab chen por bshags:tt+waṃḥrab gsal spyan la 'grib pa med mod kyang:sems kyi rtul zhugs mthong ba lkog tu gyur:nyam nga'i gnas su long ba'i 'gros ltar dub da ni rig pa rjen pas gsal zhing bshags hūṃ:rje gas chen dgongs pa zang thal rlabs chen mthus:yid chos zag pa sprul sku'i dbyings su sangs:rnam shes phra ba longs spyod rdzogs skur dag kun gzhi'i rtogs ma chos sku'i ngang du grol:don dam 'bras bu'i rgyal
110 srid gting rnyed nas:mkha' mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i dpal thob shog:lta ba'i 1nga bshags 'di brjod mthus:gzung 'dzin sems kyi dri ma kunaḥ

dzas dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las:dgyes bskang sprin kyiphung po bzhugs so: :mi na mo gu ru ya: thardzurnga snang srid ro mnyam dga' ston gyibla ma'i dgyes pa bskang bar bya:sa ma lha ( hrī:rtang 'dzin mos mchor 'khrung ba'i dga' ston nor:yid chos lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor gter:ma bzung rang rig gsal bas dang blang nas:rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul:ka dag chos skulidagongs pa ye grol klong:lhun grub longs sku'i dgongs pa rang grol ngang:ro mnyam sprul sku dgongs pa shar grol babs:brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:ye nas dri bral 'das pa'i sangs rgyas zhal:sgrib g.yogs mi dmigs da lta'i sangs rgya dngos:bral thob mi dmigs ma 'ongs bde bar gshegs:tha snyad spros bral bla mayithugs dam bskang:dgongs pa'i mtsho gling dag snang ri mor mngon:rig pa'i sgrom bu /shes brdas 'byed tshe chings bzhi'i yon tan chig rdzogs dpal ster ba'i sa/ rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang:ma rig tshogs brgyad mngal rgya las grol

rig pa'i bu chung rtogs pa'i rtsal bskyed nas: yon tan rig 'dzin yab dang mnyam mdzad pa'i ma chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang: thugs kyi gsang 'dzin slob dpon hūṃ ka ra: gsung gi dbang phyug rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nyid: sku yi gar bsgyur rgyal tshab rig pa 'dzin: bdud 'dul nus ldan dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang: snang stong zung 'jug rig 'dzin bla ma'i sku: grags stong brjod med dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung: rig stong ka dag ye shes bla ma'i thugs: mi g.yo mnyam nyid dgongs pa'i thugs dam bskangs:rten 'brel sprul sku'i bla ma gzugs su ngoms: bde chen rang byung bla ma sems kyi gsang: ka dag don gyi bla ma rig pa'i ngang: dus gsum 'bral med chen po'i thugs dam bskang: ma bzung yul snang dag pa'i dga' ston dang: ma dmigs 'dzin pa grol ba'i 'dod yon gter: ma bshams dug gsum cer grol sman gtor raka: ma lus mnyam rol mchod pas thugs dam bskang: dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba dang: dmigs gsal 'dzin pa grol ba'i sgom pa'i ngang: bya btsal re dogs ro snyoms spyod pa yis:

dzas 'bras bu dag chen bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: bskang dang bskang bar bya ba tha snyad tsam: mchod dang mchod bya mchod byed rten 'brel chos: thams cad mi dmigs ka dag spros dang bral: blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du bzhag: de ltar dgyes bskang thabs brtson pas rnal 'byor chag nyams sor chud de: nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: rig 'dzin rgyud pa'i sras su 'gyur: sa ma yā: dam can rgya mtshos thub par srung bka' log lag tu ma re ra cig rgya rgya rgya: gu hra:3): zhes pa 'di'ang las smon 'phro 'dzoms sa marnya bha tra badzra zhes bya bas bkra shis lha regs dri bral gsang gos dkar po bcas te bskur ngor kho borgyal mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda' las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin sa manta tra ma ṇi so/ sarba maṅga le/

cas dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po'i sgrub pa mi shigs snying po bzhugs so: chag na mo gu ru padma kwa ra ye:tshuzugabacikhye7) ma bcos rig pa thad gar bskyang: snang srid gzhir bzhengs bskyed rim gyis rig 'dzin bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di: man ngag kun gyi rgyal por zungs: sa ma yāḥ ā: ma nga ngas rig pa stong gsal klong: lhag mthong snang cha'i rten 'brel kun: rnga yab dpal ri'i bkod rdzogs dbus: 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul gzhal med khang: ma chags padma 'od 'bar dbus: bde stong nyi zla zhal sbyor khar: rang snang bla ma rdo rje 'chang: gter 'byung rgyal po ye shes sku: zhi ma khro 'dzum brjid nyams can: padma ra ga'i zhal bzang la: nyin byed 'bum 'khyud bkrag mdangs 'bar: phyag g.yas padma'i lcags kyu yis: gdul bya'i khams rnams dbang du bsgyur: g.yon pa nyi zla'i sgom bu 'dzin: gter rigs bco brgyad chos char 'bebs:gsang gos 'dung ma phod chen dang pād zhwa sgro dar me long mdzes: za 'og ber chen brjed par klubs: rgyal po rol ba'i thabs su 'gying: lha lcam sbas tshul kha ṭwāṃ brten: ye

shes 'od lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs: rigs bdag (chen kā ra ni: dkar gsal rdor dril bsnol 'khrud 'dzin: he ru ka pa'i cha lugs can: snang stong sgrib g.yogs bral bar bskyed: mdun du dgyes bskyed sa ra dza: bcu drug mdangs ldan 'dzum pa'i zhal: dmar gsal bde ba chen po'i sku: phyag g.yas bhanta bdud rtsi dang: rin chen sna lnga'i lde mig 'dzin: g.yon pas gter bum bcud 'khyil bsnams: mdzes sgegs lha mo'i cha byad can: brtul zhugs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: g.yas phyogs dpa' bo pho tshogs kyis:bro brdung gar byed khrigs se khrig: g.yon na dpa' mo mo tshogs kyis: nyams dga' glu len kyu ru sa: rgyab tu ging dang lang ka yis: brda skad bshug glu sangs se sang: bar mtshams 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bde stong spros bral dga' ston spyod: kun kyang ye shes rol ba'i dal: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: sgog gis bskul te ye shes pa: rnga yab gling nas spyan drangs bstim: sa hrī: o rgyan dha na dri med ko sha'i mtsho: dbang rgyal pād sdong ze'u 'bru rab bzhad khar: sku gsum ston pa gu ru gang chen mtsho:

110 ye shes sgyu ma gter 'byung rgyal po'i tshul: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don phyir: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng bcas: khyed shes dad pas gnad bskul gsol gdab na: o rgyan yi dam lha dang mkha' 'dza'i tshogs: gter 'byung rgyal po'i rnam par 'dir byon la: sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsol: 'dir 'tshogs yongs kyi snang ba dbang du bsgyur: chu bo bdun ldan zab gter rin po che'i: dga' ston dpal la kun kyang legs spyod pa'i: byin rlabs myur stsol dbang chen bskur du gsol: sgo badzra ma hā gu ru ni dha kā ra rā dza sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: snye na a we sha ya a ā: blang ātshu:chos sku'iklong na dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod: dgongs brgyud byin rlabs rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: longs sku'i dbyings na dag snang rin po che: brda thabs byin rlabs rigs ldan bu la stsol: sprul sku'i zhing na sa gter nor bu'i dpal: mngon sum snyan brgyud mos ldan bu la stsol: ye shes gzigs pa'i gter 'byung rgyal po yis: bstan pa'i

btsas su yang gter stsal du gsol: rjes chags 'dzum ngoms dzñā na sa ra dzas: gces nor snyan brgyud rig pa'i sgron me sbor: gnyis med ye rdzogs hūṃ chen ka ra yis: thugs dmasnying po rjes su dran par mdzod: bka' gter yongs 'dus man ngag nying khu mchog: rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus dngos grub stsol: skyid ma hā gu ru ni dhi pha la sarba sirnyi sa: zhes mosagus rga med pa dang ldan pas ci nus su bzla'o: ma.āḥbye stong pa chos dbyings kā pā lar: snang srid thams cad tshogs su shar: gter 'byung rgyal po dgyes phyir stobs: phyi yi sgrom rgya 'byedadu gsol: sems nyid khyab brdal ka pā lar: sems byung yid chos tshogs su shar: ma cig mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul: nang gi sgrom rgya bkrol du gsol: rig stong 'od gsalaka pā lar: 'gags med ye shes tshogs su shar: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul: gsang ba'i sgrom rgya klong rdol mdzod: 61 ma hā gha ṇa tsakra pu dza ho: ni dhi pha la a la la ho/zhes mnyam nyid bde ba go po'i tshogs ston stob po: mdun bskyed gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad dbang du bsgyur: rten 'brel

dzas nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang: legs tshogs dpal yon gyis sgo kun nas 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i slad du: zab gter rin po che'i sgron me'i 'od gegs med du 'bar zhing: gdul zhing yongs la khyab cing brdal te: rmad byung gu ru padma'i phrin las mtha' yas pa thams cad bdag gis yongs su grub par mos la: tson ma hā gu ru ni dhi kā ra rā dza sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ ā: gdongs pa dbyings su bor de bzhag: brjod med nā da'i don la bzla: thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa che: ma brtsal rang byung ting 'dzin skyongs: sa ma yā: bka' 'di dur khrod bdag pos srungs:dam nyams lag tu ma re/ra bar thugs sras rig pa 'dzin la spel gdul zhing ma lus smin grol mdzod: rgya rgya rgya gu rgya:3|: zhes rdza rgyal 'phan phyugs dang 'brel ba'i gnas brag btsan mched bdun gyis srung skyobs byed pa'i yang dbenagashin rje'i rnam rol gyi sgrom rgya las sman btsun mched lngas gces nor du gnang ba'o: spron lam 'phro 'dzom kun bzang rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang thugs sras padma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bzhed bskul don dang ldan phyir kholargyal mchag bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'u nas zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin sa manta bha tra ma ṇis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
rbesha dmagachas gsang b.longs 'dus sa: gter sgrub rin po che'i lde mig zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

cas na mo gu ru ni dhi kā ra ya: rba rajadru 2rotshebaza4thurmarkaco6rna11 1tsho dgos 'dod char 'bebs bum pa bzang po'i dbyig don gnyis lhun grub dpag bsam na pa'i tshal: gdul bya'i mun pa sel ba'i sgon me mchog: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ongs padma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin gyi brda sgo ma khrol brda sgrom ma 'byed pa: sa gter ma rnyed dag snang mog gyur pa: rten brel nyes pa'i 'dzabs ma gang byung yang 'di nyid brten na legs tshogs dpal yon 'phel: sa ma yuX sgyu 'grul dben pa'i gnas su dam rgya bcad dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi khod snyoms steng: gnas chen dag gi sa sna bye ma krams pad ma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon legs par bkye: lte bar 'bru dang sman sna spungs pa 'i steng: brda'am yi ge rdzas rnams gang rung bkod: yang na gter gnas ming dang rdzas kyi ming: sku gsung thugashe rtan 'ide zha ba 'god:pas lnga tshogs ston spos me zhal zas bkrams yid 'ong bkod pa bla bre 'phan gdugs bcas: bkod mdzes khyad par 'phags pa blo yi dpags sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyi rlabs sa ni: /meX /spyo hrī ā: lha rdzas dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la: rnams pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po: dpe 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam

110 rol du rgyas par gyur cig: tshesarbabid su ra su ra a parta ya a parta ya badzra pu dza spra ra ṇa dza: mchod pa'i sprin gzung mang du brjod la spel lo rten bskyed ni: sa ma hā shu n+ya ta dzña na badzra sā bha wa atpa ko3 nya: rten rnams mi dmigs chos dbyings stong par gyur: de yi ngang las lhun grub yi ge sbyo: yongs gyur dri med 'od lnga'i gzhal med dza: phyi nang gsal ba brda don rtags rdzogs dbus: rig pa trī:dmar spro bsdus zhu ba las: gter 'byung rgyal po dmar gsal bkrag 'od babar: zhi 'dzum brtse ba'i rnams 'gyur bsam yas rdzogs: phyag g.yas padma'i lcags kyu mdzes pa yis: gdul bya'i zhing kun ma lus dbang du bsgyur: g.yon pas nyi zla kha sbyor sgrom bu 'dzin: chu bo bdun ldan zab mo'i dpal kha 'byed: mdzub mor ratna lnga yi lde mig brten: rten 'brel legs pa'i gsal sgo 'byed par byed: rdo rje'i gsang gos 'dung ma phod chen dang: dmar ser chos gos za 'og ber chen klubs padazhwasgrodar nyi zla nor bu'i mtshan: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭwāṃ mchan g.yon brten: 'od zer bsam yas sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i klong: 'bum phrag

yangs pa'i mkha' 'gros bde stong stob: 'od re'i rtse la 'gro 'dul sprul pa re: mi mjed zhing kun 'dren pa'i de dpon 'gyed: chu bo bdun ldan phun tshogs skal ba 'byor:mdzad phrin stobs nus gdul bya'i yul mthun 'byed: phong rgud rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs 'joms shing: legs tshogs dpal yon 'byung ba'i gzhi ru shar: kun gyi mthun snang dpal spel sa ra dza: zab mdzod rin chen drug gi lde mig tu: re re bzhin du gzigs pa'i zhal bzang ngoms: gdul bya'i zhing khams 'dul ba'i dpal du shar: kun gyi thugs srog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: sa/ rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i rnam pa dzasgyuspyan drangs gnyis med bde ba chen por bsre: spos sreg rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs cing snyan pa'i glu yis bskul te spyan 'dren pa ni: bla hrī: stong gsum mi mjed sprul pa sku yi zhing: bye ba phrag brgya'i bla ma gang chen mtsho: rnam rol mtha' yas ye shes gcig gi tshul: gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po'i sgyu 'phrul du: gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsol: gdul bya'i
