dzas mthun snang zab gter sbas rgya khrol:skal bzang bu la dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa spor:sbas don rdor tshig bkrol bar dbugs dbyung mdzod:tsho/ ma hā gu ru ni dhi kā ra ra dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza:bzhugs gsol ni:shā trī:ting 'ardzan dadza/ngas pas byin gyis brlab pa'i gzhi:ma dang mkha' 'dza'i dam tshig 'dzom pa'i gdan:gdul bya'i zhing sa bsod nams phun tshogs rten:'gags med shugs 'byung chen por bzhugs su gsol:dzñā na dhartu ma hā mu tra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:phyag 'tshal ni:na ma ka dag spre sa dang bral ba'i pho brang nas:khyab brdal chos sku'i bla ma kun tu bzang:ye grol lta ba dag pas phyag bgyi'o:yid dpyod blo bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs:'od gsal bum pa sku yi pho brang nas:kun gsal longs sku'i bla ma rdor 'chang la:rang grol sgom pa dag pas phyag bgyi'o:yid chos spros dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs:ma 'dres mnyam pa nyid kyi pho brang nas:kun gzigs sprul sku'i bla ma pad 'byung la:shar grol sprod pa dag pas phyag bgyi'o:tshogs drug zang thal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs:yod min med min drag

mnyam pho brang nas: rdzogs pa chen po ye shes bla ma la: cer grol 'bras bu dag pas phyag bgyi'o: gdod ma'i zad sar 'byel bar byin gyis rlobs: sa ma ya na mo sa: mchod 'bul ni bye hrī: phyogs dus kun na 'dod lngar bkod pa'i chas: mtshan ma rang grol rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos nyid la yang chos nyid thim par 'bul: du ma rang grol chen por bzhes su gsol: zlo ru pa shabha ghandhe ra sa sparnye dharma pu dza ho:hrī: yi shes ma 'gags zang thal rol ba'i mdangs: dug lnga cer grol ro mnyam mchod pa'i mchog: chos nyid la yang chos nyid thim par 'bul: du ma rang grol chen por bzhes su gsol: skye ma hā sarba su kha dzñā na dhartu a ho sa ma ya pu dza hoḥhrī: dbyings kyi mkha' las rigs lnga'i rtags 'gro ma: ye shes rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya'i tshogs: tshos nyid la yang chos nyid thim par 'bul: du ma rang grol chen por bzhes su gsol: ma dzñā na dhartu la phywa ma swe girti nīrti mu tra ma hā sa ma ya ho: tri: chos kun bdud bcom chos nyid rtsi ru 'khyil: rten 'brel dbyings sbyor bde ba chen po'i khrag dhu tir rol ba'i rlung sems bā lirnyi: chos nyid la

dzas yang chos nyid thim par 'bul:du ma rang grol chen por bzhes su gsol: badzrapu dza ma hā a mṛ ta rakta bā lirnyi su kha sa ma ya ho:yimishegs dgongs pa'irol mtsho dwangs pa ༄/'khor 'das lam gsum phyag rgya bzhi yi chos:ma 'dres rang shar rang grol 'dzin pa med:kun khyab brdal ba chen por bzhes su gsol:a ho:ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho:bstod pa ni:(hrī:dri ma mid pa mkha' ltar dag pa'i thugs:sgra tshig las 'das 'gag pa med pa'i gsung:mtshan ma rang grol dwangs ma 'od kyi sku:lhun mnyam bla ma gter 'byung rgyal la bstod:chos sku'i don rtags thugs la phyogs ris med:longs sku'i brda ru sku la rdos mtshan grol:sprul sku'i rnam rol rgyan chas ma 'dres shar:kun 'dus bla ma pad ma rgyal la bstod:gzhi las ma g.yos dgongs rgyud yongs 'dus zhal:lam snang ma 'gags brda rgyud kun gyi gsang:rang snang ston pa snyan rgyud 'dus pa'i gter chig rdzogs bla ma yid bzhin nor bur bstod:zad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi dgongs pa can:ye shes sgyu mar rol ba'i gzigs pa ldan:ting 'dzin zad

pa med pa'i 'phrul snang can: gter brgyud bla ma gang chen mtsho la bstod bde ba'i rdo rje chags pas ma gos par: bde ba yongs la sbyin pa'i dam 'dzin ma: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod 'chang ba po: bde stong pad 'byung yab yum sku la bstod: stong pa'i mkha' la chos khams yul med 'gro: ngo bo nyid mkhar chos can zang thal 'gro: ka dag mkha' la lhun grub ye shes 'gro: mnyam rdzogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod gsol ni kyi ho: kun gzhis myos pa'i gti mug 'gro ba'i khams: dgongs gter mdzad pas chos skur bsgral du gsol: rnam shes kyis myos zhe sdang 'gro ba'i khams: dag snang mdzad pas longs skur bsgral du gsol: yid kyis myos pa'i 'dod chags 'gro ba'i khams: sa gter mdzad pas sprul skur bsgral du gsol: mi rtogs phyogs rer gol ba'i rtog pa can: rjes dran ye shes gzigs pas bsal du gsol: gsal ba phyogs rer lta ba'i rtogs pa can: snyan rgyud shes rab sgron mes bsal du gsol: bde ba nyams su myong ba'i rtog pa can: yang gter rig pa'i sgon mes bsal du gsol:

beedu yid chos khams kyi dri ma phra rags kun: kun khyab dgongs pas chos skur bsal du gsol: ni dhi pha la a la la ho: tshogs ston 'bul ba ni: ā: stong chen kun gzhi yangs pa'i ka pā lar: 'khor 'das tshogs su shar ba'i 'khor lo kun ro mnyam ye shes rjen pas dang blang nas: kun bzang bla ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir spro: kazhwa:snang ba rgyan gyi tshogs ston 'di: stongs pa lha mos gar dang bcas: bla ma'i sku la gus pas 'bul: gnyis su med par bzhes su gsol: grags pa glu yis dga' ston 'di:stong dbyings lha mos 'gyur khug bcas: bla ma'i gsung la gus pas 'bul: bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol: 'gyu 'phro sems kyi dga' ston tshogs: rig stong lha mos gar dang bcas: bla ma'i thugs la gus pas 'bul: mnyam nyid chen por bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dug gsum ka dag ste: sku gsum mngon gyur dngos grub stsol: tsang ma hā gha ṇa tsakra pu dza ho: bshags pa ni: sto snachogs snang ba sku yi klong: sku la nongs pa ma mchis kyang: rdos por bzung ba'i nongs pa kun: zang thal tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags:

grags pa sngags kyi rang bzhin la: sngags la nongs pa ma mchis kyang: ris chad tshig tu brjod pa'i nongs: 'gags med rjen par bskang zhing bshags: 'gyu 'phro thugs kyi dkyil 'khor che: thugs la nongs pa ma mchis kyang: 'dzin stangs las rlung nongs pa kun: kun khyab dbyings su bskang zhing bshags: yul med mthong ba'i dam tshig gis: so thar sdom dam nyams pa bshags: gzhi med rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: byang sems sdom dam nyams pa bshags: zang thal rig pa'i ye shes kyis: gsang sngags sdom dam nyams pa bshags: bshags dang bshags bya bshags byed dben: blo 'das rdzogs pa chen por bzhag: gha ṇa tsakra sa ma ya bhi shuddhi ā: bskang ba ni trī: chos sku'i bla ma gang chen mtsho kun gzhi'i dga' ston bkod pas bskang: ma rig rdul skyon ka dag ste: gdod ma'i chos sku mngon gyur shog: longs sku'i bla ma sgyu 'phrul gter: rnam shes dga' ston bkod pas bskang: lhan skyes dri ma rnam dag nas: ye rdzogs longs sgu mngon gyur shog: sprul sku'i bla ma thugs rje'i gter: yid chos dga' ston bkod pas bskang: kun

110 btags khams gsum bral dag ste:don gyi sprul sku mngon gyur re ga:gzhi yi bla ma kun tu bzang:lam gyi bla ma gter 'byung rgyal:'bras bu'i bla ma gang chen mtsho:gnyis med rdzogs pa chen por bskang:bskang ba'i chos ni ye nas zad:bya ba mos ru rdzogs sangs rgyas:bskang bar bya rgyu gdod nas dag: byed pa po ni kun tu bzang:bskang ba'i yul ni ka nas dag:rnam thar gsum ldan dgongs ba'i klong:'di don blo yis mi dmigs pas: ye shes rig pa rjen par ā:gsol gdab ni:yi mato thugs rje chan bayongs su gang ba yi:sprulasku'i bla ma gter 'byung rgyal po la: blo bral rig pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'deb:sa gter sbas rgya grol bar byin gyis rlobs:ye shes gzigs pa phyogs med yongs brdal ba'i:longasasku'i bla ma gtar mdzod rgyal po la: so so rang rig ngang nas gsol ba 'deb:dag snang gab rgya grol bar byin gyis rlobs:dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag cing yongs khyab pa'i:tshasasku'i bla ma gter bdag rgyal po la:ye grol rig pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'deb:dgongs gter 1nga rgya grol

bar byin gyis rlobs:kun gzhi sems kyis myas pa'i gti mug rnams:dgongs gter rjes dran thabs kyis bsgral ba dang:rnam shes kyis myos zhe sdang sems can rnams:dag snang snyan rgyud zab mos bsgral ba dang:yid kyis myos pa'i chags pa'i sems can rnams:sa'i bcud yang gter sgo nas bsgral nus pa'i:smon lam phrin las thabs stobs mtha' yas par:o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i byin gyis rlobs:mtsho rgyal ḍārkis rtags bar byin gyis rlobs:'bral med lhag pa'i lha yi byin gyis rlobs:dpa' bo rnams kyis nyes pa'i phyogs rnams sol:dpa' mo rnams kyis legs pa'i sgo tshogs bskyed ging dang ling gas bar chad bsal ba dang:rje btsun bla mas rjes su bzung du gsol:skabs 'dir rdo rje'i tshig bdun pa'i gsol gdab mos gus tshad med pas bya'o bzlas dmigs ni:rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros:gu ru gter 'byung rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul:zab gter chu bo bdun ldan gyi sgo 'phar gdul bya'i dpal du 'byed cing:mi zad dgongs pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi dngos grub:mi 'gags ye shes sgyu 'phrul gsal ba'i dngos

tsas grub: mi nub 'byung khams sa ya sbas don grol ba'i dngos grub: rtag par snyan rgyud rin po che'i sgron me'i 'od nub pa med pa'i dngos grub: khams gdul bya'i yul la rjes dran ye shes kyi mdzad pa chags thog dang bral ba'i dngos grub: smon lam gyi dbang gis rjes su lhag pa'i gdul bya'i mjug rnams skyong phyir yang gter rin po che'i dngos grub: bka' gter zab pa'i don 'dus 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i dngos grub rnams bdag sgrub pa po la dus da lta nyid du stsol bar dmigs la: 6)dhu /dhu ru dza ya mu khe swā hā: 'bum phrag bzla: khya(badzram hā gu ru ni dhi kā ra ra dza sarba sirnyi pha la sa: ci nus su bzla ni dhi pha la a we sha ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho sidhi hrī: de yang grangs mang du bzla'o: tshogs la rol ba ni: yim ho pad ma'i mdzad pa bdag gis sgrub lags pas: dngos grub zab gter rin chen nyi ma shar: mnga' gsol dbugs dbyung skyes len tshogs ston 'di:gter gyi dbang skal 'dzom pa'i dpal du byedad: siddhi pha la a la la ho: lhag ma dang gtor ma skyems bcas phul te:ra yi kho: tsos ā shā lan gsum gyis phul la 'di skad do: rje : sku gsum rdo na

mchog padma he ru ga'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos ma sring ging: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro ma: sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad dang: dpal mgon bdud cu yul lha gter bdag rigs: 'dzam gling skyong ba'i bstan ma 'khor bcas kyis: bzhes lhag rol ston sha khrag dmar gtor dpal: dza gad sman raka zla rgyas zla phrum la: dgyes par rol zhing dam tshig chen pos bzhes: zab gter bstan pa spel ba'i grogs po mdzod: phrin las rnams bzhi'i gdul zhing yongs bskyang nas: 'brel tshad rig 'dzin tshogs gral skyel ma gyis: tse rgyan padma'i zhabs drung 'khod par mdzod: gnyer bcol phrin las sgrubs shig sa ma ya: ma ma gzhi ṭa e dam ba lirnya dza gta a mṛ ta ra kta la kha khā kha khā hi kha hi: bsngo spron ni ho: padma'i rang lugs chu bo bdun ldan gyi: sgo 'byed phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du bsngo: thams cad sku gsum rang zhal mngon gyur nas:chos sku gter bdag rgyal po'i dpal thob shog: brten bzhugs ni:61rmos kyi sku la g.yo ba ma mchis kyang: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad 'gags pa mi mnga' pa'i: sprul sku rgyun mi

tsas chad pa'i phrin las su:chu bo bdun ldan yun ring bzhugs gyur cig: dharma ni dhi tiṣṭha badzra bsdu rim ni: snod kyi 'jin rten rnga yab dpal rir shar ba: bcu da dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs la bsdu: de thams cad o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po la bsdu: de nges pa lnga ldan la bsdu: de gter mdzod rgyal po la bsdu: de 'od gsal thig le nyag gcig tu bsdu: de chos sku gter bdag rgyal po la bsdu: de gting gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa shin tu phra ba'i ye shes rjen par mnyam bzhag bya'o: slar yang chos sku'i dgongs pa gdul bya'i dpal du shar ba gu ru gter bdag rgyal po'i gsal snang gis: rjes thob ro mnyam gyi spyod pa la bslabs par bya'o: shis brjod ni: na mo: ka dag mkha' la lhun grub nyi zla 'bar: rtsol med 'od 'bar gdul bya'i rmongs mun sel: sku gsum lhun grub mdzad pa rgyas mtsho yis: phyogs dus kun du khyab pa'i shis pa rtsol kun bzang thugs kyis bstan pa rin po che: mthong thos dran reg rnam grol sar 'god pa'i: rmad byung a ti rdzogs pa chen po yis: 'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun du khyab gyur

cig: nyin yang bkra shis rig pa gcer mthong ngang: mtshan yang bkra shis 'od gsal khyab brdar klong: rtag par bkra shis ka dag rjen pa'i gshis: dus gsum ro mnyam chen po'i bkra shis rtsol: padma'i rang lugs chu bo bdun ldan gyi: zab gter mchog gi nyin mo rab gsal te: gdul bya'i zhing gis mun pa sangs mdzad cing: gdod ma'i rgyal sar 'bo da pa'i bkra 6)sa regag: gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab 'di sgrub bsod nams bsam mtha' yas: rten 'brel nyes pa sor chud cing rin chen sgrom gyi sgo 'phar 'byed: gab pa brda yi gsang gnad grol: sbas pa gter gyi dbang skal 'byor: gsang ba'i lde mig 'di yis 'byed dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bu bzhin skyong: chos skyong srung ma bran ltar 'du: pho nya las mkhan rtag tu nye 'gro ba'i bde skyid nyin mo 'gyed:legs pa'i sgo brgya gong 'phel 'gyur gzhan yang yon tan bsam mtha' yas: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal bdag 'dra padma so bha wa'i: gdul zhing 'gro ba skyob pa'i phyir sku tshab lung bstan thugs dgongs zer las can bu yi dpal du bzhag snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing 'khrug rtsod dang mi 'dod 'tshubs ma langs rkyen gyis legs pa'i sna kha bkag 'gyur ba'i: de tshe rgyal tshab rig 'dzin la: thabs 'di shin tu zab pa'i phyir: gces nor bgo skal tshul du

beedu bzhag:sgyu ma'i nor dang 'di ma brje:zog po'i lag tu 'di ma shor:rin chen rdzas la 'di ma btsong:chos brgyad sgrub sar 'di ma 'jugs:dben pa'i gnas su rang nyams longs 'gro don thugs bskyed dag pa gnad bstan pa'i che ba bskyed phyir zungs rgyal khams mun pa sel phyir spel:'dul zhing smin phyir thabs mkhas mdzod nga yi rgyal tshabs rig pa 'dzin:spyod pa khyi phag ltar ston yang rang bzhin dag pa'i las can yin:nyi ma'i 'od zer bsam mtha' yas:spro yang nyid la bsdu yang nyid:nga yi rgyal tshab mu med pa:spro bsdu thams cad rang gi sang:rnga yab dpal ri logs na med:rje 'bangs lo paṇa ris chad min padma bdag kyang tha mi dad:zab gsang bdun ldan chos nyid klong rgyal tshab spro dang spros pa med:ka dag don gyi dgongs pa 'di don dam nges pa'i de kho na:brjod pa tshig dang bsam pa'i chos:thams cad drang don kho na'o:bden gnyis shan drang 'byed nus na:nga yi rjes 'jug skal bzang yin:phul byung phun tshogs gdams pa 'di:snying gi khrag las phang ba'i phyir:mgon dkar dur khrod bdag por gnyer:bsdam spel mkhas pa'i dam tshig bcol dam nyams lag tu mi 'chor ba'i gnyer gyi bka' rgya dam du bsdam:sa ma ā:rgya rgya rgya:gu khya brda thim 3ni:zhes pa 'di'ang rong chen sngags kyi grub sde nas smon lam las 'phros bskul ba'i chos bdag sa manta bha tra badzra gyis bkra shis lha regs dri bral gsang gos dkar po sgrub

brtson gyi maṇḍal bcas te nan du bskur ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'joms nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin kun bzang nor bus bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

cas dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las: o rgyan gartar 'byung rgyal po'i don dbang bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs so: bsha na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: sna sgo bdag mdun dkyil 'khor bum pa bsgrubs tshogs bsags rig pa'i me tog dor slob ba'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyangs maṇḍal phul la gsol gdab ni: kyi: gsang chen dbang bzhi'ichar 'bebs pa: he ru ka dpal bdag la dgongs: skal ldan smin zhing grol ba'i phyir: rjes su zungs la byin gyis rlobs: lan gnang ni: yim skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du: bsod nams bsags pa'i las 'phro can: sgo 'dir 'phrad pa skal ba bzangaḥ thabs kyi cho ga'i don dbang sbyin: sdom bzung ni: na mkhya dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'gro don byang chub sems mchog bskyed: rdul snyed lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal: snang srid rig pas dang blang mchod: nga bdag dri ma dbyings su bshags: mnyam nyid don la rjes yi rang: sku gsum mdzad pa rgya mtsho bskul: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs: dge kun 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon

gyur phyir: sdom gsum rig pas dang blang nas: 'gal 'khrul mi dmigs lta ba'i klong: sgom dang spyod pa'i dam tshig 'dzin: srung med ye grol rtogs par shog: dam chu ni: ho:khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhal: ye shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i skyems: rdo rje slob ma'i lce la bzhag: rig pa ye shes 'dzin par byos: kā wā tsi sa ma ya na ra gan: slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbabs: de nyid 'gyur med brtan bzhugs gsol: 'dong pa bsal zhing me tog 'bul: dag pa rab 'byams lha ngo sprad: de nas bum dbang sbyin pa ni tsū hrī: skye med dbyings kyi bum pa dzas 'gags med ye shes bcud chen bskyil: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dag mnyam lha dbang yongs thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: gter 'byung rgyal po'i sku gtad la: ( hrī:dgongs pa dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: thugs rje'i gzigs pa bu la ngoms: 'dod 'byung gter bdag rgyal po yi: sku gsung thugs dbang bu la sbyin: zab gter bstan pa 'dzin nus shing: sgo gsum smin grol dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: mtsho rgyal gyi sku gtad la: nyu hrī: bde ba'i mthar son stong pa'i dbyings: rnam kun mchog

110 ldan de bzhin nyid: ye shes gzugs su ngoms pa mo'i: dbang mchog rigs ldan bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: rig bdag gi sku gtad la: ( hrī: ka dag spros dang bral mod kyang: thugs rje'i lo 'dab yongs khyab pa'i: mdzad phrin smon lam gter chen por: rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi shi mi ā: dpa' bo'i sku gtad la: nyu hrī: rdul bral rdo rje'i mkha' dbyings las: 'gags med gar la mnga' brnyes shing: gnyis snang bcom pa'i brtul zhugs can: thabs mchog dpa' bo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: dpa' mo' sku gtad la: ྅ hrī: 'gags med 'od gsal gzhal yas nas: rdo rje'i glu la mnga' brnyes pa'i:tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi 'dren stangs can: shes rab dpa' mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ging gi sku gtad la: shā hrī: rgya mcho'i gleng la dbang bsgyur zhing: gang dkar rtse nas phrin las 'gyed: bdud bzhi bcom pa'i brtul zhugs can: sprul pa ging gi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: dur khrod bdag po'i sku

gtad la: tsū trī: thabs mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yi: phrin las gar gyis 'gro 'dul ba: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin dur bdag gi: srog dbang dam ldan bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar:kwa ya a bhi ༷ 〉 ā: de nas gsang dbang ni: bye hrī: mtshan ldan bhanta yangs pa'i nang: mnyam nyid sbyor ba'i bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong rtogs pa mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: phreng ba gtad la: ( hrī: dri med shel phreng brgya rtsa brgyad: 'od lnga'i thag pas rnam par sprol: dam pa rigs brgyar byin rlabs pa'i: rdzas kyi dbang bskur bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: sngags 'khor gtad la: tsū trī: 'dza ra 'das thams cad rgyu las byung: sems gyi yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sprin: don dam gsang ba sngags kyi dbang: rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: sher dbang ni: ྅ hrī: bde ba sbyin pa'i yid 'ong ma: don dam dbyings skyol nyi zla'i rta: sngags kyi gsang lam khyed la sbyin: zhen pa spongs la dang du longs: rtsa sngags mthar: ma hā a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñtsa sum̐: phyag mtshan gtad la: ka hrī: snang ba

dzas dbang bsgyur padma'i lcags kyu dang: stong gsal gter gyi rgyas 'debs nyi zla'i sgrom: skal bzang pad tshal rab tu rgyas pa'i phyir: smon lam 'phro 'dzoms khyod la rtags dbang sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: phyag mtshan rigs lnga gtad la nyu hrī: chos kyi 'khor lo dbyings rdo rje: mnyam pa'i nor bu rin po che: chags med padma 'dab stong bkra: las rdzogs rgya gram bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar: tsitta a bhi ༷༷/ sa: tshig dbang ni : ā: ming tshog dpi bsdod yul las 'das: skye 'gags 'gyur med rig pa 'di:dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa che: blo bral rjen pas mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: me long gtad la shā trī dngas shing gsal ba'i rang bzhin las gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'gag pa med: don la tha mi dad pa'i dbyings: mnyam nyid rtogs phyir bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a bhi ti mi hrī: thig le gtad la nyu trī: tshos can grwa zuralas 'das shing: chos nyid mnyam pa'i thig le 'di: chos zad rdzogs chen don rtogs phyir: chos dbyings gcer mthong don dbang sbin: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a je 〉〉

trī: mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang ni: nyu hrī: skye med dbyings kyi gtor snod du: 'gags med 'od lnga'i gtor chen bshams: rig rtsal ye shes rgyan gyis spras: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba dang: nyams snang 'khor 'das mtshang grol te: ka dag rig pa tshad la pheb: chos zad bum skur byang chub regag: rtsa sngags mthar bā lirnyi 65 bhi ༷༷ skyed ā hūṃ hrī: de ltar dbang bskur thob pa'i srog: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig 'dzin gtang rag sgo gsum stos med 'bul dge ba mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo: de 'bras don gnyis lhun gyi grub sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya gu hya: brda thim:snyi zhes pa 'di'ang smon lam 'phro 'dzoms kun bzang rdo rje nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskur ngor: kho bo rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus ste dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni sa manta bha tra ma ṇis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam̐/

ru: snyan brgyud rin po che'i mdzod las: 'od gsal bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'ja' lus mngon byed bzhugs so:ṭwāṃ: na mo dzñā na ṭakki ni ya: tha /ca1zas/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la khyed shes blo gtad 'gyur med bcas rnal 'byor 'di ltar sgom par bya: yeng 'khrul rtogs pa'i ma bslus par: ā:rang snang dag pa rnga yab dpal gyi ri: bde chen lhun grub 'od snang bkod rdzogs dbus: rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i mdun mkha' rtsa 'ja' 'od lnga ldan thig le zlum 'khyil 1nga: rtsa ba'i bla ma padma 'byung gnas sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rgyal po rol stabs tshul: phyag g.yas rig stong don mtshon rdo rje bsdig: g.yon pas snang stong thod bum lte bar 'chang: lha lcam sbas tshul gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga: dbu la 'dab ldan padma mthong grol mdzes: zhal 'dzum spyan dang dgyes brtse'i 'od zer 'bar: za ber sngags phod 'dung ma gsang gos dang: chos gos mthing sham rin chen mgul phreng brgyan: zhabs gnyis sāg lham pad zla'i gdan la rol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang liṅga 'gyed: mkhyen brtse'i

gzigs pa dad ldan bu la phyogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bor dmigs: brgyud gsum bla ma sras bcas spyan drangs bstim: kye ma kye hud 31 rgyan rin po che: rnga yab gling nas thugs rjes nye bar dgongs: snyigs ma'i smag rum las ngan 'khrigs pa'i khrod: dpa' bo khyed kyi rjes su 'jug pa bdag: nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i bdud dbang mi gtong bar: lus la 'gyur rmed sku yi gzi byin phob: ngag la 'gags med tshangs dbyangs nus byin phob: sems la 'gyur med bde stong mthu byin phob: mi zad yon tan re skong dbang byin phob: phrin las 'phro 'dul nus pa'i stobs byin phob: ma 'gyang myur ba nyid du byin phob 'dug sa gdan thog 'di ru byin phob chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar rig pa tshad la pheb par byin chos rnams zad sar 'byed bar byin phob mkhyen gnyis ye shes rgyas par byin phob kun bzang dgongs pa rtogs par byi gyis rlobs: ces snying khung rus pa'i gting las gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab par bya'o: kyi ho: rang rig bla ma'i gsang gsum dbang byin rlabs: 'od zer lnga ldan thig le'i rnam par byung: bdag la thim pas sgo

sum̐: gsum sgrib pa dag:bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang gis smin:bskyed rdzogs bde stong khrag thod sgom la dbang:snang dang gsal ba bde chen rig stong mjal:slaranibla ma 'od zhu rang la thim:smra bsam brjod bral nyid du ro gcig 'dres:thugs dgongs mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang la bzhag:ye shes bla ma'i rnal 'byor mngon du bya:a.a:sla yang mkha' 'gra'i gsang sgrub lam khyer ni:ā:snang ba thams cad 'og min zhing:bde chen bkod pa rab rdzogs dbus:chu skyes nyi zla bam ros khar:nang snangam tsaka lab bshan sku:dkar dmar zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i 'khyud:phyag g.yas snyan pa'i ṭā ma ru'i:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar sdud:g.yon pa'i dngul dkar dril bu sgrogs:stong nyid chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'gyed:pha rol phyin rdzogs rus rgyan spras:'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong byed:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur thabs su rol:srid zhi mnyam nyid dgongs don ston:thabs mchog sbas tshul kha ṭwāṃ brten:dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rol:nu 'bur gsang ba rab tu rgyas:bu la bde stong dngos grub 'bebs ljang sngon dar gyi

dpyangs pa 'phur: 'gro don phrin las thogs pa med: 'ja' dang 'od zer mu med 'khrigs: 'khor ba dongs sprug mdzad pa ston: thugs srog las spros 'od zer gyi: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro rten brten pa: brgyud gsum bla ma sras dang bcas: ma cig mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa dang: 'ja' dang 'od phung tshul du byung: rgyang zhags nas drangs snying dbus sum: dbang byin dngos grub gyis gang dmigs: yengs med ting 'dzin brtan po yis: gsal dag stong gsum ldan par sgom de nas dbyings nig rig gsum gyi snang ba rang byung rang shar sgom nyams rtogs yon tan rtsal rdzogs 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya: brda thim:snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin pubye bha dra dang snying nor shrī tris bskul ngor/kho bo nus ldan pas mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni slob bu shrī tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

gyi snyan brgyud rin po che'isgron me las: macigayi shes mkha' 'dza'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya bzhugs:rlu: na 37 gu ṭākko ni ya: canargya/rten/ mdun mkhar 'phags ma gsal btab steḥ khyod shes dad pas gsol gdab ni: ā: gnas smin 'tshams snyeng gi nam mkha' la:mdangs 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gur khang dbus: drin mtshungs bral blamardorje 'chang: sku tha mal ma yin dwangs ma'i lus: skyabs ma cig las kyi sgrol ma ni: bkrag mjes 'bar dkar la dmar mdangs can: rgyan ratna rus pa dar chas spras: phyag g.yas pas ḍā ru mkha' la dkrol: gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' mgro bskul: g.yon bhanta 'chi med bcud kyis gtams: bu dad ldan yongs la dngos grub 'bebs: zhabs rdo rje gar gyi rol thabs mdzad: srid zhi yi sa rnams zil gyis gnon: zhal 'dzum bzang stong gsal 'od sgra la: ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu 'gyed: kun chos nyid mnyam pa'i dgongs sang 'khyil: dpal rig 'dzin rnal 'byor yongs kyi mgon: skyabs brgyud ldan kun

gyi ngo bor dmigs: mtshan 'dzin gyis rtog pa pāṭa kyis ba gas rte gsol bgadabs pa na pāṭa: gnas ka dag dbyings kyi nam mkha' nas: ma chos sku kun tu bzang mo nyid: ye gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i zhal:don rang ngo shes pa'i rtogs pa yis: gnyis med par gsol ba 'debs lags na: lam 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhi ye grol brdal khyab chen po'i klong: dus da lta gdan thog 'di nyid la: ngang rtogs grol dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs pāṭa: gnas 'od gsal rgyan rdzogs pho brang nas ma longs sku mkha' spyod dbang mo nyid: ye gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i zhal:don rang ngo shes pa'i rtogs pa yis: gnyis med par gsol ba 'debs lags na: lam 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhi ye grol brdal khyab chen po'i klong:dus da lta gdan thog 'di nyid la: ngang rtogs grol dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs: pāṭa gnas mkha' spyod gsang chen pho brang nas: ma sprul sku rigs lnga'i mkha' gro ma: ye gdod

ru: nas 'du 'bral med pa'i zhal:don rang ngo shes pa'i rtogs pa yis: gnyis med par gsol ba 'debs lags na: lam 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhi ye grol brdal khyab chen po'i sang: dus da lta gdan thog 'di nyid la: ngang rtogs grol dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs: pāṭa: gnas dag chen dbyingasakyi gzhal yas nas: ma rgyal yum las kyi sgrol ma nyid: ye gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i zhal: don rang ngo shes pa'i rtogs pa yis: gnyis med par gsol ba 'debs lags na:lam 'khrul snang gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos: dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhi ye grol brdal khyab chen po'i klong:dus da lta gdan thog 'di nyid la:ngang rtogs grol dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs: pāṭa: gnas gtsug tor ye shes 'khor lo nas:drin mtshungs bral rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid: ye gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i zhalaḥdon rang ngo shes pa'i rtogs pa yis: gnyis med par gsol ba 'debs lags na: lam 'khrul snang gzung

dang 'dzin pa'i chos: dbyings bdag med rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhi ye grol brdal khyab chen po'i klong: dus da lta gdan thog 'di nyid la: ngang rtogs grol dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs: zhes mos gus tshad med pas gsol ba ci nus su btab po: skyabs slu med las kyi sgrol ma yi: thugs gting gsal nyi zla'i ga'u dzas srog yi ge bam̐ḥgyis rnam pa la: sngags gser thag lta bu'i 'od zer gyi: dpal 'khor 'das 'byung lngas dwangs bcud kun: 'od 'ja' zer yig ge'i rnams pa ༄sa dus skad cig nyid la rab bsdus te: bu mos ldan snying gar reg pa'i mod: blo gnyis 'dzin mdud rgya rab grol nas: gzhi brdal khyab rig stong sku gsum klong: ye gdod ma'i btsan sa zin gyur cig: ma dzñā na garma tā re sarba sirnyi pha ma hūṃ ā: ting 'dzin dgongs pa g.yo med ngang: rig rtong ka dag sa bzung ste: rtsol sgrub blo yis ma reg par rang byung ye shes rang ngo skyongs sa ma yu kyi ho: skyabs mtshungs bral ma cig drin ldan ma'i: gnas lnga la brten bcas yi ge las: 'od kha dog lnga ldan rnams pa dzas cig char du byung nas bdag nyid kyi: gnas lnga la thim pas sgrib tshog dag: smin byed kyi

ru: dbang don nyams su myong: grol lam la bskyed rdzogs gnad 'byung ste: rig 'dzin gyi gsang lam la brgyud de: sku bzhi yi rgyal sar byang chub nas: don gnyis kyis mdzad pa phun dzamags de ga: ces thugs yid bsres la mi rtog ye shes chen po'i ngang la rjen bor bzhag: nyams rtogs yar zla ltar 'phel bar gdon mi za'o/ sa ma yā: lus sbyin gtong bar 'dod na: pāṭa:nga bdag tu 'ardzan pa'i gnyis snang bdud: re dogs kyi spros bral mkha' la bcom: pāṭa: skyabs yul gyis ngo bo rang rig zhal: lhan skyes kyi klong la bdag skyabs mchi: pāṭa:bdag gnyis kyis bcing ba'i sems can rnams: sku gsum gyi dgongs klong 'god par bgyi pāṭa: khams gsum du bzung ba'i dpal 'byor sprin: rgyal yum gyi gsang ba gsum du 'bul: pāṭa: rang byung gi rig pa bla ma'i zhal: gdos bral de ye shes sgyu mar shar: pāṭa: mngon gyur gyi rtogs pas gsol gdab na: sgo gsum po gsang ba gsum du rol: pāṭa: rnam shes gyi ngo bo 'od thig le: dpag chen gyi mda' ltar dbyings su 'pho: pāṭa: gdangs ma 'gags yi shes mkha' 'gror ldang: phyag gri thod bde stong gar

chen bsgyur: pāṭa: bam ye shes dga'aston tshogs su shar: a thung dang haṃ gis bdud rtsir zhu: 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon 'gags med 'dzom ro mnyam pa'i 'dod yon phung por gyur oṃ āḥ(ཿ ha ho hrī: pāṭa pāṭa pāṭa: ḍādril rkang gling ki sgras bskul te: dbyings spros dang bral ba'i nam mkha' la: skyabs rtsa gsum nor lha dam can shar: las byed kyi mkha' 'gros tshogs ston stobs: dgyes bzhes nas rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: pāṭaphuṭa pāṭa: sems dug gsum rang mdangs 'gro ba drug: rnams rtog gi cho rol lha 'dre la: myong grol gyi tshogs ston 'di bstabs pas: nyon 'khrul de rang ngo shes par re/ga: pāṭawāṭa pāṭa: nyam thag pa'i semasacan blun cing rmongs: rang byas kyi las gyis mnar ba rnams: zag med kyi bdud rtsi myong bas grol: sku gsum gyi rang ngo shes par shog pāṭawāṭa pāṭa: mchod bya dang mchod yul spros pa kun: ye grol gyi dgongs par rab zhig te: don dam pa'i kun bzang yab yum zhal: dus gsum du bde bar btagags ste nga pāṭa: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: gnas skabs lam gyi tshogs rdzogs shing mthar thug sku gnyis mngon du

(mi: 'gyur: 'di las zab pa'i man ngag dkon: ma chen snying thug dam pa yin: skal bzang khyod 'dra ma gtogs pas: spron lam log pa'i spyod yul min sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya brda thim:zhwag: snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgron me lta bu 'di gzhan la ston par phang na 'ang / dad ldan snying norandakhyudabha dras bkra shis lha reg dbyangs snyan dril g.yel gyis skyes bcas bskul ngor/ kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

sum̐: bza' tshogs ni:yin ā&: lus bdib chen po'i grongs khyer na: ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ḍakki'i gtams: lag thabs shes phyag rgya 'phrul mo ches: tshogs dga' bzhi'i rol ston mtha' yas pa: rtsa 'khor lo gsum gnyis srog shing gsum: rlung stobs ma me yi 'gros ldan pas: lha gzhon nu thams cad mnyes pa bskangs: 'gros yas dbab mes brtan phyed byed chas: khams gnas dag mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar nas: ma mkha' 'gro'i bzhed don phun tshogs ༄keg:ma ha a nu rā ga a la la ho: 'di yanganus ldan dpa' bosaso: bkra shis ni:na dza: drang dan thabs mang lam gyis 'gro khams skyongs: nges don lta spyod mdzad srong rig 'dzin smin: gza' yul gzung 'dzin bdud sgrol chosaskur dag: che ba'i dbang phyug mchog des shes pa stsol: nus ldan pas so tsogam: dan dam yod dbyed las 'da' ka dag gi dbyings na: lhun grub nang gsal 'og min he ruga'i zhing khams: ma brtsal ye rdzogs 'dus ma byas pa yi tshul can: ngo bo nyid kyi tshos sku ku ma rar bzhugs so: shes rab sku ru smin pa sras mchog gi dkyil 'khor: ye shes

chos sku'i phrin las rabs 'byams kyi khro tshogs: dkyil 'khor gsum kyang don la gnyis med du mnyam nyid: don dam rtogs pa'i lta ba'i rdzong chen de zin pas: snang tshad lha sngags chos skur dag rdzogs du smin par: 'du ba bdun ldan dga' ston tshogs mchod la brten pa'i: gsang sgog ye shes dag pa'i lug gu rgyud 'dir 'tshogs: gnas yul dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin: dga' 'o skyid do mkha' spyod ṭasgri yi gling dbus glu bro gar gyis brtul zhugs dgongs spyod la 'jug 'tshal: mi ring 'og min me ri 'bar ba la spyod pa'i: smon lam mtshams sbyor 'brel ba'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o: khyad chos drug ldan bum skur byang chub la spron 'tshal: zhes thol glu spro na don dang ldan bsnyams nas dhe was ngor/ surya'i bris pa'o:

༷sa dag snang las: bsam pa lhun 'grub myur mgyogs thugs rje'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs:〈mi: shā na gang zhig dran pas phan bde'i dpal ster zhing: bcu gsum zhal bzhes yid bzhin nor bu la: gsol ba btab pas dgos rgu ngang gis 'byung: rkyen snang kun zhi legs tshogs phun tshogs byed sa ma yā: yi/marta skyabs gnas rgya mtshanga'ispyi gzugs bla ma rjes: bcu gsum zhal bzhes tha tshig dus bab pas: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'khru1ba par byin gyis zlordobs: mthu che byin myur dngos grub drod 'bebs cing tshe 'di'i rkyen zhi bsam don kun 'grub pa'i: yid bzhin bsam 'phel lta bu'i gdams pa 'di: bya sla don che padma'i khyad chos yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya: gu khya: brda thim snyi nusaldan rdo rdo'irig pa'i sgom bu las zhal bshus te dad pa'i mos mtshor gsal bar bkod pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

badzra: na mo gu padma ka ra ye: merjedmagagasathami/ bdag snang rig pa skad cig gis ā: rig pa mi 'gyur gzhir bzhings lha: khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum: g.yas pa khrus kyi bum pa bsnams: g.yon na rma bya'i sgro mdangs phyar: brgyad khri bzhi stong grib rnams 'joms: sku la dpal dang dur khrod rdzogs me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs klongs bskyed: gnas gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim: thugs klong nyi zla zung 'jug rbubs:rig pa hūṃ la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas gzung 'dzin grib rnam zhi: 'khor 'das dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: au lhur khung dhis swā hā: 'phro 'du dmigs pa'i cho 'phrul ngang bzlas pa 'bum phrag nyi khri stong: ma yengs ngang bzlas grib rnams byang rgyun du 'di la brtson nus tshe: bsrung bzlog gzhan gyi do zla min pad 'byung bdag gi snying thig dngos: shin tu zab po sa ma āḥ rgya rgya rgya bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal: gu rgya dzi ces kyang rang gi grogs mo rin chen mtshos bskul ngor nus ldan rdo rje'i gter dpe las bsgyur ba bkra shis par gyur cig: sarba maṅga lam̐/ dza yan tu: skabs su mchod bstod bya ba ni: yin bhur khung ma ha pra

ma ye sa pa ri wa ra badzra argham sogs shabha ru pa dharma ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ma hā ba ling ta kha ram̐ khā hi: hrī: rmos nyid zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: log lta 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal: bgegs mthar sme bar brtsegs pa la: mnyam nyid chen po'i phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bskyal surya'i spel ba dge'o:

|| 'od gsal nyams kyis thol glu ni: nyipo gnas banab chen po mkha' spyod kyis gling 'dir: lus thabs kyi rgyu la dkyil 'khor du byas nas: khams drug ldan klong naso gnyug ma yi 'od gsal: da cha med kun 'gro khyab brdal gyi ye shes: lha bdastong rdo rje gzhon nus zhal 'jal byung: sems rlung gi 'gyu ba 'gyur med du brdal nas:khams snang gsum me rlung bdud rtsi ru bzhugs la: 'byung drug sprin he ru ka dpal gyi gsang gsum: da mi shig srog gzugs grub pa na spro byung: nang dga' bzhi stong bzhi'i tshogs ston de spros nas: srog ka ba gsum dang 'od zer lngar bzhugs pa'i da dpa' bo dpa' mo dgyes rol la ngo mtshar: dbyangs gsal 'bras brgya dang bcu gnyis su smin nas: gnas 'og min 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la: da mi 'khyang 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o: zhes smon lam gdab par bya'o: zhes sprul skuyilas ngor:nusaldan pas so

ru: bla ma'i rnal 'byar ni ā: rang lus 'jin med spyi bo'i nam mkha' la: bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal: khyed shes dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na: dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho bar mdzad du gsol: bla ma ha gu ru sa manta bha tra surya sarba sirnyi pha la sa: ci nus bzla bla ma'i gnas bzhi'i 'od zer sna bzhi byung:bdag la thim pas sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs: thugs rgyud byin rlabs rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob: thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang la bzhag: a ā: dbagab 'diyis byang chub snying po'i bar: dpal ldan bla ma'i rjes su zin pa dang: rdo rje theg pa'i rang lugs ma nor bar: bsgom sgrub nyams rtogs yon tan yongs rdzogs shog: shin tu zab cing byin rlabs che bya sla don 'grub khyad chos che sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: zhe pa'ang mgar che'i sngags paka dag rdo dzinas bskul ngor nus ldan pas smras tesnyekhrus yiger bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

ru: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni:rta dmigs mad stongs pa chos sku'i khyon:kun bzang rig rtsal mchod pa'i sprin:phyi nang gsang gsum lha mor bcas: rdor sems dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir spel:badzrasparaṇa dza:'di yang padma theg mchog la:nusaldanaral b.lirdo rjes so:sarba maṅga lam̐/
